storage_living_document_170413.topic: Electricity Storage: Technologies, Economics, and Business Cases

concepts.name: Levelized Cost of Storage (LCOS)
concepts.scope: Net-present-value-based metric expressing the full lifecycle cost of an electricity storage facility per unit of energy output, analogous to LCOE for generation.

concepts.name: Value Stacking
concepts.scope: Strategy of maximising storage asset utilisation and revenue by simultaneously delivering multiple grid or behind-the-meter services.

concepts.name: Behind-the-Meter Storage
concepts.scope: Storage sited downstream of the grid connection point, enabling location-specific services such as demand charge reduction and PV self-consumption increase.

concepts.name: Centralized Grid Storage
concepts.scope: Large-scale storage connected at transmission or distribution level, optimised for system-wide services rather than site-specific benefits.

concepts.name: Techno-Economic Analysis
concepts.scope: Quantitative assessment combining technical performance parameters and cost data to evaluate storage competitiveness and deployment conditions.

concepts.name: Storage Services
concepts.scope: Range of grid and customer functions that storage can provide, including frequency regulation, peak shaving, and renewable energy time-shifting.

concepts.name: Frequency Containment Reserves
concepts.scope: Fast-response ancillary service maintaining grid frequency within limits, historically provided by power plants and increasingly contestable by storage.

concepts.name: Demand Charge Reduction
concepts.scope: Behind-the-meter service whereby storage lowers a customer's peak power demand to reduce tariff charges based on maximum consumption.

concepts.name: PV Self-Consumption
concepts.scope: Use of on-site battery storage to increase the share of locally generated solar electricity consumed at the point of generation rather than exported.

concepts.name: Microgrid Optimisation
concepts.scope: Modelling approach that determines the least-cost combination of distributed generation and storage assets within an islanded or semi-islanded local energy system.

concepts.name: Storage Technology Characteristics
concepts.scope: Techno-economic and safety parameters—including power capacity cost, energy capacity cost, and HSSE properties—that differentiate storage technologies.

concepts.name: CAPEX and OPEX of Storage
concepts.scope: Capital and annual operating expenditure components that together determine the total cost base entering an LCOS or NPV calculation.

concepts.name: Multi-Year Cash Flow Analysis
concepts.scope: Project-level financial model that captures time-varying revenues and costs across a storage asset's life, accounting for regulatory changes and market evolution.

concepts.name: Regulatory Impact on Storage
concepts.scope: Ways in which rules, tariffs, subsidies, and market access restrictions can prohibit, disincentivise, or incentivise electricity storage deployment.

concepts.name: Flexibility in Power Systems
concepts.scope: Capability to balance supply and demand across timescales from milliseconds to years, provided by storage, interconnection, flexible plant, and demand response.

concepts.name: Storage Cost Database
concepts.scope: Structured repository of current and forecast cost, deployment, and market data for storage technologies used to inform project and investment assessments.

concepts.name: National Energy System Modelling
concepts.scope: Long-horizon whole-system models used to assess the role of storage within national energy transitions out to 2050.

implied_prerequisites: Time value of money and discounted cash flow
Electricity market structure and ancillary services

10_1_1_11_6839.topic: Electricity swing option pricing and hedging

concepts.name: Swing option
concepts.scope: An electricity OTC derivative allowing purchased power and energy to vary between contractually specified lower and upper bounds over a delivery period.

concepts.name: One-Swing option
concepts.scope: A swing option variant granting a single consumption swing right from the lower to the upper power boundary within the delivery period.

concepts.name: Full-Swing option
concepts.scope: A swing option variant where the number of swing rights equals the number of discrete delivery dates in the delivery period.

concepts.name: Load pattern
concepts.scope: A stochastic process describing the time-varying power consumption or production quantity subject to energy and power feasibility constraints.

concepts.name: Power and energy constraints
concepts.scope: Deterministic bounds on instantaneous power usage and cumulative energy purchased that define the feasible set of load patterns for a swing option.

concepts.name: Electricity forward curve
concepts.scope: The time-indexed term structure of forward prices on electricity spot price, used as the primary pricing input and hedging instrument.

concepts.name: Swing option decomposition
concepts.scope: Representation of the swing option payoff as a portfolio of a mandatory (forward-hedged) baseline, a supplementary forward component, and an optional call-option component.

concepts.name: Forward martingale measure
concepts.scope: The equivalent martingale measure under which the discounted forward price is a martingale, used to price each delivery-date component of the swing option.

concepts.name: Call option martingale measure
concepts.scope: The equivalent martingale measure associated with a European call option numeraire, enabling decomposition of optional purchase probabilities into call option values.

concepts.name: Optimal load pattern (stopping time problem)
concepts.scope: The constrained stochastic control problem solved by the option holder to maximise swing option value by choosing when to consume at the upper power boundary.

concepts.name: Markov load pattern approximation
concepts.scope: A tractable subclass of load patterns in which optimal purchase decisions depend only on current market prices, yielding a lower boundary for the swing option price.

concepts.name: Swing option lower boundary
concepts.scope: A closed-form computable lower bound on the true swing option price derived by restricting the optimal load pattern to Markov strategies expressed as indicator functions.

concepts.name: Linear optimisation for hedging sets
concepts.scope: A linear programme that determines the time sets over which forwards versus call options are used to replicate the optimal Markov load pattern.

concepts.name: Bermudan option characteristics
concepts.scope: The multi-exercise, path-dependent nature of swing options that makes full analytical pricing intractable and motivates the lower-boundary approximation.

concepts.name: Black-76 model
concepts.scope: The commodity option pricing formula applied to electricity forward prices to compute European call option values from forward price and volatility data.

concepts.name: Complete and arbitrage-free electricity derivative market
concepts.scope: The market assumption that electricity forwards and options span all risk sources and that the law of one price holds, guaranteeing a unique pricing measure.

concepts.name: Power plant production optimisation
concepts.scope: Application of the swing option framework to schedule generation output subject to capacity and fuel constraints, treated as holding a swing option with strike equal to production cost.

concepts.name: Electricity forward curve volatility
concepts.scope: The term structure of volatilities of forward prices, which governs call option values and therefore the portion of the swing option price attributable to optionality.

concepts.name: Wealth equation and replication strategy
concepts.scope: A dynamic self-financing portfolio condition linking the swing option seller's hedging gains and losses to the traded forwards and call options.

methods: No-arbitrage pricing via equivalent martingale measure
Change of numeraire (forward and call option measures)
Stochastic control / constrained optimisation over load patterns
Linear programming for optimal hedging set selection
Nord Pool forward and volatility curve calibration
Numerical examples with tabular and graphical sensitivity analysis
implied_prerequisites: Equivalent martingale measures and Radon-Nikodym derivatives
Electricity forward and spot price modelling
Basic knowledge of electricity market structure and OTC derivatives

dphil_thesis.topic: Electricity derivatives pricing: swing options and spot price modelling

concepts.name: Electricity spot price
concepts.scope: The market-clearing price per MWh determined by supply-demand bidding in day-ahead electricity exchanges.

concepts.name: Price spikes
concepts.scope: Short-lived extreme upward price movements in electricity markets caused by supply-demand imbalances near capacity limits.

concepts.name: Mean reversion
concepts.scope: The tendency of electricity spot prices to return toward a long-run equilibrium level, motivating Ornstein-Uhlenbeck-based models.

concepts.name: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) process
concepts.scope: A continuous-time mean-reverting Gaussian diffusion used to model the normal-regime component of electricity spot prices.

concepts.name: Pure jump process
concepts.scope: A mean-reverting jump component driven by a Poisson process and iid jump sizes, used to capture price spikes independently of the diffusion component.

concepts.name: Exponential OU spot price model
concepts.scope: A spot price model defined as the exponential of a seasonal function plus an OU diffusion plus an independent mean-reverting jump process.

concepts.name: Seasonality
concepts.scope: Deterministic periodic patterns in electricity prices reflecting predictable demand cycles across hours, days, weeks, and seasons.

concepts.name: Moment generating function
concepts.scope: The transform of the log-spot-price distribution used to derive semi-analytic option pricing formulas under the proposed model.

concepts.name: Forward contract
concepts.scope: A zero-cost agreement to deliver electricity at a fixed strike price, either at a point in time or averaged over a delivery period.

concepts.name: Forward contract with delivery period
concepts.scope: A forward whose payoff is the difference between the average spot price and a strike over a specified delivery interval [T1, T2].

concepts.name: Continuous forward curve
concepts.scope: An interpolated function of instantaneous forward prices consistent with the finite set of delivery-period forward prices observed in the market.

concepts.name: Forward curve interpolation
concepts.scope: Methods for constructing a continuous forward curve from discrete delivery-period contract prices, including spline and basis-function approaches.

concepts.name: Piecewise quadratic spline
concepts.scope: An interpolation of the forward curve using quadratic polynomial segments satisfying integral, continuity, and smoothness conditions.

concepts.name: Piecewise cubic spline
concepts.scope: A higher-order polynomial spline interpolation of the forward curve imposing additional curvature conditions.

concepts.name: Seasonal correction forward curve method
concepts.scope: A two-step forward curve construction using a seasonality first approximation calibrated to historical spot data, corrected by a quadratic spline to match market integrals.

concepts.name: Swing option
concepts.scope: A path-dependent electricity derivative granting the holder multiple exercise rights to adjust consumption volume within specified limits over a contract period.

concepts.name: Path-independent option pricing
concepts.scope: Valuation of electricity options whose payoff depends only on the spot or forward price at a single date, using moment generating function techniques.

concepts.name: Call and put options on forwards
concepts.scope: Options whose payoff is based on the value of an electricity forward contract at expiry, with or without a delivery period in the underlying.

concepts.name: Grid method for swing options
concepts.scope: A numerical dynamic-programming approach on a state-space grid that uses conditional density approximations to price swing options.

concepts.name: Conditional density approximation
concepts.scope: Analytical approximations to the conditional distribution of the spot price process used as inputs to the grid-based swing option pricing algorithm.

concepts.name: Equivalent martingale measure
concepts.scope: A risk-neutral probability measure under which discounted asset prices are martingales, used as the pricing measure for electricity derivatives.

concepts.name: Market incompleteness
concepts.scope: The property of electricity markets whereby the non-storability of the underlying prevents perfect hedging, leaving the risk-neutral measure non-unique.

concepts.name: q-optimal martingale measure
concepts.scope: The equivalent martingale measure minimising the q-th moment of the Radon-Nikodym derivative, used to select a canonical pricing measure in incomplete markets.

concepts.name: Utility indifference pricing
concepts.scope: A valuation approach determining option prices as the compensation that leaves the agent's expected utility unchanged with or without the derivative position.

concepts.name: Calibration to forward curve
concepts.scope: The process of adjusting model parameters so that model-implied forward prices match the observed market forward curve.

concepts.name: PIDE formulation
concepts.scope: A partial integro-differential equation characterising the option price under a jump-diffusion spot price model.

concepts.name: Markov switching model
concepts.scope: A spot price model that switches between a normal and a spiky regime according to a continuous-time Markov chain.

concepts.name: Supply-demand equilibrium model
concepts.scope: A structural electricity price model in which the spot price is implicitly determined by equating a stochastic demand process with a deterministic supply stack function.

concepts.name: Non-storability of electricity
concepts.scope: The physical constraint that electricity cannot be efficiently stored, making it a flow commodity and causing market incompleteness.

concepts.name: Base load price
concepts.scope: The arithmetic average spot price over all hours of a day, serving as the standard underlying for most electricity derivative contracts.

concepts.name: Parameter estimation for OU process
concepts.scope: Statistical calibration of mean-reversion speed and volatility parameters of the OU component from historical spot price time series.

concepts.name: Stochastic volatility model
concepts.scope: An equity or commodity model in which the diffusion coefficient is itself a stochastic process, used here as a reference setting for q-optimal measure theory.

concepts.name: Transform analysis
concepts.scope: Computation of characteristic or moment generating functions to obtain semi-analytic pricing formulas for derivatives under affine or exponential models.

concepts.name: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) mean-reversion process
concepts.scope: Continuous-time diffusion process used to model the base stochastic component of log electricity spot prices with mean reversion.

concepts.name: Spike process
concepts.scope: A separate jump-diffusion component with high mean-reversion rate capturing short-lived price spikes independently of the base OU process.

concepts.name: Compound Poisson jump process
concepts.scope: A Poisson-driven process with random jump sizes used to model sudden large deviations in electricity prices.

concepts.name: Seasonal component
concepts.scope: A deterministic function capturing yearly and weekly periodicity in log electricity prices, estimated via least-squares regression on Fourier terms.

concepts.name: Moment generating function of the spike process
concepts.scope: Closed-form expression for the MGF of the mean-reverting jump process, used to derive moments and approximate densities.

concepts.name: Truncated (approximated) spike process
concepts.scope: An approximation retaining only the last Poisson jump, whose distribution is analytically tractable and converges to the full spike process for large mean-reversion rates or small jump intensities.

concepts.name: Stationary distribution of the spike process
concepts.scope: Long-run limiting distribution of the spike process, approximated by a Gamma-like distribution for exponentially distributed jump sizes.

concepts.name: Incomplete electricity market
concepts.scope: A market setting where electricity cannot be stored or used to hedge, so no unique equivalent martingale measure exists from the underlying alone.

concepts.name: Equivalent martingale measure (risk-neutral measure)
concepts.scope: A probability measure under which discounted derivative prices are martingales, parameterised here by market prices of diffusion and jump risk.

concepts.name: Market price of diffusion risk
concepts.scope: A parameter function governing the Girsanov drift adjustment to the Brownian component of the OU process under the risk-neutral measure.

concepts.name: Market price of jump risk
concepts.scope: A parameter governing the change in Poisson process intensity between the physical and risk-neutral measures.

concepts.name: Forward curve consistency
concepts.scope: The requirement that the risk-neutral seasonal function is calibrated so that model-implied forward prices match observed market forward prices.

concepts.name: Exponential utility function
concepts.scope: A utility function with constant absolute risk aversion used to derive closed-form indifference prices and marginal price connections to expectation under a martingale measure.

concepts.name: Conditional expectation decomposition
concepts.scope: Analytical approximation for E[X_t | X_t + Y_t = c] used to separate the unobservable base and spike components given only the observable sum.

concepts.name: Demand-supply stack model
concepts.scope: A structural model where the spot price is determined by inverting a supply function at the level of a stochastic demand process.

concepts.name: Log-return distribution and heavy tails
concepts.scope: Empirical distributional property of de-seasonalised log electricity prices showing excess kurtosis attributed to non-constant volatility and spikes.

concepts.name: Iterative spike-filtering calibration
concepts.scope: A heuristic parameter estimation procedure that alternately fits OU parameters and removes outliers beyond a conditional standard-deviation threshold.

concepts.name: MGF-based option pricing (Duffie-Pan-Singleton)
concepts.scope: A Fourier-inversion formula expressing option payoff expectations in terms of the complex-valued moment generating function of the log price process.

concepts.name: Mixture approximation for the combined process density
concepts.scope: An approximation of the density of X_t + Y_t as a probability-weighted mixture of a Gaussian and a jump-shifted Gaussian component.

concepts.name: Lévy's Inversion Theorem
concepts.scope: Recovers the cumulative distribution function of a random variable from its moment generating function via an imaginary-axis integral.

concepts.name: Truncated moment generating function
concepts.scope: Defines the conditional expectation of an exponentially weighted indicator restricted to a half-line, used to decompose put option payoffs.

concepts.name: Laplace inversion for option pricing
concepts.scope: Prices European options by expressing the expected payoff as an inverse Laplace transform of the product of the payoff's Laplace transform and the MGF of the log-price.

concepts.name: Convolution theorem for option pricing
concepts.scope: Converts the expected payoff integral into a product in Laplace space, enabling efficient computation via inversion.

concepts.name: Black-76 formula
concepts.scope: A log-normal forward pricing formula used as the benchmark approximation for options on electricity forwards.

concepts.name: Term structure of implied volatility
concepts.scope: Describes how the Black-76 implied volatility varies with time to maturity, driven by diffusive and jump components of the spot model.

concepts.name: Implied volatility skew
concepts.scope: Captures the strike-dependence of implied volatility induced by the jump component's heavy-tailed distribution.

concepts.name: Log-normal moment-matching approximation
concepts.scope: Approximates the distribution of a forward with a delivery period by matching the first two moments to a log-normal, enabling Black-76 pricing.

concepts.name: Forward with delivery period
concepts.scope: An electricity forward delivering a flow commodity over an interval, priced as a weighted integral of single-delivery forwards.

concepts.name: Dynamic programming for swing options
concepts.scope: Recursively computes swing option value by choosing at each node between holding and exercising, working backward from the terminal condition.

concepts.name: Grid (non-tree) backward induction
concepts.scope: Extends tree-based dynamic programming to a full spatial grid to handle jump-induced heavy tails in the transition density.

concepts.name: Gaussian quadrature integration
concepts.scope: Approximates the conditional expectation integrals in the backward induction using three-point Gauss-Legendre weights on sub-intervals.

concepts.name: Dimension reduction for swing options
concepts.scope: Reduces the two-dimensional state space to one dimension by conditioning on the sum of the diffusion and spike factors given the observable spot price.

concepts.name: Partial integro-differential equation (PIDE)
concepts.scope: Characterises the no-arbitrage value of a contingent claim under a jump-diffusion spot model via the Feynman-Kac representation.

concepts.name: Diffusive delta-hedging in incomplete markets
concepts.scope: Hedges only the Brownian-motion component of option risk using a second derivative, leaving jump risk unhedged.

concepts.name: Minimal relative entropy measure
concepts.scope: The q=1 special case of q-optimal measures, minimising the Kullback-Leibler divergence from the physical measure.

concepts.name: Minimal martingale measure
concepts.scope: The equivalent martingale measure obtained by setting the market price of volatility risk to zero, coinciding with all q-optimal measures when the Sharpe ratio depends only on time.

concepts.name: Heston stochastic volatility model
concepts.scope: A mean-reverting variance model used to study q-optimal measure selection and its effect on European option prices and implied volatility smiles.

concepts.name: Implied volatility smile
concepts.scope: The strike profile of Black-Scholes implied volatility extracted from model option prices, shaped by correlation and volatility-of-volatility parameters.

concepts.name: Mean-reversion and spike two-factor spot model
concepts.scope: Represents the electricity spot price as the exponential of a diffusive Ornstein-Uhlenbeck factor plus a compound-Poisson spike factor.

concepts.name: Exponential jump size distribution
concepts.scope: Models spike magnitudes as exponentially distributed, giving analytically tractable moment generating functions and density approximations.

concepts.name: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) spot price model
concepts.scope: Mean-reverting log-price process used as the base model for electricity spot prices, with constant or time-varying parameters.

concepts.name: Exponential OU process
concepts.scope: Spot electricity price modelled as the exponential of a seasonal function plus an OU component, ensuring positive prices with mean reversion.

concepts.name: Jump-diffusion spot model
concepts.scope: Extension of the OU model incorporating a compound Poisson process to capture electricity price spikes.

concepts.name: Incomplete markets
concepts.scope: Market setting where electricity spot cannot be used to hedge derivatives, making the risk-neutral measure non-unique.

concepts.name: Equivalent martingale measure (EMM)
concepts.scope: Probability measure equivalent to the real-world measure under which discounted asset prices are martingales, used for arbitrage-free pricing.

concepts.name: q-optimal pricing measure
concepts.scope: Risk-neutral measure selected by minimising the q-norm of the Radon-Nikodym derivative, interpolating between minimal reverse entropy (q=0) and minimal relative entropy (q=1).

concepts.name: Market price of risk
concepts.scope: Process ψ parameterising the change of measure from the real-world to the risk-neutral measure via the Girsanov kernel.

concepts.name: Market price of volatility risk
concepts.scope: Component of the measure change associated with the untraded volatility factor in stochastic volatility models, shown to be time-inhomogeneous.

concepts.name: Implied volatility smile and skew
concepts.scope: Strike-dependent implied volatility surface extracted from option prices, used to compare pricing measures and diagnose model behaviour.

concepts.name: Forward curve consistency constraint
concepts.scope: Requirement that the pricing measure reproduces observed forward electricity prices as conditional expectations of the spot.

concepts.name: Bermudan option
concepts.scope: Option exercisable at a discrete set of dates, related to swing options via asymptotic expansions in the number of exercise rights.

concepts.name: Forward price formula for mean-reverting spot
concepts.scope: Closed-form expression for the expected spot price under Q when the log-price follows an OU process with seasonal drift.

concepts.name: Call option pricing on lognormal underlying
concepts.scope: Black-Scholes-type formula adapted for mean-reverting spot dynamics, with time-dependent effective variance.

concepts.name: Affine jump-diffusion transform analysis
concepts.scope: Method of Duffie-Pan-Singleton using exponential-affine ansatz to obtain the moment generating function of a jump-diffusion via ODEs.

concepts.name: Girsanov's theorem
concepts.scope: Result describing how the drift of a stochastic process changes under an equivalent probability measure defined by a Radon-Nikodym derivative.

concepts.name: Minimal reverse entropy measure
concepts.scope: EMM that minimises E[-ln(dQ/dP)], equivalent to minimising the expected squared market price of risk under P.

concepts.name: Speed of mean reversion (α)
concepts.scope: Parameter controlling how fast the OU process reverts to its long-term level, estimated from data and potentially re-calibrated under Q.

concepts.name: Seasonality function
concepts.scope: Deterministic time-dependent component of the log-spot price capturing periodic patterns in electricity prices.

concepts.name: Maximum likelihood estimation for OU processes
concepts.scope: Calibration procedure using the known Gaussian transition density of the OU process to estimate mean reversion, level and volatility from discrete observations.

concepts.name: Martingale estimation functions
concepts.scope: Alternative parameter estimation approach for discretely observed diffusions that yields analytic estimators without requiring the full likelihood.

concepts.name: Moment generating function (MGF) of jump-diffusion
concepts.scope: Exponential-affine function of the initial state obtained by solving a system of ODEs, used to price options via Fourier inversion.

concepts.name: Fourier inversion / Gil-Pelaez formula
concepts.scope: Numerical integration technique converting the complex-valued MGF into option prices or distribution functions.

concepts.name: Grid-based numerical option pricing
concepts.scope: Finite-difference or lattice method for path-dependent options, applied to swing contracts with spike dynamics.

concepts.name: Non-uniform spatial grids
concepts.scope: Grid generation technique concentrating mesh points near regions of interest (e.g. the strike) to improve PDE solver accuracy.

concepts.name: Stochastic volatility with correlation
concepts.scope: Model feature linking the asset price and variance innovations, producing skewed implied volatility smiles.

concepts.name: Fundamental theorem of asset pricing
concepts.scope: Equivalence between absence of arbitrage and existence of an equivalent martingale measure, underpinning all derivative pricing.

concepts.name: Risk-neutral valuation PDE
concepts.scope: Partial differential equation for the option price derived from the no-arbitrage condition when the underlying follows an Itô process.

concepts.name: Feynman-Kac formula
concepts.scope: Correspondence between conditional expectations under Q and solutions of the pricing PDE, linking probabilistic and PDE approaches.

concepts.name: Compensation of jump processes
concepts.scope: Technique subtracting the predictable compensator of a jump integral to obtain a martingale, used in deriving the MGF ODE.

concepts.name: Conditional expectations for normal and exponential random variables
concepts.scope: Closed-form results for E[X | X+Y=c] and truncated moments used analytically in spike and option pricing calculations.
