out_6.topic: Valuation of power swing options using spike-jump-diffusion models and state-space forest methods

concepts.name: Swing option
concepts.scope: A derivative bundled with a power forward that grants the holder flexible rights to adjust delivery volume and timing within contractual bounds.

concepts.name: Swing right
concepts.scope: An individual option-like entitlement within a swing contract allowing the holder to acquire or deliver an additional volume unit at specified strike prices.

concepts.name: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) process
concepts.scope: A mean-reverting continuous-time stochastic process used to model the core and spike components of power spot prices.

concepts.name: Spike-jump-diffusion model
concepts.scope: A spot price model combining a mean-reverting diffusion core with separate Poisson-driven OU processes for positive and negative price spikes.

concepts.name: Positive spike process
concepts.scope: A mean-reverting jump process driven by a Poisson subordinator capturing upward price anomalies that revert rapidly.

concepts.name: Negative spike process
concepts.scope: A separate mean-reverting jump process capturing downward price anomalies, calibrated independently from positive spikes.

concepts.name: Lévy driver
concepts.scope: A pure-jump process, such as a compound Poisson process, used to introduce discontinuous increments into the core OU diffusion.

concepts.name: Itô transformation
concepts.scope: A function applied to the latent stochastic process to produce either additive or geometric (log-normal) spot price dynamics.

concepts.name: Negative power prices
concepts.scope: Observed market prices below zero, requiring spot price models to move beyond standard exponential OU specifications.

concepts.name: Deterministic seasonality
concepts.scope: A decomposed time-varying drift capturing weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual periodic patterns in power prices.

concepts.name: State-space forest
concepts.scope: A multi-dimensional grid pricing structure composed of N+1 state-space trees, each representing the swing option value with a given number of remaining exercise rights.

concepts.name: State-space tree
concepts.scope: A collection of discretised state spaces over the option lifetime representing all possible process realisations at each time step.

concepts.name: Conditional density approximation
concepts.scope: An analytical approximation to the transition density of the underlying processes used to compute node-to-node transition probabilities in the pricing grid.

concepts.name: Truncated reversed spike process
concepts.scope: A time-reversed and truncated version of the spike OU process whose distribution is analytically tractable and used to approximate the spike conditional density.

concepts.name: Moment-generating function (MGF) of spike process
concepts.scope: A closed-form expression for the MGF of the truncated reversed spike process used to derive its moments and density approximation.

concepts.name: Upper incomplete gamma function
concepts.scope: A special function used to express the closed-form density of the truncated spike process under exponential jump-size distributions.

concepts.name: Exponential jump size distribution
concepts.scope: A symmetric exponential distribution used to model the heights of positive and negative spiky jumps in the spot price model.

concepts.name: Optimal multiple stopping
concepts.scope: The mathematical framework governing the exercise strategy of a swing option as a sequence of optimal stopping decisions.

concepts.name: Least squares Monte Carlo (LSMC)
concepts.scope: A simulation-based pricing method for path-dependent derivatives that estimates continuation values via regression, applicable to swing options.

concepts.name: Recovery time
concepts.scope: A contractual minimum waiting period that must elapse between consecutive swing exercise actions.

concepts.name: Swing payoff structure
concepts.scope: The specification of acquisition and delivery payoffs for swing rights including price boundaries that cap the writer's exposure to large price moves.

concepts.name: Marginal value of swing rights
concepts.scope: The incremental option value added by each additional swing exercise right, which is concave and decreasing in the number of rights.

concepts.name: Jump risk premium
concepts.scope: The additional option value attributable to the presence of price spikes, quantified as the difference between swing option prices with and without jump components.

concepts.name: American option strip
concepts.scope: A benchmark replication strategy for a swing option consisting of a series of identical American options whose aggregate cost exceeds the swing option price.

concepts.name: Model calibration via jump filtering
concepts.scope: A sequential procedure that detects and separates positive spikes, negative spikes and non-spiky jumps from historical price data before fitting each process component.

concepts.name: Running sample volatility filter
concepts.scope: A statistical tool used during calibration to identify price jumps as outliers beyond a confidence threshold in the transformed price series.

concepts.name: Fourier seasonality decomposition
concepts.scope: Calibration of annual and semi-annual periodic price components using Fourier frequencies fitted to the log-transformed price series.

concepts.name: Sinh Itô transform
concepts.scope: An alternative transformation that can accommodate negative spot prices within a stochastic spot price model.

methods: Convolution of jump-size and attenuation densities
Sequential jump filtering via running volatility
Backward induction dynamic programming on grid
implied_prerequisites: Poisson processes and compound Poisson processes
Markov chain and transition probability theory
Power market microstructure and forward contracts

swing_last.topic: Swing option valuation in energy markets

concepts.name: Swing option
concepts.scope: A flexibility-of-delivery contract granting the holder multiple rights to take greater or smaller energy volumes subject to daily and periodic constraints.

concepts.name: Take-or-pay contract
concepts.scope: A supply agreement requiring the buyer to pay for a minimum volume of commodity whether or not it is actually taken.

concepts.name: Local-effect exercise right
concepts.scope: A swing right whose volume modification applies only on the date of exercise, reverting to base-load thereafter.

concepts.name: Global-effect exercise right
concepts.scope: A swing right whose volume modification persists from the exercise date until the next exercise or contract expiry.

concepts.name: Refraction period
concepts.scope: A mandatory waiting interval between consecutive exercise of swing rights specified in the contract.

concepts.name: Bang-bang exercise
concepts.scope: Optimal swing exercise at extreme allowable volume levels when no penalty on total consumption is present.

concepts.name: Penalty function
concepts.scope: A contractual payoff term assessed at expiry for total cumulative delivery falling outside specified minimum or maximum bounds.

concepts.name: Dynamic programming for swing options
concepts.scope: Backward-induction valuation over three state dimensions—price, exercise rights remaining, and cumulative usage—to price swing contracts.

concepts.name: Trinomial forest
concepts.scope: A multi-layer extension of the trinomial tree in which each layer corresponds to a distinct number of remaining exercise rights and usage level.

concepts.name: One-factor mean-reverting price model
concepts.scope: A commodity spot price model driven by a single Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process for the deseasonalized log-price.

concepts.name: Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process
concepts.scope: A continuous-time stochastic process with drift toward a long-run mean, used here for the logarithm of the deseasonalized energy spot price.

concepts.name: Seasonality factor
concepts.scope: A deterministic multiplicative function of calendar time capturing periodic patterns in energy spot prices.

concepts.name: Deseasonalized spot price
concepts.scope: The commodity price series obtained by dividing the spot price by the deterministic seasonality factor to isolate the stochastic component.

concepts.name: Risk-neutral measure
concepts.scope: The equivalent martingale measure under which discounted prices of traded instruments are martingales, used as the pricing measure throughout.

concepts.name: Convenience yield
concepts.scope: A derived quantity reflecting the benefit of holding physical inventory, linked here to limited substitutability of energy across time.

concepts.name: Forward price under mean reversion
concepts.scope: The risk-neutral expectation of the future spot price under the one-factor model, yielding a closed-form term structure expression.

concepts.name: Black's formula
concepts.scope: A closed-form pricing expression for European options on futures assuming log-normally distributed futures prices.

concepts.name: Implied volatility term structure
concepts.scope: The relationship between option-implied volatility and time to expiration, declining as T^{-1/2} under mean reversion.

concepts.name: Hull-White trinomial tree
concepts.scope: A discrete-time lattice construction that matches initial forward curves and accommodates mean reversion via non-standard branching.

concepts.name: Model calibration to futures and options
concepts.scope: Estimation of model parameters by minimising pricing errors relative to observed forward curves and implied volatilities.

concepts.name: Bermudan option
concepts.scope: An option exercisable on a discrete set of dates, providing the upper bound for a single-right swing option.

concepts.name: European option strip
concepts.scope: A collection of European options on individual exercise dates, providing the lower bound for a swing option value.

concepts.name: Homogeneity of swing value
concepts.scope: The property that the swing option value scales linearly with price level and with volume quantities under suitable penalty structures.

concepts.name: Optimal exercise threshold
concepts.scope: The critical spot price level at or above which immediate exercise of a swing right is optimal, studied for uniqueness under various dynamics.

concepts.name: Weak convergence of numerical scheme
concepts.scope: The mathematical guarantee that trinomial-tree swing prices converge to their continuous-time counterparts as the time step tends to zero.

methods: Hull-White trinomial tree construction with displacement shifts
Black's formula for European options on futures
implied_prerequisites: Risk-neutral pricing and equivalent martingale measures
Energy market structure and natural gas futures
Numerical methods for PDEs and lattices

111102_collector.topic: Practical valuation of power derivatives: energy swaps and swaptions in the Nordic electricity market

concepts.name: Power swap vs. forward distinction
concepts.scope: Covers why exchange-traded Nordic electricity 'forwards' are structurally swaps with daily financial settlement against spot, not true forwards.

concepts.name: Swap present-value discounting
concepts.scope: Covers the correct discounting of power swap cash flows to obtain contract value distinct from the quoted market price.

concepts.name: Forward-start interest swap rate
concepts.scope: Covers the use of the forward-starting rate spanning the delivery period as the relevant discount rate for power swap valuation.

concepts.name: Geometric Brownian motion applied to power forwards
concepts.scope: Covers the justification for modelling quarterly and annual power swap returns as GBM given empirical return distributions closer to normal than spot returns.

concepts.name: Black-76 model for power options
concepts.scope: Covers application of the Black (1976) formula to European options on power forwards/swaps and its role as market standard at Nord Pool.

concepts.name: Adjusted delta for swap-hedged power options
concepts.scope: Covers the modification of the Black-76 delta required when the hedging instrument is a power swap rather than a forward expiring at option maturity.

concepts.name: Energy swaption (option on power swap)
concepts.scope: Covers the contract structure where exercise delivers the underlying swap at the strike price, generating payoff spread over the delivery period.

concepts.name: Energy swaption pricing formula
concepts.scope: Covers the closed-form modification of Black-76 that discounts expected payoff to account for deferred swap delivery cash flows.

concepts.name: Put-call parity for energy swaptions
concepts.scope: Covers the no-arbitrage relationship between call and put swaption prices and the implied synthetic swap forward price.

concepts.name: Swaption Greeks (delta, gamma, vega, rho)
concepts.scope: Covers analytical sensitivity formulas for energy swaption value with respect to underlying price, volatility, and interest rates.

concepts.name: Volatility smile and fat tails in power markets
concepts.scope: Covers the empirical observation of leptokurtic return distributions and the practitioner practice of applying a volatility smile to fudge the Black-Scholes-Merton model.

concepts.name: SABR stochastic volatility model
concepts.scope: Covers the SABR model as an extension accommodating stochastic volatility via two additional parameters for use in power derivatives markets.

concepts.name: Jump-diffusion models for power prices
concepts.scope: Covers the rationale for incorporating price jumps, potentially combined with stochastic volatility, when modelling electricity price dynamics.

concepts.name: Spot price seasonality and mean reversion
concepts.scope: Covers the statistical properties of electricity spot returns including seasonality, mean reversion, and extreme kurtosis and their implications for forward pricing.

concepts.name: Strip of forwards vs. annual swap arbitrage
concepts.scope: Covers the no-arbitrage condition requiring a strip of seasonal or quarterly swaps to equal the value of an annual swap after correct discounting.

concepts.name: Continuous approximation for swap value
concepts.scope: Covers a continuously-compounded discount-rate approximation that simplifies power swap present-value calculation while maintaining accuracy.

methods: Discounted cash flow analysis of swap settlements
Delta hedging with adjustment for swap underlying
implied_prerequisites: Interest rate discounting and zero-coupon rates

analytical_valuation_in_mean_reverting_w.topic: Analytical Valuation of Full Requirements Contracts in Mean-Reverting Electricity Markets

concepts.name: Full Requirements Contract
concepts.scope: A power supply agreement where the seller is sole provider at a fixed price per unit and the customer cannot resell received power.

concepts.name: Geometric Mean-Reverting Process
concepts.scope: A stochastic process for positive-valued variables such as power prices or temperature where the log-price reverts to a time-dependent equilibrium mean.

concepts.name: Mean-Reverting Process (arithmetic)
concepts.scope: An Ornstein-Uhlenbeck-type process for real-valued variables such as temperature reverting to a time-dependent equilibrium mean.

concepts.name: Risk-Neutral Dynamics
concepts.scope: The probability measure under which discounted asset prices are martingales, used here to price contingent claims by discounted expectation.

concepts.name: European Contingent Claim on Power and Temperature
concepts.scope: A derivative whose payout at expiry depends jointly on the spot power price and a temperature index.

concepts.name: Effective Volatility
concepts.scope: A time-aggregated volatility parameter that summarises the integrated variance of a mean-reverting process over a valuation interval.

concepts.name: Effective Correlation
concepts.scope: A time-aggregated correlation parameter between two mean-reverting processes over a valuation interval.

concepts.name: Load Structure
concepts.scope: A family of time-indexed load functions mapping a random state variable (temperature or load) to customer power demand at each delivery time.

concepts.name: Load Function
concepts.scope: A deterministic function mapping the random state variable to the quantity of power demanded by a customer at a given delivery time.

concepts.name: Strip of European Contingent Claims
concepts.scope: Representation of a full requirements contract as a sum of European claims with payouts at each delivery date in the contract's delivery schedule.

concepts.name: Eigenclaim / Spectral Method
concepts.scope: An analytical pricing technique that expands contingent claim values in terms of eigenfunctions of the pricing operator to obtain closed-form solutions.

concepts.name: Power Function Payout
concepts.scope: A payout structure that is a power (monomial) function of the state variable, enabling analytical reduction of joint claims to univariate temperature claims.

concepts.name: Equilibrium Mean
concepts.scope: The time-dependent level to which a mean-reverting process is attracted, entering the long-run drift of the stochastic differential equation.

concepts.name: Mean-Reversion Rate
concepts.scope: The speed parameter governing how quickly a mean-reverting process returns toward its equilibrium mean after a deviation.

concepts.name: Fair Fixed Price (Break-even Strike)
concepts.scope: The fixed price per unit of power at which the inception value of the full requirements contract equals zero.

concepts.name: Correlated Wiener Processes
concepts.scope: A pair or triple of Brownian motions with time-dependent instantaneous correlations used to model joint dynamics of power price and temperature.

concepts.name: Power Price with Spikes
concepts.scope: An extension of the mean-reverting price model that incorporates non-Markovian spike behaviour observed in electricity spot prices.

methods: Discounted risk-neutral expectation for European claim pricing
Reduction of joint power-temperature claims to univariate temperature claims
Analytical integration for effective volatility and correlation parameters
Exponential payout decomposition for arithmetic mean-reverting temperature
Break-even fixed-price solving from zero-NPV condition
Limiting argument (mean-reversion rate to zero) to recover Brownian motion / GBM cases
implied_prerequisites: Stochastic differential equations and Ito calculus
Risk-neutral pricing and change of measure
Basic derivative pricing theory (European options, discounted expectations)
Electricity market structure and power derivatives
Linear algebra and functional analysis (operator/spectral methods)

concepts.name: Real option to invest
concepts.scope: The right but not obligation to invest in a CCGT plant modelled as an American-style option over the licence period.

concepts.name: Option to delay investment
concepts.scope: The value of postponing an irreversible capital commitment until conditions are more favourable.

concepts.name: Spark spread
concepts.scope: The difference between the electricity price and the heat-rate-adjusted cost of natural gas per MWh produced.

concepts.name: Spark spread forward curve
concepts.scope: A term structure of forward spark spread prices constructed from electricity and natural gas futures contracts.

concepts.name: Arithmetic Brownian motion (ABM)
concepts.scope: A one-factor stochastic process for spark spread that permits negative values and implies a linear forward curve.

concepts.name: One-factor mean-reverting process
concepts.scope: A single-factor Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process for spark spread capturing short-run reversion to a long-run equilibrium level.

concepts.name: Two-factor mean-reverting model
concepts.scope: A stochastic model combining short-term mean reversion in spark spread with a long-term drifting equilibrium level.

concepts.name: Spanning asset
concepts.scope: A traded financial instrument whose risk tracks that of a non-traded commodity, enabling contingent-claims valuation.

concepts.name: Net present value (NPV) of the project
concepts.scope: The present value of expected cash flows from the CCGT plant minus the sunk investment cost.

concepts.name: Investment trigger
concepts.scope: The spark spread level at which the NPV of investing equals the option value of waiting, defining the optimal exercise boundary.

concepts.name: Exercise boundary
concepts.scope: The time-dependent threshold in the state variable space above which immediate investment is optimal.

concepts.name: CO2 quota cost
concepts.scope: An additional operating cost per MWh reflecting the expected market price of emission allowances under the Kyoto framework.

concepts.name: Take-or-pay (TOP) contract
concepts.scope: A long-term natural gas supply contract requiring the buyer to pay for a minimum contracted volume regardless of offtake.

concepts.name: Heat rate
concepts.scope: The ratio of natural gas energy input to electrical energy output, used to convert gas prices into electricity-equivalent costs.

concepts.name: Base load operation
concepts.scope: A plant operating strategy of running at maximum available capacity continuously rather than cycling with demand.

concepts.name: Forward curve construction
concepts.scope: The process of synthesising long-dated annual spark spread forwards from shorter-maturity exchange-traded contracts using swap-pricing methods.

concepts.name: Contingent claims analysis
concepts.scope: A valuation approach that prices an asset by constructing a replicating portfolio of traded securities to eliminate arbitrage.

concepts.name: Risk-neutral drift
concepts.scope: The drift parameter of the underlying process under the risk-neutral measure used in contingent-claims pricing.

concepts.name: Availability factor
concepts.scope: The fraction of hours per year a power plant is operationally available, determining effective annual generation.

concepts.name: CCGT thermodynamic efficiency
concepts.scope: The ratio of electrical output to natural gas energy input for a combined-cycle gas turbine plant.

concepts.name: Real options – option to invest
concepts.scope: The right but not obligation to invest in a CCGT plant, valued as a financial option to capture optimal investment timing.

concepts.name: Infinite-horizon investment option
concepts.scope: A perpetual option to invest whose value satisfies an ODE with value-matching and smooth-pasting boundary conditions.

concepts.name: Finite-horizon investment option
concepts.scope: A time-limited investment option whose value satisfies a PDE and requires numerical methods such as binomial or trinomial trees.

concepts.name: One-factor mean-reversion model
concepts.scope: A single-factor Ornstein-Uhlenbeck process for spark spread that reverts to a long-run level, following Lucia and Schwartz (2002).

concepts.name: Two-factor mean-reversion model
concepts.scope: A model decomposing spark spread into a short-term mean-reverting component and a long-term arithmetic Brownian motion component, following Lucia and Schwartz (2002).

concepts.name: Forward curve / term structure of spark spread
concepts.scope: The market-implied expected future spark spread prices at various maturities, used to calibrate model parameters and assess investment profitability.

concepts.name: Investment trigger / exercise boundary
concepts.scope: The critical spark spread level at which immediate investment is optimal, analogous to the early-exercise boundary of an American option.

concepts.name: Value-matching and smooth-pasting conditions
concepts.scope: Boundary conditions requiring continuity of option value and its derivative at the exercise threshold for the perpetual investment option.

concepts.name: Binomial tree
concepts.scope: A Cox-Ross-Rubinstein lattice discretising the ABM spark spread process to numerically value the finite investment option.

concepts.name: Trinomial tree
concepts.scope: A Hull-White recombining three-branch lattice used to discretise the mean-reverting spark spread process for finite option valuation.

concepts.name: Least Squares Monte Carlo (LSM)
concepts.scope: A Longstaff-Schwartz simulation method that approximates the continuation value of an American option by cross-sectional regression along simulated paths.

concepts.name: Mean-reversion coefficient (κ)
concepts.scope: The speed at which the spark spread reverts toward its long-run level in the one- and two-factor models.

concepts.name: Half-life of mean reversion
concepts.scope: The time for a spark spread deviation to revert halfway to the long-run mean, defined as ln(2)/κ.

concepts.name: Market price of risk (λ)
concepts.scope: The risk-adjustment parameter linking the real-world drift to the risk-neutral drift used in no-arbitrage pricing of spark spread derivatives.

concepts.name: Risk-neutral pricing / no-arbitrage
concepts.scope: The pricing framework under which derivative values are computed as discounted expected payoffs under the equivalent martingale measure.

concepts.name: CO2 emission cost
concepts.scope: The per-tonne cost of carbon dioxide quotas that enters the operating cost of the CCGT plant and affects investment feasibility.

concepts.name: Net present value (NPV) of investment
concepts.scope: The present value of expected future spark spread revenues minus investment and operating costs, used as the exercise payoff of the investment option.

concepts.name: Parameter estimation via RMSE minimisation
concepts.scope: Calibration of model parameters by minimising the root mean square error between model-implied and observed forward prices.

concepts.name: Constructed forward curve
concepts.scope: A proxy long-dated spark spread forward curve built from no-arbitrage conditions linking short-dated and long-dated contracts.

concepts.name: Alternative branching in trinomial tree
concepts.scope: Modified up/middle/down branching at extreme nodes (jmax, jmin) that ensures non-negative probabilities under strong mean reversion.

concepts.name: Real option
concepts.scope: The right but not obligation to invest in a power plant asset, valued using option-pricing techniques.

concepts.name: American option
concepts.scope: An option exercisable at any time before expiry, used here to model the irreversible investment decision.

concepts.name: Mean reversion
concepts.scope: The tendency of commodity prices to revert toward a long-run equilibrium level, captured in the single-factor stochastic process.

concepts.name: Two-factor price model
concepts.scope: A stochastic model decomposing spot price into a mean-reverting short-term deviation and a drifting long-term component.

concepts.name: Monte Carlo simulation
concepts.scope: Simulation of multiple price paths used together with the Longstaff-Schwartz least-squares method to value the American investment option.

concepts.name: Least-squares Monte Carlo (Longstaff-Schwartz)
concepts.scope: A regression-based algorithm for approximating the continuation value in American option pricing via simulation.

concepts.name: Project value (DCF of operating cash flows)
concepts.scope: The present value of future revenues minus operating costs over the plant lifetime, used as the underlying asset value.

concepts.name: Early exercise boundary
concepts.scope: The threshold spark-spread level at which immediate investment dominates holding the option.

concepts.name: CO2 emission quota / certificate cost
concepts.scope: The cost of carbon allowances under an emissions-trading scheme, modelled as a per-MWh deduction from plant revenues.

concepts.name: Hull-White interest rate / lattice model
concepts.scope: A single-factor mean-reverting model and associated trinomial lattice calibration procedure adapted here for commodity price dynamics.

concepts.name: CCGT plant economics
concepts.scope: Capital cost, O&M cost structure, thermal efficiency, availability, and degradation parameters for combined-cycle gas turbine plants.

concepts.name: Irreversibility of investment
concepts.scope: The sunk-cost nature of capital expenditure that creates option value from waiting before committing.

concepts.name: CHP (combined heat and power)
concepts.scope: A plant configuration that co-generates electricity and process steam, considered as an alternative CCGT design.

concepts.name: Plant availability and RAM
concepts.scope: Reliability, availability, and maintainability metrics that affect the effective operating hours used in cash-flow valuation.

concepts.name: NOx emission cost
concepts.scope: A per-MWh cost charge for nitrogen oxide emissions treated as an operating cost deduction.

concepts.name: Two-factor electricity price model
concepts.scope: Electricity spot price decomposed into a mean-reverting short-term deviation and a long-term arithmetic Brownian motion component.

concepts.name: Mean-reverting process
concepts.scope: Short-term price factor modelled as an Ornstein-Uhlenbeck discrete-time process with speed of reversion kappa.

concepts.name: Arithmetic Brownian motion
concepts.scope: Long-term price factor modelled as an ABM with drift, correlated with the mean-reverting component.

concepts.name: Exercise value of investment option
concepts.scope: Net present value of CCGT operating cash flows minus investment cost, computed analytically given current state variables.

concepts.name: Price of risk
concepts.scope: Risk-adjustment parameter (alfa) applied to the short-term factor when computing risk-neutral expected revenues.

concepts.name: Equivalent annual operating hours
concepts.scope: Parameter E representing the effective number of full-load hours per year used to scale revenue in the valuation formula.

concepts.name: Weighted dummy price
concepts.scope: Composite scalar formed by weighting X and epsilon by their respective coefficients c1 and c2 to reduce two state variables to one for regression.

concepts.name: Longstaff-Schwartz least-squares Monte Carlo
concepts.scope: American option pricing algorithm that estimates the continuation value by regressing discounted payoffs on basis functions of the state variable.

concepts.name: Polynomial regression for continuation value
concepts.scope: Cubic polynomial fitted by polyfit to approximate the value-of-waiting function across in-the-money paths.

concepts.name: Correlated simulation
concepts.scope: Technique for drawing correlated normal random variates to reproduce the specified correlation between the two price factors.

concepts.name: Operating costs and insurance
concepts.scope: Fixed and variable running costs (opcost, insure) deducted when computing the CCGT exercise value.

concepts.name: Carbon and certificate costs
concepts.scope: Clean and certificate charges per MWh incorporated as negative revenue adjustments in the exercise value function.

concepts.name: European option benchmark
concepts.scope: Expected discounted terminal payoff computed at option maturity as a reference value against the American option price.

concepts.name: Discount factor
concepts.scope: Continuous-time exponential discounting applied to move option payoffs back to the valuation date across simulation paths.

methods: Ordinary differential equation (ODE) solution for infinite-horizon option
Least squares regression for parameter estimation
Swap-pricing formula for forward curve construction
ODE solution for perpetual real option (value-matching and smooth-pasting)
PDE formulation for finite-horizon real options
Least Squares Monte Carlo (Longstaff-Schwartz) for American options
OLS regression on discrete AR(1) spark spread process
Forward curve construction via no-arbitrage swap conditions
Polynomial regression for continuation value approximation
Monte Carlo simulation with Longstaff-Schwartz least-squares regression
Discounted cash flow (analytic project value formula)
MATLAB implementation of trinomial lattice and Monte Carlo
Least-squares Monte Carlo (Longstaff-Schwartz) for American option pricing
Cubic polynomial regression (polyfit) for continuation value approximation
Analytical NPV integration for exercise value
Monte Carlo averaging with path-wise early-exercise override
implied_prerequisites: Discounted cash flow and NPV analysis
Electricity and natural gas market structure
Risk-neutral pricing and equivalent martingale measures
American and European option pricing theory
Time series regression and autoregressive models
Basic energy market mechanics (electricity and natural gas)
Binomial and trinomial option pricing trees
Risk-neutral valuation and change of measure

concepts.name: Spread option
concepts.scope: An option whose payoff depends on the difference between two underlying asset prices.

concepts.name: Kirk's approximation
concepts.scope: A closed-form approximation for pricing spread options by reducing the two-asset problem to a single-asset Black-Scholes framework.

concepts.name: Equivalent volatility
concepts.scope: A composite volatility parameter that captures the joint uncertainty of two correlated assets in a spread option formula.

concepts.name: Margrabe's formula
concepts.scope: An exact closed-form formula for pricing exchange options (zero-strike spread options) under lognormal dynamics.

concepts.name: Bjerksund-Stensland approximation
concepts.scope: An extension of Kirk's formula that provides an improved spread option approximation accounting for correlation structure.

concepts.name: Li-Deng-Zhou formula
concepts.scope: An analytical approximation for spread option pricing that refines the equivalent volatility to better reflect inter-asset correlation.

concepts.name: Correlation between underlying assets
concepts.scope: The linear dependence parameter between two asset price processes that directly enters spread option valuation formulas.

concepts.name: Delta of a spread option
concepts.scope: The sensitivity of a spread option's price to changes in each of the two underlying asset prices.

concepts.name: Lognormal asset dynamics
concepts.scope: The assumption that each underlying asset follows geometric Brownian motion, underpinning closed-form spread option approximations.

concepts.name: Spark spread / commodity spread
concepts.scope: The difference between electricity prices and fuel costs, commonly structured as a spread option in power markets.

implied_prerequisites: Correlation and covariance in multi-asset models

gav.topic: Short-term power plant valuation with unit-commitment constraints using real options

concepts.name: Real options for power plant valuation
concepts.scope: Treating the operator's hourly on/off decision as a sequence of real options on the spark spread to determine asset value.

concepts.name: Spark spread
concepts.scope: The net payoff per MWh defined as electricity price minus the product of heat rate and fuel price.

concepts.name: Unit commitment constraints
concepts.scope: Physical intertemporal constraints including minimum uptime, minimum downtime, and startup/shutdown lead times that restrict when a generator may switch states.

concepts.name: Minimum uptime and downtime
concepts.scope: Requirements that once a thermal unit is switched on or off it must remain in that state for a minimum number of periods.

concepts.name: State-transition dynamics
concepts.scope: A finite state-space representation tracking how long a unit has been continuously online or offline to enforce commitment constraints.

concepts.name: Startup and shutdown costs
concepts.scope: Costs incurred when toggling a thermal unit, where startup cost depends on boiler cooling state following an exponential cooling model.

concepts.name: Heat rate function
concepts.scope: A quadratic input-output characteristic relating fuel consumption in MMBtu to generation output in MW.

concepts.name: No-load cost
concepts.scope: The fixed fuel cost component of the heat rate function representing fuel consumed to keep the boiler running at zero net output.

concepts.name: Multistage stochastic programming
concepts.scope: Formulation of the sequential commitment decision problem under price uncertainty across multiple hourly stages.

concepts.name: Indifference locus
concepts.scope: The set of electricity-fuel price pairs at which the expected value of committing the unit on equals the expected value of keeping it off for a given state and time.

concepts.name: Geometric mean-reverting price process
concepts.scope: An Ito process for commodity prices incorporating mean reversion, lognormality, and seasonal drift used to model both electricity and fuel prices.

concepts.name: Mean reversion
concepts.scope: The tendency of commodity prices to be pulled back toward a long-run seasonal level, parameterised by a speed-of-reversion coefficient.

concepts.name: Ramp rate constraints
concepts.scope: Limits on the rate of change of generator output between successive online periods that restrict dispatch flexibility.

concepts.name: Optimal dispatch
concepts.scope: Real-time selection of generation level within capacity bounds to maximise hourly profit given current prices, yielding an analytical closed-form solution.

concepts.name: Backward dynamic programming recursion
concepts.scope: Bellman-equation-based backward induction over time periods to embed optimal future decisions into the current valuation.

concepts.name: Forward Monte Carlo simulation
concepts.scope: Forward-in-time simulation of price paths used to evaluate expected payoffs and locate indifference loci for each state.

concepts.name: Analytical upper bound
concepts.scope: A relaxed version of the valuation problem with no commitment constraints that yields a tractable European spark-spread call formula serving as an upper bound.

concepts.name: Financial options approach to generation valuation
concepts.scope: Existing literature methods that value a plant as a strip of European call options on the spark spread, ignoring physical operational constraints.

concepts.name: Spinning reserve market
concepts.scope: An ancillary-service market where residual online capacity below maximum rating can be sold as standby generation, augmenting energy revenue.

concepts.name: Risk-neutral vs. actual price processes
concepts.scope: Distinction between market-implied risk-neutral dynamics used for derivative pricing and historical actual dynamics used here for operational valuation.

concepts.name: Maximum likelihood estimation for price processes
concepts.scope: Statistical procedure for fitting mean-reversion speed, long-run mean, and volatility parameters of log-price processes to historical data.

concepts.name: Correlated commodity prices
concepts.scope: Modelling of instantaneous correlation between electricity and fuel price innovations through correlated Wiener processes.

concepts.name: Spark spread options
concepts.scope: Options whose payoff depends on the spread between electricity and fuel prices, used to value generation assets.

concepts.name: Path-dependent options
concepts.scope: Options whose value depends on the history of the underlying price path, requiring simulation-based pricing methods.

concepts.name: Generation asset valuation
concepts.scope: Techniques for determining the economic value of power generation units using financial and operational models.

concepts.name: Unit commitment
concepts.scope: Operational optimisation problem determining which generating units to bring online over a scheduling horizon subject to technical constraints.

concepts.name: Ramp constraints
concepts.scope: Technical limits on the rate at which a generation unit can increase or decrease output, affecting short-term scheduling.

concepts.name: Nodal prices and transmission rights
concepts.scope: Locational marginal pricing framework and associated financial instruments for managing congestion in power networks.

concepts.name: Two-factor price lattices
concepts.scope: Discrete-time tree models incorporating two stochastic factors to value generation assets under electricity price uncertainty.

concepts.name: Options on futures spreads
concepts.scope: Derivative instruments written on the difference between two futures prices, used for hedging and speculation in commodity markets.

concepts.name: Stochastic differential equations
concepts.scope: Continuous-time mathematical framework for modelling the random evolution of commodity prices underpinning derivative valuation.

concepts.name: Natural gas power asset hedging
concepts.scope: Application of financial options theory to quantify and manage the price risk embedded in gas-fired generation assets.

methods: Root-finding / curve-fitting for indifference locus identification
State-space discretisation for exact ramp-constraint treatment
Analytical upper-bound derivation via constraint relaxation
implied_prerequisites: Financial options theory (European and American options)
Power system operations and unit commitment

non_markov_method.topic: Non-Markovian electricity price modelling with spikes and European contingent claim valuation

concepts.name: Self-reversing jumps
concepts.scope: Spikes modelled as multiplicative or additive jumps that revert autonomously, superimposed on a regular-regime price process.

concepts.name: Non-Markovian price process
concepts.scope: A stochastic process for electricity prices where the spike state introduces path-dependence not captured by any Markov process.

concepts.name: Two-state continuous-time Markov process
concepts.scope: An underlying Markov chain governing transitions between the regular and spike regimes of electricity prices.

concepts.name: Transition matrix
concepts.scope: A 2×2 stochastic matrix whose entries give the probabilities of moving between spike and regular states over a time interval.

concepts.name: Generator matrix
concepts.scope: A 2×2 matrix characterising the instantaneous transition rates of the two-state Markov process between spike and regular regimes.

concepts.name: Kolmogorov-Chapman equation
concepts.scope: A semigroup consistency condition satisfied by the transition matrix of the underlying Markov regime-switching process.

concepts.name: Decomposition of transition probabilities
concepts.scope: A splitting of spike-state transition probabilities into a continuous-residence component and a component involving at least one visit to the regular state.

concepts.name: Spike magnitude distribution
concepts.scope: A conditional probability distribution on (1,∞) describing the random multiplicative size of a spike at each point in time.

concepts.name: Expected spike lifetime
concepts.scope: The mean duration a price process remains in the spike state, equal to the reciprocal of the spike-to-regular transition rate.

concepts.name: Expected inter-spike duration
concepts.scope: The mean time the process spends in the regular state between consecutive spikes, equal to the reciprocal of the regular-to-spike transition rate.

concepts.name: Characteristic spike lifetime
concepts.scope: A dimensionless ratio of mean spike lifetime to mean inter-spike lifetime used to parameterise the short-lived, rare-spike asymptotic regime.

concepts.name: European contingent claim on electricity without spikes
concepts.scope: A standard derivative whose value is the discounted risk-neutral expected payout under the regular-regime price process alone.

concepts.name: European contingent claim on electricity with spikes
concepts.scope: A derivative valued by decomposing the non-Markovian spike dynamics into a portfolio of regular-regime contingent claims weighted by regime-transition probabilities.

concepts.name: Payout translation operator
concepts.scope: An operator that rescales a contingent claim's payout function by the spike magnitude, mapping g(s) to g(λs).

concepts.name: Short-lived and rare spike approximation
concepts.scope: A first-order perturbative correction to the no-spike contingent claim value, valid when the characteristic spike lifetime is small.

concepts.name: Dynamic hedging under spike dynamics
concepts.scope: Replication of a spiked-electricity contingent claim as a portfolio of regular-regime contingent claims, assuming claims are written on forward rather than spot prices.

concepts.name: Product integral
concepts.scope: A generalisation of the matrix exponential used to express the transition matrix when the generator matrices at different times do not commute.

concepts.name: Time-homogeneous Markov process
concepts.scope: A special case where generator entries are constant, yielding transition probabilities that depend only on the length of the time interval.

methods: Two-state continuous-time Markov chain for regime switching
Matrix exponential and product integral for transition matrix computation
Decomposition of transition probabilities into path components
Risk-neutral pricing via discounted expected payout
Perturbation expansion in characteristic spike lifetime
Parametric and non-parametric estimation of spike parameters from historical data
Portfolio replication of spiked claims using regular-regime claims
implied_prerequisites: Continuous-time Markov chains and generator matrices
Risk-neutral pricing and equivalent martingale measures

value_ccgt.topic: CCGT valuation under price uncertainty and operational constraints

concepts.name: Clean spark spread (CSS)
concepts.scope: The per-unit contribution margin of a gas-fired plant defined as the electricity price minus heat-rate-weighted gas and carbon costs.

concepts.name: Market heat rate
concepts.scope: The ratio of electricity price to (carbon-adjusted) gas price used as a proxy for the marginal generator's efficiency.

concepts.name: Combined cycle gas turbine (CCGT) operational constraints
concepts.scope: Physical limits on plant operation including ramp times, minimum/maximum output, startup costs, and temperature-dependent restart requirements.

concepts.name: Real options valuation of power plants
concepts.scope: Application of option-pricing theory to capture the value of operational flexibility in switching a generation asset on or off.

concepts.name: Least Squares Monte Carlo (LSM) algorithm
concepts.scope: A simulation-based dynamic programming method that approximates continuation value via least-squares regression to solve optimal stopping and switching problems.

concepts.name: Basis function selection in LSM
concepts.scope: The choice of regressors (e.g., power functions, Laguerre polynomials, univariate spread vs. multivariate prices) used in the LSM continuation-value regression and its impact on value estimates.

concepts.name: Co-integration of energy prices
concepts.scope: The long-run equilibrium relationship linking electricity, natural gas, and carbon allowance prices that prevents them from drifting apart indefinitely.

concepts.name: Vector error-correction model (VECM)
concepts.scope: A multivariate time-series model that represents co-integrated price dynamics by separating short-run adjustments from long-run equilibrium corrections.

concepts.name: Johansen trace test
concepts.scope: A likelihood-ratio procedure for determining the number of co-integrating relationships among a set of integrated variables.

concepts.name: Constant conditional correlation GARCH (CCC-GARCH)
concepts.scope: A multivariate volatility model where individual series follow GARCH processes and cross-series correlations are held constant through time.

concepts.name: Multivariate normal-inverse Gaussian (MNIG) distribution
concepts.scope: A heavy-tailed, skewed multivariate distribution used to model non-Gaussian residuals in energy price systems.

concepts.name: Stochastic volatility and GARCH modelling
concepts.scope: Time-varying conditional variance frameworks capturing volatility clustering observed in commodity price returns.

concepts.name: Day-ahead market price timing
concepts.scope: The institutional feature that prices for a given delivery day are fixed the preceding day, giving plant operators an additional day of price foresight.

concepts.name: Deterministic intraday production scheduling
concepts.scope: Within-day linear or network optimization of generation output given known hourly prices and plant technical constraints.

concepts.name: EU Emissions Trading Scheme (EU ETS)
concepts.scope: The cap-and-trade mechanism that adds a carbon cost to fossil fuel generation via mandatory surrender of EU allowances (EUAs) per tonne of CO2 emitted.

concepts.name: Seasonality in commodity prices
concepts.scope: Deterministic periodic patterns in electricity and gas prices captured via sine-cosine Fourier terms at annual, semi-annual, and quarterly frequencies.

concepts.name: Unit root and stationarity testing
concepts.scope: Statistical procedures (ADF and KPSS tests) used to classify price series as integrated of order one before co-integration analysis.

concepts.name: Merit order curve
concepts.scope: The supply-side ranking of generators by marginal cost that determines the equilibrium electricity price given inelastic demand.

concepts.name: Information criteria for model selection
concepts.scope: Penalised likelihood statistics (AIC, BIC, HQ, SC) used to compare competing price model specifications.

concepts.name: Price foresight and myopic assumptions
concepts.scope: The distinction between assuming prices are known only at the moment of delivery (myopic/zero foresight) versus known one day in advance (day-ahead foresight) and its effect on dispatch decisions and plant value.

concepts.name: Cointegration of energy prices
concepts.scope: Long-run equilibrium relationship linking logarithms of electricity, gas and carbon prices such that deviations are mean-reverting.

concepts.name: Vector Error Correction Model (VECM)
concepts.scope: Multivariate time-series model that captures short-run dynamics and adjustment toward a long-run cointegrating equilibrium.

concepts.name: BEKK GARCH
concepts.scope: Multivariate GARCH specification ensuring positive-definiteness of the conditional covariance matrix via quadratic forms.

concepts.name: Dynamic Conditional Correlation (DCC) GARCH
concepts.scope: Multivariate GARCH variant allowing the correlation matrix to vary over time as a function of past standardized residuals.

concepts.name: Multivariate skewed-t distribution
concepts.scope: Generalized hyperbolic distribution accommodating both tail heaviness and asymmetry in multiple dimensions.

concepts.name: EM algorithm for MNIG
concepts.scope: Expectation-Maximization procedure used to estimate parameters of the MNIG distribution on standardized residuals.

concepts.name: Quasi Maximum Likelihood Estimation (QML)
concepts.scope: Estimation method that maximises a Gaussian log-likelihood to obtain consistent parameter estimates even under non-normality.

concepts.name: Risk-neutral measure adjustment
concepts.scope: Modification of the MNIG skewness parameter so that simulated log-price increments have expected return equal to the risk-free rate.

concepts.name: Least Squares Monte Carlo (LSM)
concepts.scope: Simulation-based dynamic programming algorithm that approximates continuation values via OLS regression for optimal stopping and switching decisions.

concepts.name: Bellman equation for power plant dispatch
concepts.scope: Recursive optimality condition expressing the plant value as the maximum over next-state transitions of immediate profit plus discounted expected continuation value.

concepts.name: Power plant state space
concepts.scope: Discrete set of operating modes (Cold, Warm, Hot, Min, Max) representing boiler temperature and generator output for scheduling purposes.

concepts.name: Start-up costs and ramp constraints
concepts.scope: Operational restrictions governing minimum transition times and fuel consumption required to move between plant states.

concepts.name: Price ratio pre-solving
concepts.scope: Computational technique exploiting that optimal intraday profiles depend only on three price ratios, allowing lookup-table substitution in Monte Carlo.

concepts.name: Perfect foresight benchmark
concepts.scope: Upper-bound valuation obtained by assuming exact knowledge of future continuation values rather than regression estimates.

concepts.name: Seasonality decomposition
concepts.scope: Extraction of deterministic calendar patterns from price series prior to fitting the stochastic VECM component.

concepts.name: Weekday dummy variables
concepts.scope: Indicator variables capturing systematic day-of-week price effects, split pre- and post-2009 to reflect market structural changes.

concepts.name: Carbon intensity (IC)
concepts.scope: Fixed coefficient converting gas consumption into equivalent CO2 emissions for computing carbon cost in the spark spread.

concepts.name: Myopic vs. day-ahead price information assumption
concepts.scope: Comparison of plant dispatch decisions made with and without 12-hour advance knowledge of the next day's prices.

concepts.name: LSM regression basis functions
concepts.scope: Choice of regressors (power functions, Laguerre polynomials, multivariate price terms) used to approximate continuation values in the LSM algorithm.

concepts.name: ARCH-LM test
concepts.scope: Lagrange-multiplier test for autoregressive conditional heteroscedasticity in univariate or multivariate residual series.

concepts.name: Information criteria (AIC, BIC, HQ, SC)
concepts.scope: Penalised likelihood statistics used to select lag length, GARCH specification and residual distribution.

concepts.name: Cointegrating vector (beta)
concepts.scope: Linear combination of log prices that is stationary and interpreted as long-run price elasticities in the VECM.

concepts.name: Speed-of-adjustment coefficients (alpha)
concepts.scope: Parameters in the VECM measuring how quickly each price series corrects deviations from the long-run equilibrium.

concepts.name: Cointegration
concepts.scope: Long-run equilibrium relationship linking electricity, gas and carbon log prices within the VECM framework.

concepts.name: De-seasonalised log prices
concepts.scope: Transformation of commodity spot prices removing deterministic seasonal patterns before econometric modelling.

concepts.name: Day-of-week dummy variables
concepts.scope: Indicator variables for weekdays included in the VECM to capture systematic calendar effects in power and gas prices.

concepts.name: Multivariate Normal Inverse Gaussian (MNIG) distribution
concepts.scope: Heavy-tailed, skewed multivariate distribution used to model standardised residuals of the price process as a normal mean-variance mixture with an inverse Gaussian mixing variable.

concepts.name: EM algorithm for generalised hyperbolic distributions
concepts.scope: Expectation-Maximisation procedure that alternates between computing conditional expectations of the latent mixing variable and updating distribution parameters to achieve maximum likelihood estimates.

concepts.name: Modified Bessel function of the second kind
concepts.scope: Special function appearing in the MNIG and skewed-t probability density functions and their EM update equations.

concepts.name: Spark spread / clean spark spread
concepts.scope: Net revenue margin of a gas-fired plant equal to the power price minus variable costs and fuel costs adjusted for carbon intensity.

concepts.name: Dark spread / clean dark spread
concepts.scope: Revenue margin for coal-fired generation, used as a benchmark comparator to the clean spark spread for CCGT.

concepts.name: Merit order effect
concepts.scope: Mechanism by which renewable generation displaces higher-marginal-cost plant and thereby reduces equilibrium wholesale electricity prices.

concepts.name: Heat rate
concepts.scope: Thermal efficiency ratio converting gas input to electricity output, determining the fuel cost component of the spark spread.

concepts.name: Intraday production scheduling
concepts.scope: Deterministic optimisation of hourly dispatch decisions for a CCGT over a 24-hour period given plant state transitions and prevailing prices.

concepts.name: Dynamic programming for CCGT dispatch
concepts.scope: Backward-induction algorithm computing optimal start/stop and loading trajectories for a CCGT over each operating day.

concepts.name: Plant state transitions
concepts.scope: Discrete operational states (off, warming-up, generating, cooling-down) with associated gas consumption and electricity output matrices governing feasible CCGT transitions.

concepts.name: Dimensionality reduction via load multiplier
concepts.scope: Proof that the optimal intraday production profile depends only on relative price ratios (load multiplier and fuel cost ratio) rather than absolute price levels, allowing pre-computation of universal dispatch rules.

concepts.name: Load multiplier (LM)
concepts.scope: Ratio of net electricity revenue to fuel cost used to parameterise the dimensionality-reduced CCGT dispatch decision.

concepts.name: Fuel cost ratio (ΔcF)
concepts.scope: Ratio of next-day to current-day fuel cost capturing intraday fuel price changes for cross-midnight dispatch optimisation.

concepts.name: Real options valuation of generation assets
concepts.scope: Framework treating a CCGT as a portfolio of options on the spark spread and applying dynamic programming or simulation to compute asset value.

concepts.name: Carbon emission certificates (EUAs)
concepts.scope: EU allowances whose price enters the clean spark spread as an additional variable cost proportional to the plant's carbon intensity.

concepts.name: Unit root testing (ADF/SAID-DICKEY)
concepts.scope: Statistical tests applied to price series to determine the order of integration prior to cointegration analysis.

concepts.name: Multivariate GARCH with time-varying correlations
concepts.scope: Dynamic volatility model used to capture changing second-moment structure in joint commodity price innovations.

concepts.name: Normal mean-variance mixture
concepts.scope: Construction principle representing both the MNIG and skewed-t distributions as conditionally Gaussian processes with a random variance mixing variable.

methods: Multivariate normal-inverse Gaussian (MNIG) distribution fitting via EM algorithm
Sine-cosine Fourier seasonal decomposition via OLS
Deterministic dynamic programming for intraday scheduling
Information criterion model comparison (AIC, BIC, HQ)
OLS regression for LSM continuation value (power functions, Laguerre polynomials, multivariate regressors)
Multivariate GARCH estimation (Scalar BEKK, Diagonal BEKK, DCC-Engle, DCC-Tse-Tsui, CCC)
EM algorithm for MNIG parameter estimation
Risk-neutral skewness adjustment via numerical optimisation
Monte Carlo simulation of multivariate price paths
Least Squares Monte Carlo (LSM) dynamic programming
Deterministic intraday dynamic programming for dispatch
OLS regression for continuation value approximation
Hannan-Quinn information criterion for lag selection
Method of moments initialisation for NIG parameters
Dimensionality reduction via relative price ratios
