EU ETS and carbon market mechanics
Basic thermodynamics of gas turbine cycles
Time series analysis (unit roots, stationarity, lag selection)
Maximum likelihood and quasi-maximum likelihood estimation
Spark spread and heat rate concepts
Operational research for power plant dispatch
Stochastic processes and time series econometrics
Maximum likelihood and EM estimation theory
Multivariate probability distributions and heavy-tailed distributions
CCGT plant engineering basics (heat rates, start-up costs)

valuing_generation_assets___overview___s.topic: Valuation of thermal generation assets as real options, with focus on analytic spark spread option pricing

concepts.name: Spark spread option
concepts.scope: An option on the spread between the power price and the heat-rate-adjusted fuel cost of a generation unit.

concepts.name: Real options for generation assets
concepts.scope: The treatment of operational flexibility in running a power plant as optionality amenable to financial option pricing techniques.

concepts.name: Heat rate
concepts.scope: A measure of generation unit fuel efficiency expressed as fuel input per unit of electricity output, which varies with operating level and ambient conditions.

concepts.name: Intrinsic value
concepts.scope: The discounted in-the-money portion of the spark spread option value based on current forward prices alone.

concepts.name: Extrinsic (time) value
concepts.scope: The portion of option value attributable to price uncertainty beyond the intrinsic value.

concepts.name: Black's formula
concepts.scope: A closed-form pricing model for European call options on futures contracts used to value the spark spread option analytically.

concepts.name: Kirk approximation
concepts.scope: A technique that reduces a two-factor spread option to a single-factor option with a combined effective volatility dependent on power volatility, gas volatility, and their correlation.

concepts.name: Forward volatility term structure
concepts.scope: The time-dependent implied volatility surface for power and gas forward prices, exhibiting seasonal patterns and mean-reversion.

concepts.name: Implied correlation
concepts.scope: The market-derived correlation between power and gas forward prices used as an input to spread option pricing.

concepts.name: Start cost
concepts.scope: A fixed charge per plant start covering fuel consumed during start-up and wear-and-tear, incorporated into the option strike or via heat rate adjustment.

concepts.name: Variable operation and maintenance (VOM) cost
concepts.scope: Non-fuel variable costs of running a generation unit, treated as a fixed adder to the option strike.

concepts.name: Minimum stable generation
concepts.scope: The lowest output level at which a unit can operate and still deliver power to the grid.

concepts.name: Ramp rate
concepts.scope: The rate at which a generation unit can increase or decrease its output level, limiting instantaneous dispatch flexibility.

concepts.name: Minimum up/down time
concepts.scope: Operational constraints requiring a unit to remain on or off for a minimum number of hours once switched.

concepts.name: Forced and scheduled outages
concepts.scope: Unplanned and planned reductions in unit availability, approximated in the analytic model by de-rating the volume of MWh generated.

concepts.name: Baseload, mid-merit, and peaking unit classification
concepts.scope: A taxonomy of thermal generators by operating regime, moneyness of the associated spark spread option, and proportion of intrinsic versus extrinsic value.

concepts.name: Monte Carlo simulation for dispatch valuation
concepts.scope: Hourly simulation of spot power prices combined with a dispatch algorithm to value generation assets while incorporating operational constraints.

concepts.name: Perfect foresight bias
concepts.scope: The overvaluation arising when simulated spot prices are used both to dispatch the plant and to calculate profit and loss in a Monte Carlo framework.

concepts.name: Least squares Monte Carlo (LSMC)
concepts.scope: A method combining backward induction via regression with Monte Carlo price simulation to value generation assets without assuming perfect foresight.

concepts.name: Trinomial tree with backward induction
concepts.scope: A lattice-based dynamic programming approach that steps backward through time to optimally dispatch a generation asset at each node.

concepts.name: Emissions costs
concepts.scope: CO2, NOx, and SO2 charges incorporated as deterministic strike adjustments or, when stochastic, requiring Monte Carlo treatment.

concepts.name: Heat rate curve
concepts.scope: A step or continuous function describing fuel efficiency as a function of output level between minimum stable generation and maximum capacity.

concepts.name: Dark spread
concepts.scope: The spread between power price and the cost of coal used to generate it, analogous to the spark spread for gas-fired units.

methods: Analytic spark spread option pricing (Kirk approximation)
Black's formula for options on futures
Heat rate adjustment to absorb stochastic start gas cost
Volume de-rating to approximate outage effects
Strike decomposition into VOM, heat-rate gas adder, and amortised start cost
Implied volatility extraction from liquid option markets
Monte Carlo simulation with hourly price granularity
Dynamic programming on trinomial trees (backward induction)
implied_prerequisites: Black-Scholes and Black 1976 option pricing theory
Forward and futures curve construction for power and gas
Basic stochastic processes for commodity prices
Discounted cash flow and present value
Correlation and covariance in multi-asset settings

concepts.name: Tolling Agreement
concepts.scope: Contractual right to dispatch a generation asset in exchange for fixed and variable payments, valued as a strip of real options on the spark spread.

concepts.name: Hot Start
concepts.scope: Plant operational state allowing rapid dispatch with lower start-up cost and time than a cold start.

concepts.name: Generation Dispatch Optionality
concepts.scope: The right but not obligation to generate during each scheduling interval, capturing value when spark spread exceeds variable cost.

concepts.name: Hourly Pricing Shape
concepts.scope: Intra-day power price profile used to disaggregate block schedules into hourly dispatch decisions in developed markets.

concepts.name: Spark Spread Option
concepts.scope: Financial option on the difference between power price and heat-rate-adjusted fuel cost, forming the canonical building block for tolling valuation.

concepts.name: Variable Put
concepts.scope: An option structure capturing the asymmetric payoff of electing not to run when the spark spread is negative.

concepts.name: Correlation Sensitivity
concepts.scope: Sensitivity of the spread option value to the assumed correlation between power and fuel price processes.

concepts.name: Volatility Curve
concepts.scope: Term structure of implied or historical volatility for power and fuel used to price and risk-manage the tolling option book.

concepts.name: Historical Volatility
concepts.scope: Realised price volatility estimated from time-series data, used as a benchmark or input when implied volatility is unavailable.

concepts.name: Intrinsic Value
concepts.scope: The discounted value of dispatching the asset optimally against current forward prices, ignoring future price uncertainty.

concepts.name: Extrinsic Value
concepts.scope: The additional option premium above intrinsic value attributable to price volatility and scheduling flexibility, typically 10–20 percent of total tolling value.

concepts.name: Auxiliary Costs
concepts.scope: Non-fuel variable operating costs such as emissions allowances that reduce effective spark spread and must be embedded in dispatch economics.

concepts.name: Emission Costs
concepts.scope: Carbon or NOx/SOx compliance costs treated as a variable generation cost reducing the effective spread captured by the toller.

concepts.name: Transmission Costs and Losses
concepts.scope: Costs and energy losses associated with moving power to or from the delivery point, reducing the net spread receivable by the toller.

concepts.name: Delta-Flat Hedging
concepts.scope: Hedging strategy that offsets the net price sensitivity of the tolling position in both fuel and power markets simultaneously.

concepts.name: Liquidity-Adjusted Pricing
concepts.scope: Incorporation of bid-offer spreads and market depth into forward curve construction to reflect realistic realisable hedge costs.

concepts.name: Cost Sensitivity
concepts.scope: Measure of how tolling value responds to changes in variable operating costs including fuel, emissions, and auxiliary expenses.

methods: Hourly shape disaggregation of block forward prices
Greeks computation for spread options (delta, vega, rho-correlation)
Intrinsic value calculation against forward curve
Extrinsic value estimation as residual above intrinsic
implied_prerequisites: Power and gas forward curve construction
Basic plant operations and heat-rate concepts
Electricity market structure and scheduling (US ISO markets)

power_alco.topic: Imbalance settlement calculation and optimisation for wind and energy portfolios

concepts.name: Imbalance settlement
concepts.scope: Covers the financial settlement of deviations between metered generation/consumption and nominated positions in balancing markets.

concepts.name: Imbalance price
concepts.scope: The per-unit price applied to a party's net imbalance position in a given settlement period.

concepts.name: Portfolio imbalance aggregation
concepts.scope: Combining individual asset or counterparty positions into a single net imbalance volume for settlement purposes.

concepts.name: Wind generation forecasting
concepts.scope: Predicting output from wind assets to minimise imbalance exposure relative to nominations.

concepts.name: Actual vs. forecast deviation
concepts.scope: Quantifying the difference between realised generation and the forecast used for nominations across settlement intervals.

concepts.name: Nomination strategy
concepts.scope: Selecting the energy volume declared to the TSO/balancing authority to optimise expected imbalance cost or revenue.

concepts.name: Balancing responsible party (BRP) position
concepts.scope: The net energy position a BRP holds after netting all its portfolio nominations and actuals in a given period.

concepts.name: Half-hourly / quarter-hourly settlement granularity
concepts.scope: Resolution of imbalance calculations matching the settlement interval of the relevant national balancing regime.

concepts.name: Historical imbalance price data
concepts.scope: Time-series of past imbalance prices used to back-test nomination strategies and estimate settlement costs.

concepts.name: Cross-country imbalance comparison
concepts.scope: Systematic comparison of imbalance rules, prices and outcomes across Belgium, Germany, Netherlands and UK markets.

concepts.name: Turbine-level imbalance calculation
concepts.scope: Disaggregating settlement calculations to individual wind turbine metering to isolate asset-level P&L.

concepts.name: Matrix-to-column data reshaping
concepts.scope: Transforming wide-format time-series matrices into long-format columnar datasets suitable for analysis.

methods: Python scripting for automated imbalance P&L calculation
Excel-based imbalance data aggregation and pivot analysis
Time-series merging of actual generation, forecast and imbalance price data
Scenario comparison of alternative portfolio combination strategies
Back-testing nomination strategies against historical settlement prices
Data reshaping from matrix to column format
implied_prerequisites: Electricity market structure and balancing mechanisms
Wind power generation and forecasting basics
Excel data manipulation and pivot tables
National balancing market rules for NL, BE, DE and GB

power_battery.topic: GB Capacity Market auction results and battery energy storage project development

concepts.name: Capacity Market auction clearing price
concepts.scope: The single price at which a GB capacity auction clears, set via bidding rounds and the Net Welfare Algorithm.

concepts.name: Net Welfare Algorithm
concepts.scope: A regulatory procedure that decides whether to include a marginal capacity unit by comparing welfare gain against incremental procurement cost.

concepts.name: Capacity Market Unit (CMU)
concepts.scope: The basic unit of participation in the GB Capacity Market, classified by technology type and build status.

concepts.name: De-rated capacity
concepts.scope: Gross capacity adjusted downward by a technology-specific de-rating factor to reflect reliability of supply during stress events.

concepts.name: Capacity Agreement
concepts.scope: A contract awarding a CMU the right to receive capacity payments in exchange for availability obligations in a defined delivery year.

concepts.name: Early Capacity Auction (T-1 auction)
concepts.scope: A short-lead-time GB capacity auction targeting delivery one year ahead, distinct from the main T-4 auction.

concepts.name: Demand Curve (capacity auction)
concepts.scope: A downward-sloping administrative price-quantity schedule defining the target volume of capacity procured at each price level.

concepts.name: Proven and Unproven DSR
concepts.scope: Demand-Side Response CMUs distinguished by whether they have previously demonstrated delivery of their contracted capacity.

concepts.name: CMU technology classification
concepts.scope: Categorisation of capacity units by generation technology (CCGT, nuclear, coal/biomass, hydro, storage, DSR, interconnector, etc.) for auction reporting.

concepts.name: Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) as a Capacity Market unit
concepts.scope: Grid-scale battery storage registered as a New Build Generating CMU eligible to compete in GB capacity auctions.

concepts.name: Storage de-rating and loop efficiency
concepts.scope: The round-trip efficiency of a battery storage facility used to adjust its gross capacity to net deliverable capacity.

concepts.name: Development Consent Order (DCO)
concepts.scope: UK planning consent mechanism required for energy infrastructure projects above 50 MW classified as Nationally Significant Infrastructure Projects.

concepts.name: Grid connection voltage and costs for large-scale storage
concepts.scope: The transmission or distribution voltage level and associated capital expenditure required to connect a utility-scale battery project.

concepts.name: Transmission Network Use of System (TNUoS) charges
concepts.scope: Charges levied on generators and storage for use of the GB transmission network, which can be negative at certain connection points.

concepts.name: Battery Management System (BMS) and EMC
concepts.scope: Control electronics managing cell-level battery operation, with electromagnetic compatibility challenges in large installations.

concepts.name: Short-Term Operating Reserve (STOR)
concepts.scope: A National Grid ancillary service product requiring delivery of active power within a defined response time, for which storage can pre-qualify.

concepts.name: Fast Frequency Response (FFR)
concepts.scope: A high-speed ancillary service requiring active power delivery within one second of a frequency deviation, relevant to battery storage.

concepts.name: Battery degradation and end-of-life management
concepts.scope: The capacity fade of lithium-ion or other battery chemistries over time and the asset management procedures for replacement.

concepts.name: Containerised vs building-housed storage deployment
concepts.scope: A site-level design choice comparing prefabricated container solutions with purpose-built structures for housing battery systems.

concepts.name: Blended services procurement (EFR/FFR)
concepts.scope: National Grid's procurement framework combining enhanced and firm frequency response products into a single tender for storage assets.

concepts.name: Multi-purpose energy storage application
concepts.scope: Covers the simultaneous or sequential delivery of multiple grid services from a single battery asset at a distribution substation.

concepts.name: Energy Storage Device (ESD) architecture
concepts.scope: Covers the hierarchical hardware structure of a grid-scale battery system from individual trays through string BMS, SMS, BESDM and BESSM layers.

concepts.name: Battery Management System (BMS)
concepts.scope: Covers the control and monitoring of individual battery strings and their state within a large-format grid storage installation.

concepts.name: Power Conversion System (PCS)
concepts.scope: Covers the AC/DC inverter and DC/DC chopper units that mediate power flow between the battery arrays and the grid.

concepts.name: Forecasting, Optimisation and Scheduling System (FOSS)
concepts.scope: Covers the software layer responsible for generating charge/discharge schedules to optimise storage dispatch across multiple services.

concepts.name: Frequency response service
concepts.scope: Covers automated real-power delivery triggered by system frequency deviations, including droop curves, deadbands and response speed configuration.

concepts.name: Static frequency response
concepts.scope: Covers constant-power delivery triggered by a pre-set frequency threshold, with configurable ramp rate and duration.

concepts.name: Dynamic frequency regulation
concepts.scope: Covers continuous automated real-power modulation proportional to frequency deviation using configurable droop characteristics.

concepts.name: Peak shaving
concepts.scope: Covers automated power threshold control that limits network loading by injecting or absorbing power when measured flows exceed an asset-rating limit.

concepts.name: Voltage support
concepts.scope: Covers automated reactive or real-power delivery in response to local voltage deviations using configurable voltage droop curves.

concepts.name: Energy arbitrage (tolling)
concepts.scope: Covers the commercial arrangement whereby a third party takes operational control of the storage to exploit energy price spreads or manage portfolio imbalance.

concepts.name: State of charge (SoC) management
concepts.scope: Covers energy-based setpoint control used to position battery SoC in preparation for subsequent service delivery.

concepts.name: Storage control modes
concepts.scope: Covers a standardised set of parameterised operating modes that map physical power/energy commands to specific use-case behaviours.

concepts.name: SCADA integration for storage
concepts.scope: Covers the connection of a software-driven battery asset into an existing network SCADA and RTU architecture via digital interfaces rather than analogue signals.

concepts.name: Enterprise Service Bus (ESB) messaging
concepts.scope: Covers the use of message-queue middleware to exchange schedules and status data between multi-vendor storage control and optimisation systems.

concepts.name: Electromagnetic compatibility (EMC) in grid storage
concepts.scope: Covers conducted and radiated emissions arising from high-frequency switching in MW-scale PCS units and their interaction with battery management electronics.

concepts.name: High-frequency circulating currents
concepts.scope: Covers unintended current flow at inverter switching harmonics through earthing and cable support structures due to skin effect at the installation scale.

concepts.name: Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT)
concepts.scope: Covers formal witnessed testing of storage hardware and software at the supplier's facility against agreed functional requirements and defect acceptance criteria.

concepts.name: Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) and System Integration Testing (SIT)
concepts.scope: Covers end-to-end functional and non-functional testing of the fully installed storage system within the live network environment.

concepts.name: Network reinforcement deferral
concepts.scope: Covers the use of grid-connected storage to defer capital investment in conventional network infrastructure by providing additional capacity or flexibility.

concepts.name: DNO asset management for storage
concepts.scope: Covers the incorporation of an energy storage asset into a distribution network operator's asset management database with appropriate data templates and maintenance schedules.

concepts.name: Building-housed versus containerised storage
concepts.scope: Covers the comparative assessment of planning, logistics, balance-of-plant, operability and cost trade-offs between the two principal ESS housing approaches.

concepts.name: Storage business models
concepts.scope: Covers alternative ownership and revenue structures for grid storage including DNO-owned and third-party-owned configurations with multiple revenue streams.

concepts.name: Low Carbon Network Fund (LCNF)
concepts.scope: Covers the Ofgem innovation funding mechanism under which the SNS project was financed to demonstrate smart grid storage at scale.

concepts.name: Battery Energy Storage System Management (BESSM)
concepts.scope: Centralised control platform coordinating battery dispatch, closed-loop power control and monitoring for a grid-connected energy storage device.

concepts.name: State of Charge (SoC)
concepts.scope: Estimated proportion of remaining energy capacity in a battery system, subject to algorithmic uncertainty from temperature, ageing and current.

concepts.name: State of Health (SoH)
concepts.scope: Calibration metric indicating the overall condition and usable capacity of battery cells relative to their nameplate rating.

concepts.name: Closed-loop power control
concepts.scope: Feedback control architecture in which metered network power is used to continuously adjust energy storage output set-points.

concepts.name: RTU data latency
concepts.scope: Communication delay introduced by a Remote Terminal Unit that limits the speed of closed-loop control response for an energy storage device.

concepts.name: BESDM handover and SoC balancing
concepts.scope: Control logic that rotates active battery sub-modules to equalise state of charge, causing transient power fluctuations during ramp transitions.

concepts.name: DC capacitor inrush current
concepts.scope: High transient current drawn from battery strings when charging Power Conversion System DC-side capacitors, capable of blowing protection fuses.

concepts.name: Dynamic Firm Frequency Response (DFFR)
concepts.scope: Ancillary service in which a storage device responds to grid frequency deviations according to a droop characteristic, with a defined dead-band.

concepts.name: Short Term Operating Reserve (STOR)
concepts.scope: National Grid reserve service requiring sustained MW delivery or absorption over a minimum two-hour window, with energy delivery tolerance penalties.

concepts.name: Firm Frequency Response (FFR) pre-qualification testing
concepts.scope: Mandatory compliance testing to verify response speed and accuracy of a generator or storage asset before enrolment in the FFR market.

concepts.name: Frequency droop characteristic
concepts.scope: Pre-agreed linear relationship between grid frequency deviation and storage power output used to deliver frequency response services.

concepts.name: Reactive power support
concepts.scope: Provision of reactive power from a storage inverter to correct power factor, extendable indefinitely unlike energy-limited active power delivery.

concepts.name: Flexibility Optimisation and Scheduling System (FOSS)
concepts.scope: Software platform used to schedule and optimise commercial and network services for an energy storage asset across multiple use cases.

concepts.name: CAN-BUS interference
concepts.scope: Electromagnetic interference on the Controller Area Network communications bus degrading data integrity between battery and control subsystems.

concepts.name: MODBUS communications link
concepts.scope: Serial protocol link between battery sub-modules and power conversion systems whose reliability affects coordinated power dispatch.

concepts.name: Battery string protection fuse rating
concepts.scope: Selection of fuse ratings in battery strings balancing fast fault isolation against nuisance tripping from inrush currents during capacitor charging.

concepts.name: Asset Management System (Ellipse)
concepts.scope: Enterprise asset register and maintenance scheduling platform used by a DNO to record asset attributes, condition indices and inspection tasks.

concepts.name: Battery hierarchy granularity
concepts.scope: Decision on the level of sub-component aggregation (cell, tray, string, array) at which battery assets are registered and managed in an asset database.

concepts.name: Engineering Maintenance Standard (EMS)
concepts.scope: Standardised document chain specifying inspection frequency, activities and scripts for a class of network assets to ensure consistent lifecycle management.

concepts.name: SoC calibration drift
concepts.scope: Accumulating error in estimated state of charge that requires periodic full-cycle calibration to maintain accuracy in battery management systems.

concepts.name: TRIAD period
concepts.scope: One of the three half-hour periods of highest national demand used by GB network operators to set transmission network use-of-system charges.

concepts.name: Remote support link
concepts.scope: Secure communications path allowing geographically remote technology vendors to access, diagnose and update storage control systems without site visits.

concepts.name: Battery Manager role
concepts.scope: Operational role responsible for commercial scheduling and manual control of an energy storage device, distinct from network control authorisation.

concepts.name: Engineering Operating Standard (EOS)
concepts.scope: Site-specific procedural document defining roles, isolation procedures, alarm responses and safety requirements for operating a novel energy storage asset.

concepts.name: Point of common coupling (PCC)
concepts.scope: Electrical connection point at which storage system power output is measured for performance assessment and network impact evaluation.

concepts.name: Aggregator interface (KOMP)
concepts.scope: Control and metering interface between an energy storage operator and an aggregator enabling automated dispatch signals and performance reporting for ancillary services.

concepts.name: Calibration Cycle
concepts.scope: Scheduled full charge-discharge routine used to recalibrate SoC or SoH measurements, creating a temporary loss of storage availability.

concepts.name: Calibration Opportunity Cost
concepts.scope: Revenue foregone from commercial or network services during periods when the storage system is unavailable due to mandatory calibration routines.

concepts.name: Battery Degradation
concepts.scope: Reduction in usable energy capacity over time due to calendar fade and cycle aging, governed by temperature, depth-of-discharge and cycling frequency.

concepts.name: End of Life (EoL) Threshold
concepts.scope: The capacity level, conventionally 80% of rated capacity, at which battery cells are deemed to require replacement.

concepts.name: Cycle Life
concepts.scope: The number of full charge-discharge cycles a battery technology can sustain before reaching its defined end-of-life capacity threshold.

concepts.name: Calendar Life
concepts.scope: Degradation in battery capacity occurring with elapsed time independently of charge-discharge cycling activity.

concepts.name: Second Life Application
concepts.scope: Re-use of battery modules that have reached end of life for their primary application in a less demanding secondary application or recycling stream.

concepts.name: WEEE Directive
concepts.scope: EU regulation placing responsibility on manufacturers to recover and recycle battery modules at end of life.

concepts.name: Stacked Service Revenue
concepts.scope: Combined commercial income from simultaneously offering multiple grid services using a single storage asset to maximise return on investment.

concepts.name: Simultaneous Calibration and Service Delivery
concepts.scope: Scheduling calibration cycles to coincide with service delivery periods, such as exporting during a SoH discharge at peak demand to provide arbitrage or peak shaving.

concepts.name: Net Present Value (NPV) of Storage Revenue
concepts.scope: Discounted sum of commercial service revenues earned over a storage asset's economic life, used to evaluate the financial impact of operational constraints.

concepts.name: Frequency Response
concepts.scope: Fast injection or absorption of power by a storage system to stabilise grid frequency following generation-demand imbalances.

concepts.name: Operating Reserve
concepts.scope: Committed energy capacity held available by a storage system to be dispatched by the transmission system operator when required.

concepts.name: Energy Arbitrage
concepts.scope: Buying electricity at low-price periods for storage and selling at high-price periods to generate a price-spread profit.

concepts.name: Demand Forecasting for ESS Scheduling
concepts.scope: Statistical prediction of local network demand used to reserve appropriate storage energy for priority network support services before allocating remaining capacity to commercial markets.

concepts.name: Forecasting, Optimization and Scheduling System (FOSS)
concepts.scope: Software framework combining load forecasting, energy and power resource allocation, and cost-based optimisation to schedule a storage system across multiple concurrent service contracts.

concepts.name: Greedy Search Heuristic
concepts.scope: Iterative optimisation algorithm that selects the highest-value available service at each step to build a near-optimal storage dispatch schedule.

concepts.name: Multiple Linear Regression for Load Forecasting
concepts.scope: Statistical method used to predict local network demand from explanatory variables as an input to storage scheduling.

concepts.name: Power and Energy Resource Allocation
concepts.scope: Apportioning the finite MW and MWh capacity of a storage system across concurrent service commitments while respecting physical and contractual constraints.

concepts.name: Battery Replacement Procurement Considerations
concepts.scope: Commercial and contractual issues around warranty scope, cost responsibility and logistics for battery module replacement at end of life.

power_energinet_wind.topic: Danish wind power market data and locational spread option modelling

concepts.name: Locational spread option
concepts.scope: An option whose payoff depends on the price difference between two geographic delivery points in a power market.

concepts.name: Locational price spread
concepts.scope: The difference in electricity spot prices between two interconnected bidding zones or nodes.

concepts.name: Wind power market data
concepts.scope: Time-series records of wind generation output and associated market variables used for quantitative analysis.

concepts.name: Wholesale electricity pricing
concepts.scope: The determination and recording of clearing prices in organised day-ahead and intraday power markets.

concepts.name: Bidding zone interconnection
concepts.scope: The cross-border capacity linking separate pricing zones that gives rise to locational price differentials.

concepts.name: Market statistics and descriptive analytics
concepts.scope: Summary statistical measures applied to power price and generation time-series to characterise distributional properties.

power_european_toll.topic: European power tolling, clean spread options and price assessment methodology

concepts.name: Tolling agreement
concepts.scope: Contractual arrangement giving a party the right to nominate output from a generation asset in exchange for paying fuel and operating costs.

concepts.name: Delta hedging (power plant)
concepts.scope: Daily replication of the sensitivity-weighted forward positions implied by a CCGT tolling model across electricity, gas and carbon markets.

concepts.name: Greeks (tolling model)
concepts.scope: Partial derivatives of a tolling model's value with respect to forward electricity, gas and carbon prices used to determine hedge quantities.

concepts.name: Back-testing methodology
concepts.scope: Framework for reconstructing the theoretical daily hedge portfolio over a historical period and comparing it against a reference benchmark.

concepts.name: Clean dark spread
concepts.scope: Indicative margin for coal-fired generation equal to the power price minus the cost of coal and the cost of CO2 emissions allowances.

concepts.name: Clean spark spread
concepts.scope: Indicative margin for gas-fired generation equal to the power price minus the cost of gas and the cost of CO2 emissions allowances.

concepts.name: Dark spread
concepts.scope: Indicative margin for coal-fired generation equal to the power price minus the cost of coal before carbon costs.

concepts.name: Spark spread
concepts.scope: Indicative margin for gas-fired generation equal to the power price minus the cost of gas before carbon costs.

concepts.name: Clean dark spread option (monthly)
concepts.scope: A call option giving the buyer the right to nominate power capacity monthly, paying an energy price formula referencing coal, EUA and FX rather than a fixed strike.

concepts.name: Energy price formula
concepts.scope: Contractual expression linking the exercise price of a spread option to floating commodity indices such as API2 coal, ICE EUA futures and EUR/USD FX.

concepts.name: EUA (EU Emissions Allowance)
concepts.scope: Tradeable permit under the EU ETS representing the right to emit one tonne of CO2, used as a cost input in clean spread calculations.

concepts.name: API2 coal price
concepts.scope: CIF ARA coal price benchmark published by Argus used as the coal cost reference in spread and energy price formula calculations.

concepts.name: Plant parameters (CCGT)
concepts.scope: Technical inputs—efficiency, variable O&M cost, availability and start-up cost—used to characterise a gas-fired plant in a tolling model.

concepts.name: Forward curve construction
concepts.scope: Daily generation of baseload and peakload forward price curves for electricity, gas and carbon across agreed tradable tenors for use in hedging and back-testing.

concepts.name: Tradable contracts / tenors
concepts.scope: The set of baseload and peakload forward contract maturities considered sufficiently liquid for delta hedge execution and back-test replication.

concepts.name: Liquidity adjustment
concepts.scope: Correction to theoretical hedge prices to account for the bid-offer spread or limited market depth when executing forward trades.

concepts.name: Market-on-close assessment
concepts.scope: Price assessment methodology that reflects transactable market value at a defined end-of-day timestamp, as applied by Platts for European electricity.

concepts.name: Normalization (price assessment)
concepts.scope: Adjustment of bids, offers or transactions reported at different times or locations to a common timestamp and specification for assessment purposes.

concepts.name: Coal switching price indicator (CSPI)
concepts.scope: Threshold gas price at which CCGT generation becomes cheaper than coal-fired generation, accounting for fuel efficiency and carbon costs.

concepts.name: Fuel efficiency factor
concepts.scope: Plant-level parameter expressing the ratio of electrical output to fuel energy input, used to convert fuel commodity prices into equivalent power-generation costs.

concepts.name: Emissions intensity factor
concepts.scope: CO2 emission rate per unit of fuel energy (tCO2/MMBtu or mtCO2/MWh) applied to convert EUA prices into a per-MWh electricity generation cost.

concepts.name: UK Carbon Price Support (CPS)
concepts.scope: UK government levy on fossil fuels used in power generation, added to EUA prices in UK clean spread calculations to reflect total carbon cost.

concepts.name: Baseload / peakload contracts
concepts.scope: Standard European forward electricity products delivering flat 24-hour or daytime-hours power, forming the building blocks of hedging and price assessment.

concepts.name: Roll date
concepts.scope: The date on which a forward contract for a given tenor expires and trading rolls to the next calendar period.

concepts.name: EFET master agreement
concepts.scope: Standard European Federation of Energy Traders framework contract governing the terms and conditions of bilateral OTC energy trades.

concepts.name: Clean Spark Spread (CSS)
concepts.scope: The margin earned by a gas-fired power plant after deducting fuel and carbon costs from the electricity sale price.

concepts.name: Merit order
concepts.scope: The dispatch ranking of generation technologies by short-run marginal cost, determining which plants run at any given demand level.

concepts.name: Short-Run Marginal Cost (SRMC)
concepts.scope: The variable cost of producing one additional MWh, used to position a plant in the merit order.

concepts.name: Capacity mechanism / capacity market
concepts.scope: A regulatory scheme that remunerates generators for making capacity available during peak periods, separate from energy market revenues.

concepts.name: Missing money problem
concepts.scope: The shortfall between a plant's fixed costs and the revenues it earns from the energy market alone, which capacity payments are designed to cover.

concepts.name: De-rated capacity
concepts.scope: Installed capacity adjusted downward by a technology-specific availability factor to reflect realistic contribution to meeting peak demand.

concepts.name: Reserve margin
concepts.scope: The buffer of de-rated generation capacity above peak demand that measures security of supply adequacy.

concepts.name: Ancillary services (primary, secondary, tertiary reserve)
concepts.scope: Grid-balancing products procured by the TSO to maintain frequency and voltage stability across different response timeframes.

concepts.name: EU Emissions Trading System (EU ETS) and Market Stability Reserve (MSR)
concepts.scope: The EU cap-and-trade carbon market and its supply-correction mechanism intended to reduce the permit surplus and support carbon prices.

concepts.name: European Union Allowances (EUAs)
concepts.scope: Carbon permits traded under the EU ETS, whose price directly affects the marginal cost and dispatch of fossil-fuel generators.

concepts.name: Thermal sensitivity
concepts.scope: The responsiveness of electricity demand to temperature changes, measured in MW per degree Celsius, which drives peak load requirements.

concepts.name: CCGT efficiency (LHV / HHV)
concepts.scope: The ratio of electrical output to fuel energy input measured on a lower or higher heating value basis, indicating how economically a plant converts gas to power.

concepts.name: European Power Exchange (EPEX Spot)
concepts.scope: The day-ahead and intraday electricity exchange serving France, Germany, Austria, Switzerland and Luxembourg used for spot price discovery.

concepts.name: Equivalent Operating Hours (EOH)
concepts.scope: A wear-adjusted measure of turbine running time that governs maintenance intervals and long-term service agreement milestones.

concepts.name: Long-Term Service Agreement (LTSA) vs full O&M contract
concepts.scope: Alternative contractual structures for turbine maintenance, differing in scope, cost certainty, and flexibility over the plant's life.

concepts.name: Intra-month gas volatility and correlation
concepts.scope: Statistical measures of short-term price variability and co-movement between gas spot prices used to value gas-fired plant optionality.

concepts.name: European Toll (gas-to-power tolling contract)
concepts.scope: A structured arrangement in which a counterparty pays a fixed tolling fee to access a power plant's conversion capacity, transferring commodity exposure.

concepts.name: Coal-to-gas switching price
concepts.scope: The gas price level at which a gas-fired plant becomes cheaper to dispatch than a coal plant, marking the inter-fuel competitive inflexion point.

concepts.name: Regulated Asset Base (RAB) remuneration
concepts.scope: The regulatory framework under which transmission and distribution network owners earn returns on their capital invested in grid infrastructure.

concepts.name: ARENH (Accès Régulé à l'Énergie Nucléaire Historique)
concepts.scope: The French obligation requiring EDF to sell up to 25% of its nuclear output to alternative suppliers at a regulated price of €42/MWh.

concepts.name: Achieved Electricity Price
concepts.scope: The blended power price realised by a merchant plant capturing both intrinsic and extrinsic optionality across dispatch periods.

concepts.name: Extrinsic (Optionality) Value of a CCGT
concepts.scope: The additional value arising from a plant's ability to selectively dispatch only when the clean spark spread is positive, truncating downside.

concepts.name: French Capacity Market (CM)
concepts.scope: A mechanism requiring suppliers to hold certified capacity certificates proportional to customer peak consumption, creating a revenue stream for generators.

concepts.name: Capacity Certificate / Capacity Price
concepts.scope: A tradable instrument issued to certified capacity providers conferring entitlement to capacity market revenues, priced per kW of de-rated capacity.

concepts.name: Merit Order Dispatch
concepts.scope: The stack-based ranking of generation units by short-run marginal cost that determines which plants set the wholesale price in each settlement period.

concepts.name: Nuclear Infra-Marginal Rent
concepts.scope: The profit accruing to low-marginal-cost nuclear capacity when higher-cost gas plants set the wholesale price.

concepts.name: Load Factor
concepts.scope: The ratio of actual energy generated to maximum possible generation over a period, reflecting dispatch intensity.

concepts.name: Gross Margin (Power Plant)
concepts.scope: Plant revenues less all variable costs including fuel, carbon and variable O&M, before fixed costs.

concepts.name: EBITDA (Power Asset)
concepts.scope: Gross margin less fixed operating costs, taxes and overhead, used as the primary cash-flow metric for asset valuation.

concepts.name: Long-Term Service Agreement (LTSA)
concepts.scope: A reduced-scope post-major-inspection maintenance contract covering key rotating components with a lower fixed-fee structure than a full O&M agreement.

concepts.name: Full O&M Contract
concepts.scope: A comprehensive outsourced operations and maintenance agreement under which the contractor assumes responsibility for daily operation, planned and unplanned maintenance.

concepts.name: Hot / Warm / Cold Start
concepts.scope: Classification of plant restart events by cooling state, each implying different start times, gas consumption, lost output and incremental EOH accrual.

concepts.name: Forced Outage Rate
concepts.scope: The probability that a generating unit is unavailable due to unplanned mechanical failure during any given period.

concepts.name: LHV Thermal Efficiency
concepts.scope: The ratio of net electrical output to fuel energy input measured on a lower heating value basis, the standard efficiency metric for gas-fired plant.

concepts.name: Heat Rate (Degraded)
concepts.scope: The actual fuel input required per unit of electrical output, adjusted upward over time for turbine performance deterioration and off-design operation.

concepts.name: Ancillary Services Revenue
concepts.scope: Payments received for providing frequency containment reserve, automatic frequency restoration and voltage regulation services to the system operator.

concepts.name: EU Emissions Trading Scheme (EU ETS)
concepts.scope: A cap-and-trade carbon market requiring generators to surrender one EU Allowance per tonne of CO2 emitted, directly affecting variable generation costs.

concepts.name: Market Stability Reserve (MSR)
concepts.scope: A structural EU ETS reform mechanism withdrawing surplus allowances from circulation to reduce the allowance backlog and support the carbon price.

concepts.name: Carbon Cost Pass-Through
concepts.scope: The inclusion of EUA surrender costs in the short-run marginal cost of thermal generation, causing carbon prices to shift the merit order and wholesale power prices.

concepts.name: IEA World Energy Outlook Scenarios
concepts.scope: Long-run commodity price trajectories (New Policies, Current Policies, 450 ppm) used as anchor points for gas, coal and carbon price forecasting.

concepts.name: French Nuclear Fleet Age Profile
concepts.scope: The distribution of installed nuclear capacity by years of operation, determining decommissioning timelines and future capacity margin stress.

concepts.name: Nuclear Decommissioning Schedule
concepts.scope: The planned retirement of nuclear units to meet the policy target of reducing nuclear's share of French generation to 50% by 2025.

concepts.name: Thermal Sensitivity / Peak Demand
concepts.scope: The temperature-driven component of electricity demand that causes French peak load to nearly double in cold weather due to widespread electric heating.

concepts.name: GDP–Electricity Demand Elasticity
concepts.scope: The proportional relationship between economic output growth and electricity consumption used to project long-run demand trajectories.

concepts.name: Wholesale Power Price Forecast
concepts.scope: A forward projection of baseload electricity prices driven by commodity costs, carbon prices, capacity margins and the merit order of new-build plant.

concepts.name: Renewable Intermittency and Back-Up Requirement
concepts.scope: The structural need for dispatchable thermal capacity, chiefly CCGT, to firm intermittent wind and solar output and underpin system adequacy.

concepts.name: EPEX Spot / PEGAS Market Access
concepts.scope: Direct membership of day-ahead, intraday electricity and gas exchange platforms enabling a plant to trade without an intermediary broker.

concepts.name: Hedging / Forward Power Sales
concepts.scope: Pre-selling future electricity output at fixed prices to reduce revenue uncertainty, with the trade-off of foregoing upside if spot prices rise.

concepts.name: Capacity Margin
concepts.scope: The reserve of generation capacity above peak demand that determines scarcity pricing, new-build incentives and capacity market clearing prices.

concepts.name: Variable O&M Cost
concepts.scope: Output-linked operating expenditure expressed per MWh generated, covering consumables, minor maintenance and start-related costs.

concepts.name: Fixed O&M Cost
concepts.scope: Time-based plant operating expenditure incurred regardless of output, including the fixed component of the Siemens O&M contract fee.

concepts.name: Imbalance Cost
concepts.scope: The financial penalty incurred when metered generation deviates from contracted or notified position within the balancing mechanism.

concepts.name: Merchant Basis Operation
concepts.scope: Generation without long-term offtake contracts, exposing the plant fully to spot and forward market price risk and reward.

concepts.name: Capacity De-Rating Factor
concepts.scope: A regulatory adjustment reducing a plant's certified capacity below nameplate to reflect statistical availability in peak conditions.

concepts.name: Contract for Difference (CfD) – Capacity Market
concepts.scope: A seven-year CfD mechanism available to new entrants in the French capacity market providing price certainty to support investment decisions.

concepts.name: Demand Side Response (DSR)
concepts.scope: Flexible load reduction by consumers that can substitute for generation capacity in the capacity market, dampening capacity price formation.

concepts.name: Distributed Control System (DCS)
concepts.scope: A plant-wide automation and supervisory system centralising real-time control, monitoring and historical data logging for all generating unit subsystems.

concepts.name: Heat Recovery Steam Generator (HRSG)
concepts.scope: A triple-pressure reheat boiler recovering exhaust heat from the gas turbine to drive a steam turbine, constituting the combined-cycle efficiency gain.

concepts.name: Single-Shaft CCGT Configuration
concepts.scope: An arrangement coupling gas turbine, steam turbine and generator on a common shaft with a synchronous self-shifting clutch, simplifying start sequences.

concepts.name: Toll / tolling structure
concepts.scope: Revenue arrangement for gas-fired generation separating fuel cost from electricity revenue streams.

concepts.name: Gross margin
concepts.scope: Plant-level revenue net of all variable costs including fuel, carbon, variable O&M, imbalance and start costs.

concepts.name: EBITDA
concepts.scope: Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation used as the primary profitability metric for power plant assets.

concepts.name: Pre-tax unlevered free cash flow (UFCF)
concepts.scope: Operating cash flow before financing and tax, derived from EBITDA adjusted for capex, working capital and non-cash variable costs.

concepts.name: Capacity payments
concepts.scope: Fixed periodic revenues received by generators for making capacity available to the grid under a capacity mechanism.

concepts.name: Fuel and carbon costs
concepts.scope: Variable generation costs comprising natural gas consumption and EU ETS CO2 allowance purchases.

concepts.name: Variable O&M costs
concepts.scope: Output-linked operation and maintenance expenditure varying with generation volume and number of starts.

concepts.name: Start cost
concepts.scope: Incremental wear and fuel cost incurred each time a gas turbine is started, modelled per start event.

concepts.name: Long Term Service Agreement (LTSA)
concepts.scope: Narrower OEM service contract covering only specified components, typically at lower fixed cost than a full O&M.

concepts.name: Major inspection / HGPI maintenance cycle
concepts.scope: Scheduled heavy overhaul events at defined EOH intervals that drive lumpy capital expenditure and planned outage days.

concepts.name: Plant availability
concepts.scope: Percentage of time a plant is technically available after deducting planned and unplanned outage periods.

concepts.name: Net electrical efficiency
concepts.scope: Ratio of net electrical output to fuel energy input on a higher or lower heating value basis.

concepts.name: Days Sales Outstanding (DSO)
concepts.scope: Working capital metric measuring average collection period for trade receivables in days of sales.

concepts.name: Days Payables Outstanding (DPO)
concepts.scope: Working capital metric measuring average payment period for trade payables in days of purchases.

concepts.name: Plant fixed cost structure
concepts.scope: Fixed recurring costs comprising OEM fees, connection and capacity charges, personnel, local taxes and HQ overhead.

concepts.name: Cotisation Foncière des Entreprises (CFE)
concepts.scope: French local business tax levied on fixed assets, forming part of a power plant's fixed tax burden.

concepts.name: Gas supply agreement
concepts.scope: Contractual arrangement for firm natural gas procurement at defined terms, modelled as an annual payment in gross margin.

concepts.name: Maintenance capex
concepts.scope: Capital expenditure required to fund scheduled inspection and overhaul events tied to the EOH maintenance cycle.

concepts.name: Nominal vs real cash flow projection
concepts.scope: Distinction between projections stated in current-year prices (real) and projections inflated to the year of occurrence (nominal).

concepts.name: Consolidated financials
concepts.scope: Aggregation of individual plant-level P&L and cash flow statements into a single group-level financial model.

methods: Normalization of price data (time and location)
De-rated capacity and reserve margin analysis
Historical load factor and gross margin analysis
Intra-month volatility uplift for option valuation

EOH-based maintenance scheduling and cost allocation

Imbalance cost estimation from running profile
Working capital optimisation via milestone-based payment restructuring
Discounted cash flow (DCF) / unlevered free cash flow modelling
Nominal financial projections with inflation adjustment
Scenario comparison of O&M vs LTSA cost structures
Operating profile simulation (availability, load factor, efficiency)

Basic electricity market structure (generation, transmission, distribution, supply)

Basic thermodynamics and combined-cycle plant operation
