EU ETS mechanics and carbon pricing
Commodity markets (gas, coal, carbon forward curves)
French energy regulation (ASN, CRE, RTE, GRTgaz)
Options pricing intuition (intrinsic vs. extrinsic value)
French electricity market structure (RTE, GRTgaz, capacity mechanism)
M&A process and confidential information memorandum conventions

power_german_i_c.topic: German industrial & commercial power supply: operations setup, balancing-group management, load forecasting, tranche procurement and imbalance pricing

concepts.name: Balancing Group (Bilanzkreis)
concepts.scope: A virtual energy account registered with a TSO into which all supply and offtake volumes of a market participant must be allocated to achieve settlement balance.

concepts.name: Balancing Group Coordinator (TSO role)
concepts.scope: The transmission system operator acting as administrator of balancing groups, responsible for invoicing imbalance energy to market participants within each control area.

concepts.name: Control Area (Regelzone)
concepts.scope: One of four geographically defined high-voltage network zones in Germany, each operated by a separate TSO, determining where energy schedules and imbalance settlement apply.

concepts.name: MaBiS (Marktprozesse für die Bilanzierung Strom)
concepts.scope: The regulatory framework governing pre- and post-monthly processing, time-series allocation, and invoicing of supplier and balancing-group energy volumes with TSOs.

concepts.name: GPKE (Geschäftsprozesse zur Kundenbelieferung mit Elektrizität)
concepts.scope: Standardised business processes mandated by the Bundesnetzagentur for registering and de-registering end customers with distribution system operators.

concepts.name: Standard Load Profile (SLP)
concepts.scope: A synthetic consumption time series assigned to small customers without interval metering, used by suppliers and balancing-group managers for forecasting and settlement.

concepts.name: Daily Parameter-Dependent Load Profile (TLP)
concepts.scope: A load profile adjusted each day by external parameters such as temperature, used for medium-consumption customers whose metered data is not read in real time.

concepts.name: Registered Power Measurement (RLM)
concepts.scope: Interval metering applied to large industrial customers, providing actual 15-minute consumption data for scheduling and settlement rather than synthetic profiles.

concepts.name: Load Forecasting
concepts.scope: The process of predicting customer consumption at 15-minute resolution ahead of delivery to generate trading and scheduling positions and minimise balancing energy costs.

concepts.name: Scheduling (Fahrplanmanagement)
concepts.scope: The regulated daily communication process of nominating energy volume time series to TSOs for each control area ahead of and during the delivery day.

concepts.name: Intraday 15-Minute Contract Trading
concepts.scope: The sub-process of buying or selling 15-minute structured power products on intraday markets to close residual portfolio imbalances that cannot be offset by day-ahead positions.

concepts.name: REBAP (Regelenergiebeschaffungs- und Abrechnungsprozess / Imbalance Price)
concepts.scope: The German balancing energy price time series published by the TSOs' grid control cooperation, reflecting the cost of deviations between scheduled and actual energy volumes.

concepts.name: Horizontal Tranche Procurement
concepts.scope: A structured forward-buying strategy in which annual baseload volume is divided into equally-shaped tranches purchased incrementally over time at EEX forward market prices.

concepts.name: Asian Option on Power
concepts.scope: An option whose payoff depends on the arithmetic average of the underlying power price over the option period, used here for calendar-year electricity hedges with separate call and put volatilities.

concepts.name: Transportation Pass-Through (TPT)
concepts.scope: A contractual clause shifting the financial risk of grid-use charges directly to the end customer, eliminating the supplier's exposure to changes in distribution network tariffs.

concepts.name: Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) Costing
concepts.scope: A staffing and cost-estimation method that converts operational time requirements into standardised headcount units to quantify personnel expenditure for new business processes.

concepts.name: Make-or-Buy / Outsourcing Assessment
concepts.scope: A structured evaluation framework applying company-specific and company-independent criteria to determine whether operational processes should be insourced or contracted to third parties.

concepts.name: ETRM System (Energy Trading and Risk Management)
concepts.scope: An integrated software platform, here Aligne, that serves as the central database for trade capture, position management, and downstream data provision across operations systems.

concepts.name: Demand-Supply Balancing
concepts.scope: The process of monitoring contracted supply and demand volumes, identifying deviations, and reporting balancing energy exposure including ex-post analysis of spot and imbalance volumes.

concepts.name: DSO Contract and Grid Registration
concepts.scope: The legal and operational process by which a supplier concludes framework agreements with distribution system operators and registers or de-registers metering points under GPKE.

concepts.name: Market Roles (Marktrollen)
concepts.scope: The legally defined participant categories in the German power market—supplier, balancing group manager, distribution system operator, TSO—each carrying distinct contractual and regulatory obligations.

concepts.name: Balancing Energy (Regelenergie)
concepts.scope: Energy activated by TSOs to correct real-time deviations between scheduled and actual power flows, charged back to the responsible balancing group at REBAP prices.

concepts.name: StromNZV / StromNEV Compliance
concepts.scope: Adherence to the German Electricity Grid Access Ordinance and Grid Charge Ordinance governing entry conditions, network access rights, and tariff structures for power market participants.

methods: Asian option pricing with separate call/put volatilities
FTE-based personnel cost estimation (gross and net with synergy adjustment)
System landscape evaluation and module cost estimation
Process mapping and contract life-cycle analysis
implied_prerequisites: German power market structure and regulatory framework (StromNZV, StromNEV, EnWG)
Balancing group mechanics and TSO settlement processes
Energy trading fundamentals (spot, forward, intraday markets)
Load profile types (SLP, TLP, RLM) and their use in settlement
Basic options pricing concepts (call/put, implied volatility)
German energy law and Bundesnetzagentur regulatory regime

power_imbalancing_calc.topic: Imbalance Cost and Settlement Calculation for Renewable and CHP Assets

concepts.name: Imbalance settlement
concepts.scope: Covers the financial settlement of deviations between metered generation and contracted position under national balancing regimes.

concepts.name: Cashout price
concepts.scope: Covers the per-unit price applied to imbalance volumes at the time of settlement, including single and dual cashout price structures.

concepts.name: Wind forecast error
concepts.scope: Covers the difference between predicted and metered wind output used as the primary source of imbalance exposure.

concepts.name: Solar generation shape
concepts.scope: Covers the intraday profile of solar PV output used to construct forecast and metered position for settlement purposes.

concepts.name: Portfolio netting
concepts.scope: Covers the aggregation of multiple generation assets within a single balancing responsible party position to reduce net imbalance exposure.

concepts.name: Bootstrap resampling for imbalance risk
concepts.scope: Covers statistical resampling of historical imbalance price and volume data to estimate tail-risk metrics such as P99 imbalance cost.

concepts.name: Balancing Mechanism Reporting Service (BMRS) data
concepts.scope: Covers the use of National Grid's BMRS data feed as the source for settlement prices and system-length signals in GB imbalance calculations.

concepts.name: Day-ahead forecast versus actual dispatch
concepts.scope: Covers the comparison of day-ahead market scheduling against real-time metered output to compute imbalance volumes.

concepts.name: Intraday forecast updating
concepts.scope: Covers the revision of generation forecasts within the trading day to reduce imbalance exposure before gate closure.

concepts.name: Demand-side management imbalance
concepts.scope: Covers the calculation of imbalance arising from industrial and commercial demand response not matching contracted curtailment volumes.

concepts.name: Waste CHP imbalance
concepts.scope: Covers the settlement exposure specific to combined heat and power plants dispatched on thermal load rather than market signal.

concepts.name: Balancing responsible party (BRP) position
concepts.scope: Covers the aggregated nominated schedule that a BRP submits to the TSO against which imbalance is measured.

concepts.name: CO2 price pass-through in price modelling
concepts.scope: Covers the incorporation of carbon allowance costs into power price models used as inputs to imbalance revenue calculations.

concepts.name: TTF gas price as power price driver
concepts.scope: Covers the use of Dutch TTF natural gas prices to derive marginal cost benchmarks within power imbalance price models.

concepts.name: Cross-border asset comparison
concepts.scope: Covers the evaluation of the same physical asset under different national imbalance regimes to identify the optimal contracting jurisdiction.

concepts.name: P99 imbalance cost metric
concepts.scope: Covers the 99th-percentile worst-case imbalance cost derived from bootstrapped or simulated price-volume distributions.

concepts.name: Half-hourly settlement period
concepts.scope: Covers the GB-specific 30-minute settlement interval used to align generation metering with imbalance price windows.

concepts.name: Simulated future market scenarios
concepts.scope: Covers forward-looking price and volume scenarios (e.g. 2025, 2030) used to project imbalance costs under anticipated market conditions.

methods: Time-series aggregation of metered vs forecast volumes
Regression-based power price modelling from gas and CO2 inputs
implied_prerequisites: Wind and solar generation forecasting fundamentals
European power market structure (GB, NL, BE, DE, FR)
Gas and carbon market price linkages

concepts.name: Energy Management Partnership
concepts.scope: A structured commercial arrangement whereby a trading counterparty provides market access, optimisation, and capital services to a generation asset owner.

concepts.name: Clean Spark Spread (CSS)
concepts.scope: The margin of a gas-fired generator after deducting fuel and carbon costs from the power sale price.

concepts.name: Tolling Agreement
concepts.scope: A contract granting a counterparty the right to dispatch a generation asset in exchange for a premium, transferring commodity price risk to the toller.

concepts.name: Virtual Power Plant (VPP)
concepts.scope: A financial or physical construct that replicates generation asset optionality without direct ownership of the plant.

concepts.name: CSS Option (Daily/Seasonal)
concepts.scope: An option whose payoff is linked to the clean spark spread, exercisable on a daily or seasonal basis to capture CCGT dispatch optionality.

concepts.name: CSS Put Option
concepts.scope: A derivative instrument providing the generator with downside margin protection when the clean spark spread falls below a strike level.

concepts.name: Short-Term Optimisation
concepts.scope: The active trading of intraday, day-ahead, and near-forward markets to extract incremental value from generation asset flexibility.

concepts.name: Long-Term Value Optimisation
concepts.scope: Multi-year structural arrangements such as tolling or VPPs designed to monetise asset optionality and stabilise cash flows over an extended horizon.

concepts.name: Merchant Operation
concepts.scope: Generation capacity operated without long-term hedging, with output optimised opportunistically against prevailing spot and short-term market prices.

concepts.name: Gas Supply Agreement (PEG-N linked)
concepts.scope: A physical gas supply contract indexed to the Powernext PEG-N day-ahead price providing volume flexibility without take-or-pay obligations.

concepts.name: Capacity Certificates Market
concepts.scope: A French regulatory mechanism creating tradeable certificates representing committed generation capacity to ensure system adequacy.

concepts.name: Balancing Responsibility
concepts.scope: The obligation of a market participant to ensure that energy injections and withdrawals remain in balance within a defined settlement period.

concepts.name: Profit Sharing Mechanism
concepts.scope: A contractual feature allowing the asset owner to participate in upside margins above a pre-specified spread level alongside the trading counterparty.

concepts.name: Mezzanine Debt
concepts.scope: A hybrid capital instrument ranking between senior debt and equity, used here as a potential capital provision structure within the partnership.

concepts.name: Working Capital Facility
concepts.scope: A credit arrangement embedded in trading or tolling agreements to fund operational liquidity requirements of the generation asset.

concepts.name: EFET M+1 D20 Payment Terms
concepts.scope: Standard European Federation of Energy Traders settlement terms specifying payment 20 days after the end of the delivery month.

concepts.name: Extension Option (Tolling)
concepts.scope: A pre-agreed right embedded in a tolling contract allowing one party to extend the agreement at-the-money beyond the initial term at a premium fixed at inception.

concepts.name: Spark/Dark/Country Spreads
concepts.scope: Margin measures for gas-fired and coal-fired generation respectively, and cross-border power price differentials used as trading benchmarks.

implied_prerequisites: Natural gas market structure and European hubs
Energy trading credit and collateral management

power_landivisiau.topic: CCGT tolling agreements and power plant project finance

concepts.name: Tolling agreement
concepts.scope: A contract whereby a generator makes plant capacity available to a toller who bears all commodity price risk in exchange for a fixed capacity charge.

concepts.name: Capacity charge (tolling fee)
concepts.scope: The periodic fixed payment made by the toller to the generator covering capital cost recovery and fixed O&M, structured as a function of Deemed Available Capacity.

concepts.name: Deemed Available Capacity (DAC)
concepts.scope: An ambient-condition-adjusted measure of the capacity actually made available by the generator to the toller in each settlement period.

concepts.name: Capacity premium (public subsidy)
concepts.scope: A government-contracted availability-linked payment per MW per year to the project company, forming the primary revenue floor for the plant.

concepts.name: French capacity market
concepts.scope: A market mechanism issuing capacity certificates whose revenues are deducted from the public capacity premium received by the project company.

concepts.name: Spark spread / clean spark spread
concepts.scope: The margin between the electricity price and the cost of gas and CO2 required to generate it, representing the toller's market opportunity.

concepts.name: Dark spread equivalent / heat rate
concepts.scope: Plant efficiency expressed as HHV percentage, used to convert gas input cost to electricity output cost for dispatch economics.

concepts.name: Equivalent Operating Hour (EOH)
concepts.scope: A unit measuring turbine wear that weights operating hours by stress level, used to calculate variable maintenance costs and start/stop costs.

concepts.name: Plant degradation curve
concepts.scope: Tabulated factors showing how power output and heat rate deteriorate with cumulative operating hours between major overhauls.

concepts.name: Ambient condition correction factors
concepts.scope: Temperature- and humidity-dependent multipliers applied to nameplate capacity and efficiency to reflect actual site meteorological conditions.

concepts.name: Start classification and costs
concepts.scope: Categorisation of turbine starts (hot, hot-warm, warm, cold) by time since shutdown, each with distinct duration, efficiency and EOH cost.

concepts.name: Guaranteed Available Capacity / Annual Guaranteed Availability
concepts.scope: Contractual performance floors below which the generator incurs liquidated-damage penalties to the toller.

concepts.name: Energy manager role
concepts.scope: An intermediary entity responsible for plant programming, balancing, gas/electricity shipping, ancillary service participation and capacity certificate management on behalf of co-tollers.

concepts.name: Co-toller structure
concepts.scope: A multi-party tolling arrangement where several tollers share reserved capacity and jointly bear imbalance and outage risk.

concepts.name: Non-recourse project finance
concepts.scope: A debt structure where lender recourse is limited to project assets and cash flows, requiring direct agreements with contractual counterparties.

concepts.name: Debt-to-equity ratio in power project finance
concepts.scope: The leverage ratio (here 70:30) used to fund CAPEX, influencing required tolling fee levels and lender covenant terms.

concepts.name: CSPE (contribution to the public service of electricity)
concepts.scope: A French levy funding public-service obligations including the capacity premium paid to the project company via EDF.

concepts.name: PEG Nord day-ahead gas price
concepts.scope: The French northern gas hub spot price used as the floating fuel cost reference in the tolling variable cost pass-through.

concepts.name: ICE ECX CO2 price
concepts.scope: The EU ETS carbon allowance closing price used to calculate the CO2 variable cost passed through in the tolling structure.

concepts.name: Electricity injection costs
concepts.scope: Network use-of-system charges payable to RTE per MWh injected, treated as a variable pass-through cost in the tolling agreement.

concepts.name: Day-ahead power price modelling
concepts.scope: Hourly fundamental stack-based simulation of French wholesale electricity prices using demand, nuclear, hydro and interconnector sub-models.

concepts.name: Nuclear availability modelling
concepts.scope: Historical-data-based generation availability curves for French nuclear fleet used as a key input in the power price model.

concepts.name: Hydro dispatch modelling (RoR, reservoir, pumped storage)
concepts.scope: Sub-models representing run-of-river, reservoir and pumped-storage hydro dispatch strategies as inputs to the French power price simulation.

concepts.name: Interconnector import constraint
concepts.scope: A scenario assumption limiting cross-border imports in winter to reflect correlated demand peaks across neighbouring markets.

concepts.name: ENTSO-E scenario framework
concepts.scope: Published long-run capacity and demand scenarios (Constrained Progress, National Green Transition) used to bracket future French power price projections.

concepts.name: Maintenance schedule (minor / hot gas path / major overhaul)
concepts.scope: A tiered outage programme at defined cumulative operating-hour intervals driving planned unavailability and maintenance cost in the tolling model.

concepts.name: Reliability Run period
concepts.scope: An initial commissioning phase during which the toller may dispatch the plant but generator performance guarantees are not yet in force.

concepts.name: Delay liquidated damages
concepts.scope: Pre-agreed daily penalties payable by the generator if the scheduled commercial operation date is not achieved within a defined grace period.

concepts.name: Force majeure allocation
concepts.scope: Contractual provisions defining which party bears risk and cost when plant unavailability results from events outside either party's control.

concepts.name: Inflation indexation of capacity charge
concepts.scope: An escalation mechanism linking the fixed O&M component of the capacity charge to a basket of price indices over the contract term.

concepts.name: Capacity charge
concepts.scope: A fixed monthly payment made by the toller to the generator to reserve plant generation capacity, covering fixed costs and debt service regardless of dispatch.

concepts.name: Variable charge
concepts.scope: A monthly payment linked to Toller Equivalent Operating Hours, variable O&M rate, and an inflation escalator, compensating the generator for wear-and-tear from actual operation.

concepts.name: Equivalent Operating Hours (EOH)
concepts.scope: A normalised measure of plant utilisation that aggregates dispatch hours, start-related wear, trip penalties, and top-up hours to track maintenance interval consumption.

concepts.name: Toller Equivalent Operating Hours (TEOH)
concepts.scope: The portion of total EOH attributed to the toller, comprising dispatch hours, start EOH, trip EOH up to a cap, and top-up EOH, forming the basis of the variable charge.

concepts.name: Top-up EOH
concepts.scope: Unused EOH credited to the toller when maintenance is brought forward or insufficient dispatch would otherwise waste the remaining interval before a scheduled outage.

concepts.name: Guaranteed Available Capacity
concepts.scope: The contractually guaranteed net electrical output (MW) that the generator must make available to the toller under standard ambient conditions.

concepts.name: Guaranteed Efficiency / Guaranteed Heat Rate
concepts.scope: The minimum contractual thermal efficiency (or equivalent heat rate) of the plant at standard ambient conditions, against which tested performance is benchmarked.

concepts.name: Tested Efficiency
concepts.scope: The actual plant efficiency established by pre-commercial performance tests, with shortfalls relative to guaranteed efficiency triggering liquidated damage payments.

concepts.name: Declared Available Capacity
concepts.scope: The capacity the generator notifies as available for dispatch in each settlement period, capping what the toller may nominate.

concepts.name: Minimum Stable Generation (MSG)
concepts.scope: The lowest generation level at which the plant can operate stably, defining the floor for toller dispatch nominations.

concepts.name: Dispatch nomination
concepts.scope: The toller's instruction to the generator, submitted after day-ahead market close, specifying desired output for each settlement period of the following day.

concepts.name: Plant start types (cold / warm / hot / ambient)
concepts.scope: Classifications of plant restarts by prior shutdown duration, each with distinct start durations, fuel consumption, electricity production profiles, and EOH charges.

concepts.name: Scheduled maintenance period
concepts.scope: Planned outage windows triggered by accumulated EOH thresholds (minor, HGPI, major overhaul), during which the capacity charge continues to be paid up to an agreed maximum duration.

concepts.name: Equivalent Availability Factor
concepts.scope: An annual guaranteed availability metric that accounts for both planned and forced outage durations as a percentage of total possible operating hours.

concepts.name: Pass-through costs
concepts.scope: Specified network, nomination, and administrative charges incurred by the generator or energy manager that are recharged to the toller at cost without margin.

concepts.name: Pass-through revenues
concepts.scope: Imbalance, intraday optimisation, and ancillary-service revenues collected by the energy manager that are credited directly back to the toller.

concepts.name: CO2 allowance transfer mechanism
concepts.scope: A monthly netting arrangement under which the toller delivers EUAs sufficient for actual dispatch, with penalties to the toller for any shortfall causing generator regulatory non-compliance.

concepts.name: Capacity premium (mécanisme de capacité)
concepts.scope: A French state-awarded payment of €94,000/MW/year for 20 years, forming the primary revenue stream for the generator and partially offset by capacity market revenues.

concepts.name: Inflation escalation factor (ESCV / ESCC)
concepts.scope: Index-linked multipliers applied to variable and capacity charges to adjust payments for changes in a basket of inflation indices since a reference date.

concepts.name: Degradation correction factors
concepts.scope: Tabulated multipliers applied to measured power output and heat rate as a function of cumulative EOH to reflect progressive performance deterioration between overhauls.

concepts.name: Performance correction curves
concepts.scope: Engineering functions that adjust measured plant output and heat rate for deviations in ambient temperature, pressure, humidity, fuel LHV, grid frequency, and inlet pressure drop.

concepts.name: Change-in-law pass-through
concepts.scope: A clause transferring to the toller incremental costs or revenue losses caused by legislative or regulatory changes, subject to a cumulative threshold and mitigation obligation.

concepts.name: Termination payment (NPV-based)
concepts.scope: Upon generator-triggered termination, the toller owes the net present value of remaining capacity and fixed O&M charges assuming full guaranteed availability for the remaining term.

concepts.name: Payment security / letter of credit
concepts.scope: Collateral equivalent to 12 months of projected capacity and variable charges that the toller must maintain in favour of the generator throughout the agreement.

concepts.name: Non-recourse project finance / lender direct agreement
concepts.scope: A financing structure where lenders have security only over project assets, requiring toller cooperation and a direct agreement that governs lender step-in and assignment rights.

concepts.name: Reliability Run
concepts.scope: A 22-day phased commissioning test demonstrating sustained plant operability within defined forced-outage frequency and duration limits before the commercial start date.

concepts.name: Spark spread / dark spread
concepts.scope: The margin between electricity prices and fuel (gas or coal) costs per MWh of generation, used to assess plant intrinsic value and tolling fee affordability.

concepts.name: Forward curve modelling (power, gas, CO2)
concepts.scope: Construction of long-term price paths for French power, PEG-N gas, and EUA CO2 markets out to 2030, used to value the tolling option and set the capacity charge.

concepts.name: Plant intrinsic value (KyPlant / stochastic dispatch model)
concepts.scope: The expected net present value of optimal dispatch decisions given a set of forward curves, capturing the option value embedded in the tolling arrangement.

concepts.name: CCGT dispatch optimisation
concepts.scope: Determination of profit-maximising operating decisions (start, run, stop) for a combined-cycle plant subject to technical constraints including ramp rates, minimum run times, and start costs.

concepts.name: Ramp rates and minimum on/off times
concepts.scope: Plant technical parameters constraining how quickly output can change and how long the unit must run or remain offline, directly affecting dispatchable value and EOH accumulation.

methods: Fundamental power price simulation (merit-order stack dispatch)
Hourly demand profile construction from historical data
Nuclear availability curve estimation from historical generation data
Dynamic interconnector flow modelling with price-based arbitrage
Scenario analysis (Constrained Progress vs National Green Transition)
Back-testing / model validation against historical day-ahead prices
Ambient condition correction factor interpolation (temperature/humidity grid)
Plant degradation factor interpolation from operating-hours table
Project finance cash flow modelling (EBITDA, debt sizing)

Capacity charge benchmarking across market scenarios

EU ETS and CO2 allowance trading
Real options and energy asset valuation

power_limejump.topic: Power Purchase Agreement intermediation and back-to-back PPA structuring

concepts.name: Power Purchase Agreement (PPA)
concepts.scope: Contractual arrangement for the sale and purchase of electricity output from a generation asset, covering pricing, volume and term.

concepts.name: Back-to-back PPA
concepts.scope: Structure in which an intermediary passes through physical energy flows and pricing terms between a generator and an offtaker via two mirrored contracts.

concepts.name: Grid Trade Master Agreement (GTMA)
concepts.scope: Standard UK bilateral electricity trading master agreement governing the terms of individual power transactions between parties.

concepts.name: Imbalance risk
concepts.scope: The financial exposure arising from differences between contracted/nominated volumes and actual metered generation settled under the GB balancing mechanism.

concepts.name: ECVN / MVRN (Energy Contract Volume Notification / Metered Volume Reallocation Notification)
concepts.scope: Elexon notification mechanisms used to reallocate contracted and metered generation volumes between supplier licence holders in the SVA settlement process.

concepts.name: Supplier Volume Allocation (SVA)
concepts.scope: The GB half-hourly settlement process that allocates metered and nominated generation volumes to the relevant licensed electricity supplier.

concepts.name: MPAN (Meter Point Administration Number)
concepts.scope: Unique identifier for a UK electricity supply point used for registration, data flows and settlement.

concepts.name: Embedded benefits
concepts.scope: Financial payments accruing to embedded generators connected to distribution networks, including TNUoS triad avoidance and distribution use-of-system credits.

concepts.name: Renewable obligation certificates (ROCs)
concepts.scope: UK tradeable certificates issued to accredited renewable generators per MWh produced, used to demonstrate compliance with the Renewables Obligation.

concepts.name: Feed-in Tariff (FiT)
concepts.scope: UK government subsidy providing guaranteed generation and export payments to small-scale low-carbon generators below 5 MW.

concepts.name: Renewable Energy Guarantee of Origin (REGO)
concepts.scope: Certificate issued to renewable generators in GB certifying the renewable origin of each MWh for disclosure and marketing purposes.

concepts.name: Fixed-price PPA
concepts.scope: PPA variant in which the wholesale power price is locked at a specified £/MWh for the contract term, transferring market price risk to the offtaker.

concepts.name: Flexible / index PPA
concepts.scope: PPA variant in which the power price is linked to a market index with a pass-through percentage, retaining some price exposure for the generator.

concepts.name: Combination PPA
concepts.scope: PPA structure blending fixed-price ECVN/MCVN volumes with an index-linked product for the remaining metered volume.

concepts.name: Step-in rights
concepts.scope: Contractual mechanism allowing a creditworthy counterparty to assume the obligations of a defaulting intermediary and continue the PPA.

concepts.name: Know Your Customer (KYC) / due diligence
concepts.scope: Regulatory and counterparty credit checks performed on generators before entering into individual PPA transactions.

concepts.name: Credit support
concepts.scope: Security arrangements (parent company guarantee, investment-grade rating or debt instrument) required to underwrite counterparty obligations under each individual PPA.

concepts.name: Day-ahead nomination
concepts.scope: The process of submitting forecast generation volumes to Elexon on a day-ahead basis under the SVA settlement timetable.

concepts.name: R1 imbalance reconciliation
concepts.scope: First formal reconciliation of initial settlement imbalance charges issued by Elexon approximately two months after the delivery period.

concepts.name: Imbalance premium
concepts.scope: An additional charge included in PPA pricing to compensate the offtaker for bearing the financial risk of forecast versus actual generation imbalance.

concepts.name: Supplier licence registration
concepts.scope: The requirement for a licensed electricity supplier to register generation MPANs under its licence for settlement and billing purposes.

concepts.name: Self-billing invoice
concepts.scope: Invoice raised by the buyer on behalf of the seller, used here to pay the generator under the PPA without a separate generator invoice.

concepts.name: Generation forecasting
concepts.scope: Prediction of site-level and portfolio-level output used to produce nominations and manage imbalance exposure ahead of delivery.

methods: KYC and credit due diligence workflow
Step-in rights structuring for credit events
Quote generation with bid-offer spread management

Elexon SVA data flows and notification types
Renewables Obligation and FiT subsidy schemes

concepts.name: Power outright option valuation
concepts.scope: Pricing of plain-vanilla options on German baseload and peakload power forwards across multiple model versions.

concepts.name: Power spread valuation
concepts.scope: Mark-to-market and pricing of spread options (e.g. dark/spark spreads) on power and fuel combinations.

concepts.name: Baseload vs peakload price databases
concepts.scope: Structured daily time-series storage of NL baseload and peakload forward price data for model calibration and valuation.

concepts.name: Forward curve construction
concepts.scope: Building and maintaining power forward price curves used as inputs to option pricing models.

concepts.name: Volatility surface calibration
concepts.scope: Fitting implied volatility surfaces to observed market quotes for power options across strikes and tenors.

concepts.name: Mark-to-market (MtM) valuation
concepts.scope: Daily revaluation of power derivative positions against live or end-of-day market data.

concepts.name: Model versioning in valuation tools
concepts.scope: Iterative refinement of pricing model logic across successive spreadsheet releases to improve accuracy or scope.

concepts.name: Data download and templating
concepts.scope: Automated retrieval and standardised formatting of market data feeds for downstream valuation models.

implied_prerequisites: Basic stochastic processes for commodity prices

concepts.name: Locational spread option
concepts.scope: An option whose payoff depends on the price difference between power at two geographic locations.

concepts.name: Forward model simulation
concepts.scope: Monte Carlo simulation of forward power price curves across multiple maturities for multiple commodities.

concepts.name: Spot model simulation
concepts.scope: Simulation of hourly and daily spot power prices derived from forward curves, covering peak, off-peak, and base load segments.

concepts.name: Rolling products
concepts.scope: Standardised forward contracts reconstructed from simulated prices to have a fixed time-to-maturity at each simulation date.

concepts.name: Single volatility model
concepts.scope: Baseline spot price model assuming constant return volatility, used as a benchmark for likelihood-ratio model selection.

concepts.name: GARCH(1,1) model
concepts.scope: Time-varying volatility model for spot power returns where conditional variance follows an autoregressive moving-average process.

concepts.name: Jump diffusion model
concepts.scope: Spot price model augmenting continuous diffusion with a Poisson jump process to capture sudden price spikes.

concepts.name: Two-regime model with Normal spikes
concepts.scope: Regime-switching spot price model with two states where the spike regime has Normally distributed innovations.

concepts.name: Three-regime model with Normal spikes
concepts.scope: Extension of the two-regime model adding a third regime to better capture extreme spike behaviour.

concepts.name: Two-regime model with Poisson spikes
concepts.scope: Regime-switching spot price model where spike arrivals within the spike regime are governed by a Poisson process.

concepts.name: Likelihood ratio test
concepts.scope: Statistical test comparing nested spot price models to select the best-fitting specification at a given confidence level.

concepts.name: Cointegration parameters
concepts.scope: Parameters capturing the long-run equilibrium relationship between UK and French power spot prices.

concepts.name: Weekday seasonality weights
concepts.scope: Multiplicative factors adjusting simulated spot prices to reflect systematic intra-week demand patterns.

concepts.name: Spread analysis
concepts.scope: Post-simulation computation of statistical properties of price differences between the two power markets.

concepts.name: FX rate simulation
concepts.scope: Simulation of EUR/GBP exchange rates to convert French power prices into GBP-denominated equivalents.

concepts.name: Realized volatility
concepts.scope: Historical volatility computed from observed price returns and used to calibrate forward model parameters.

concepts.name: Simulated implied volatility and correlation
concepts.scope: Volatilities and correlations of rolling forward products derived from Monte Carlo paths for use in option pricing.

concepts.name: Locational spread
concepts.scope: The price differential between power at two geographic locations, here UK and French power markets.

concepts.name: Spot price regime-switching model
concepts.scope: A stochastic model that allows spot power prices to switch between distinct regimes capturing normal and spike behaviour.

concepts.name: GARCH(1,1) volatility model
concepts.scope: A time-varying volatility specification applied to power spot price returns to capture volatility clustering.

concepts.name: Cross-market price correlation
concepts.scope: The linear correlation between UK and French spot power price innovations used to model co-movement in the spread.

concepts.name: Forward curve simulation
concepts.scope: Monte Carlo generation of forward price paths for base, peak, and off-peak power contracts across future delivery months and years.

concepts.name: Rolling forward outputs
concepts.scope: Simulated forward price arrays organised by contract tenor (monthly, yearly) and updated on a rolling basis.

concepts.name: Spot-to-forward spread
concepts.scope: The simulated differential between spot and forward power prices used to value spread options between locations.

concepts.name: FX rate simulation (EUR/GBP)
concepts.scope: Stochastic simulation of the EUR/GBP exchange rate to convert UK GBP-denominated power prices into EUR for cross-market spread valuation.

concepts.name: Peak and off-peak price segmentation
concepts.scope: Separation of power prices into peak-hour and off-peak-hour products to reflect intraday demand and price structure.

concepts.name: Hourly spot power simulation
concepts.scope: Generation of simulated hourly spot prices over multi-year horizons for use in plant dispatch and spread option valuation.

concepts.name: Carbon (EUA) price input
concepts.scope: EU Emission Allowance futures prices used as an input commodity affecting power generation costs in the simulation model.

concepts.name: Coal (API2 ARA) price input
concepts.scope: API2 coal futures prices used as a fuel cost input within the power spot price simulation framework.

concepts.name: NBP gas price input
concepts.scope: UK National Balancing Point natural gas futures prices used as a fuel cost driver in the power simulation model.

concepts.name: Nodal Price Spread
concepts.scope: The difference in electricity prices between two nodes or hubs arising from transmission constraints and congestion.

concepts.name: Congestion Rent
concepts.scope: Revenue generated by the difference in locational marginal prices across a constrained transmission path.

concepts.name: Locational Marginal Price (LMP)
concepts.scope: The marginal cost of serving an additional unit of load at a specific network node, incorporating energy, congestion, and loss components.

concepts.name: Spread Option Pricing
concepts.scope: Valuation of options written on the difference between two correlated underlying asset prices.

concepts.name: Correlation Structure of Power Prices
concepts.scope: The joint statistical dependence between prices at different locations, critical for spread option valuation.

concepts.name: Monte Carlo Simulation for Spread Options
concepts.scope: Numerical pricing of spread options via simulation of correlated price paths across multiple nodes.

concepts.name: Mean Reversion in Power Prices
concepts.scope: The tendency of electricity spot prices to revert to a long-run equilibrium level, affecting spread dynamics.

concepts.name: Price Spike Modeling
concepts.scope: Capturing the extreme upward price excursions observed in electricity markets within a stochastic model.

concepts.name: Margrabe Formula
concepts.scope: Closed-form approximation for pricing exchange options (spread options with zero strike) under log-normal assumptions.

concepts.name: Kirk's Approximation
concepts.scope: An analytic approximation extending the Margrabe formula to spread options with a non-zero strike.

concepts.name: Transmission Congestion Contract (TCC) / Financial Transmission Right (FTR)
concepts.scope: Financial instruments whose payoff mirrors the congestion component of the locational spread, used for hedging transmission risk.

concepts.name: Basis Risk
concepts.scope: The residual risk arising from imperfect correlation between prices at two locations when using one location's instrument to hedge another.

concepts.name: Stochastic Volatility for Power Spreads
concepts.scope: Models that allow the volatility of the spread process to evolve randomly over time.

concepts.name: Regime-Switching Models
concepts.scope: Multi-state models where price dynamics shift between distinct regimes such as normal and spike states.

concepts.name: Interconnector
concepts.scope: A transmission link connecting two electricity markets across which power and price differentials can be arbitraged.

concepts.name: Spread option valuation
concepts.scope: Pricing of options written on the difference between two correlated underlying price series.

concepts.name: Correlation between nodal prices
concepts.scope: The statistical dependence between electricity prices at different locations, which drives spread option value.

concepts.name: Price curve alignment
concepts.scope: Matching and synchronising price time series from different markets or settlement periods for joint analysis.

concepts.name: Implied volatility surface
concepts.scope: The set of market-implied volatilities across strikes and tenors used to calibrate spread option models.

concepts.name: Two-asset log-normal model
concepts.scope: A joint model assuming each location price follows geometric Brownian motion, used as a baseline for spread pricing.

Finite-difference / PDE methods for spread options
Spread option pricing under correlated log-normals

Risk-neutral valuation and change of measure

Basic Python or Excel VBA programming

power_noble.topic: Energy book acquisition: European power and gas portfolio novation and valuation

concepts.name: Book novation
concepts.scope: Transfer of rights and obligations under OTC power and gas contracts from one trading entity to another via trilateral novation agreements.

concepts.name: Total Return Swap (TRS)
concepts.scope: Bilateral instrument used to transfer market and credit risk of OTC positions to the purchaser ahead of formal novation completion.

concepts.name: Mirror transaction
concepts.scope: Back-to-back trade entered between seller and buyer replicating a confidential counterpart position to transfer market risk while counterparty identity remains undisclosed.

concepts.name: Mark-to-market (MTM) valuation
concepts.scope: Present-value pricing of OTC and exchange-listed power and gas positions in the currency of the underlying commodity as of a specified valuation date.

concepts.name: Funding and capital charges
concepts.scope: Balance-sheet, execution, and capital costs assessed by a potential acquirer on top of MTM value when pricing a portfolio acquisition bid.

concepts.name: Credit risk transfer
concepts.scope: Mechanism by which counterparty credit exposure associated with OTC transactions migrates from seller to buyer, including treatment of CSA and netting.

concepts.name: Exchange position transfer
concepts.scope: Process for moving listed futures and options on EEX, ICE, CME, and Nordpool to the purchaser, including settlement-price reference and longstop provisions.

concepts.name: Indicative bid process
concepts.scope: Structured competitive auction procedure for acquiring an energy trading book, covering bid submission requirements, valuation assumptions, and selection criteria.

concepts.name: Base Consideration
concepts.scope: Agreed net purchase price for the portfolio, constituted by MTM valuations plus fees and charges across EUR, GBP, and USD denominations.

concepts.name: Confidential counterpart
concepts.scope: A counterparty whose identity has not been consented for disclosure to the bidder, requiring mirror trades until novation is achieved.

concepts.name: Novation consideration mechanics
concepts.scope: Fee structures including non-deferred, deferred, and bonus novation payments tied to the proportion and timing of successfully novated trades.

concepts.name: Principal component analysis (PCA) for gas swing
concepts.scope: Statistical technique applied to gas price dynamics to reduce dimensionality for valuing swing and seasonal optionality.

concepts.name: Summer/winter optionality
concepts.scope: Seasonal spread options embedded in gas and power contracts capturing the value of storage or flexible supply between summer injection and winter withdrawal periods.

concepts.name: Credit exposure netting
concepts.scope: Reduction of gross counterparty credit exposure by offsetting positive and negative MTM values across trades under the same master agreement.

concepts.name: Reference Market-maker quotation
concepts.scope: Market quotation mechanism using multiple broker quotes to determine replacement transaction amounts for early-terminated or novated contracts.

concepts.name: Novation
concepts.scope: Legal substitution of one counterparty for another in an existing derivatives or energy contract, transferring all rights and obligations.

concepts.name: DCT Payment Amount
concepts.scope: Mark-to-market compensation calculated and agreed between parties for disclosed confidential transactions being novated, covering residual value transfer.

concepts.name: Average Replacement Transaction Amount
concepts.scope: Fallback valuation mechanism averaging each party's independent replacement cost estimates when bilateral agreement on termination or novation value fails.

concepts.name: Novation Costs and Novation Benefits
concepts.scope: Incremental or reduced costs to the Purchaser arising from capital, credit, and funding charge differences when a transaction novates to a third party rather than directly to the Purchaser.

concepts.name: Transfer Long Stop Date
concepts.scope: Contractual deadline by which all counterpart transaction novations must be completed, after which alternative disposition rights (termination or third-party transfer) are triggered.

concepts.name: Deferred Novation Consideration
concepts.scope: Contingent cash payment from Noble to the Purchaser triggered upon completion of all priority counterpart novations within the prescribed timeline.

concepts.name: Bonus Deferred Novation Consideration
concepts.scope: Time-incentive payment scaled as a percentage of the administration fee rewarding faster completion of all novations within 30, 60, or 90 calendar days.

concepts.name: Exchange Transaction
concepts.scope: Centrally cleared or exchange-listed derivative position being transferred from Noble to the Purchaser via exchange transfer procedures and clearing member mechanics.

concepts.name: Deemed Mirror Exchange Transaction
concepts.scope: Synthetic bilateral replication automatically created when an exchange transaction fails to transfer by the effective date deadline.

concepts.name: Credit Support Arrangement
concepts.scope: Collateral or guarantee mechanism supporting a counterpart transaction, which the Purchaser must replicate on a like-for-like basis as a condition of novation.

concepts.name: Counterpart Master Agreement
concepts.scope: Governing ISDA, EFET, or equivalent framework agreement between Noble and a counterpart under which individual transactions are documented.

concepts.name: Termination Amount
concepts.scope: Bilaterally agreed or market-quoted sum payable upon early termination of a total return swap or mirror transaction when novation cannot be completed.

concepts.name: Relevant Event
concepts.scope: Breach, force majeure, or default occurring under a counterpart transaction that may trigger termination rights and corresponding TRS close-out mechanics.

concepts.name: Priority Counterpart
concepts.scope: Designated subset of counterparties whose novations must be pursued first and tracked most actively to qualify for deferred novation consideration payments.

concepts.name: CT Event
concepts.scope: Defined trigger under a total return swap that activates upon termination of the underlying counterpart transaction, determining the close-out payment mechanics.

concepts.name: Limitation of Liability Thresholds
concepts.scope: Contractual caps and de minimis baskets (individual USD 500k, aggregate USD 2m, maximum USD 10m) constraining Noble's exposure to warranty and representation claims.

concepts.name: Market Quotation Determination
concepts.scope: Structured fallback procedure for deriving an average replacement transaction amount when parties cannot agree a termination or novation value bilaterally.

concepts.name: Counterpart Transaction
concepts.scope: An existing energy derivative or physical trade between the transferor and a third-party counterpart whose economics are synthetically transferred via the TRS.

concepts.name: Additional Termination Event (ATE)
concepts.scope: A contractually defined trigger, here the TRS Counterpart ATE, that causes early termination of affected separated TRS transactions without affecting other transactions under the master agreement.

concepts.name: Separated TRS Transaction
concepts.scope: A notional sub-transaction of the TRS corresponding one-to-one with a single counterpart transaction, used to ring-fence termination events.

concepts.name: Portfolio Partial Recovery Amount
concepts.scope: A formula-derived figure capping the transferee's share of recoveries from a defaulting counterpart, accounting for netting, collateral and other transactions.

concepts.name: Maximum Loss
concepts.scope: The ceiling on the transferee's loss from a subsequent CT event, calculated as the unrecovered amount assuming no further cash receipts from the counterpart after the deemed termination date.

concepts.name: Netting Arrangement
concepts.scope: A contractual or legal right to set off mutual obligations between the transferor and a counterpart, applied before computing CT event payment and recovery amounts.

concepts.name: Market Risk Retention
concepts.scope: The principle that the transferee bears the price and valuation risk of the counterpart transactions regardless of counterpart credit events.

concepts.name: Imbalance Charges
concepts.scope: Costs arising from failures in nomination, scheduling or delivery under energy market rules, allocated to the party whose act or omission caused the failure.

concepts.name: EMIR Reporting Obligation
concepts.scope: EU regulatory requirement to report OTC derivative transactions to a trade repository, cited as a permitted exception to confidentiality.

concepts.name: Dodd-Frank CFTC Reporting
concepts.scope: US regulatory requirement to report swap transactions to a swap data repository, with the transferee designated as the reporting party.

concepts.name: TUPE
concepts.scope: UK Transfer of Undertakings (Protection of Employment) Regulations, addressed to confirm that employment contracts do not automatically transfer to the purchaser.

concepts.name: FX Hedging Transaction
concepts.scope: A foreign exchange derivative entered alongside the TRS to manage currency exposure arising from counterpart transactions denominated in multiple currencies.

concepts.name: Deemed Termination Date
concepts.scope: A contractually assumed date on which a counterpart transaction is treated as having terminated for the purpose of calculating the maximum loss under the TRS.

concepts.name: Economic Sanctions Compliance
concepts.scope: Obligations preventing any party from taking actions that would cause another party to violate applicable UK, EU, UN or US sanctions regimes.

concepts.name: Gross-up for Withholding Tax
concepts.scope: The obligation of the paying party to increase payments so that the recipient receives the full contractual amount net of any mandatory tax deductions.

concepts.name: Counterpart Unpaid Amount
concepts.scope: An amount due from a counterpart to the transferor that remains unpaid, triggering a compensating payment obligation from the transferee to the transferor under the TRS.

concepts.name: Total Return Swap (TRS) Confirmation
concepts.scope: A bilateral contract transferring economic exposure of an underlying energy trading book from seller to purchaser via swap mechanics.

concepts.name: Confidential Transaction
concepts.scope: An OTC energy trade where the counterparty identity is withheld from the purchaser until post-signing consent is obtained.

concepts.name: Disclosed Counterpart Transaction (DCT)
concepts.scope: A previously confidential trade whose counterparty identity has been disclosed, triggering a separate credit risk pricing and payment process.

concepts.name: Novation Agreement
concepts.scope: A trilateral agreement transferring a trade from the seller to the purchaser with counterparty consent, extinguishing the original contract.

concepts.name: Sleeve Process
concepts.scope: An interim arrangement where the seller continues to hold a trade on behalf of the purchaser when direct novation is not immediately achievable.

concepts.name: Termination Process
concepts.scope: A mechanism to close out a counterpart transaction when novation cannot be completed, capping the purchaser's residual credit exposure.

concepts.name: Market Risk Transfer
concepts.scope: The passage of exposure to changes in marked-to-market value of the book from seller to purchaser from the effective date.

concepts.name: Novation Consideration (Non-Deferred and Deferred)
concepts.scope: Fee payments from seller to purchaser tied to the administration cost of novating priority counterpart trades, split across the effective date and a completion milestone.

concepts.name: Bonus Novation Consideration
concepts.scope: An incentive payment to the purchaser scaled to the speed of completing all novations within 30, 60, or 90 calendar days.

concepts.name: Early Termination Date
concepts.scope: A contractually designated date on which close-out netting is triggered under the master agreement following a termination event or event of default.

concepts.name: Force Majeure Release
concepts.scope: A provision releasing rather than merely suspending the swap seller's performance obligations where force majeure prevents delivery under a counterpart transaction.

concepts.name: VAT Treatment on TRS Payments
concepts.scope: A clarification that referenced payment amounts are VAT-exclusive and that VAT is payable additionally where the payment constitutes consideration for a taxable supply.

concepts.name: Withholding Tax Gross-Up
concepts.scope: An obligation on the payer to increase payments so the recipient receives the same net amount as if no withholding were required, with a reimbursement mechanism where the recipient recovers tax credits.

concepts.name: FATCA Carve-Out
concepts.scope: An exclusion of FATCA-mandated withholdings from the general gross-up obligation under the TRS confirmation.

concepts.name: Transaction Reporting Consent
concepts.scope: A standing, post-termination consent permitting disclosure of trade and counterparty data to regulators, trade repositories, and affiliates in compliance with reporting mandates.

concepts.name: Live Price Mechanism
concepts.scope: A real-time pricing process on the effective date through which the purchaser submits a final bid for the book based on current market levels.

concepts.name: Know Your Customer (KYC) Requirement
concepts.scope: A pre-condition requiring the purchaser to complete regulatory identity checks on disclosed counterparties before executing the sale.

concepts.name: Credit Support Arrangements
concepts.scope: Collateral or margin agreements between seller and purchaser established where necessary to support obligations under the TRS.

concepts.name: MTM Cap on Credit Exposure
concepts.scope: A mechanism limiting the purchaser's loss on an unnovated trade to the difference between mark-to-market value and collateral held at the point the seller declines to terminate.

concepts.name: Nordic Baseload Forward Pricing
concepts.scope: Quarterly forward price data for Nordic baseload power used to value exchange and OTC positions in the transaction book.

concepts.name: OTC Portfolio Mark-to-Market (MTM)
concepts.scope: The aggregate fair value of outstanding bilateral energy contracts, denominated in USD, as of a reference date.

concepts.name: FX Risk in Energy Book
concepts.scope: Foreign exchange exposure arising from energy positions denominated in multiple currencies including GBP, EUR, and USD.

FX conversion using reference price sources

Iterative recalculation of recovery amounts on new information
Early termination amount determination under ISDA Section 6

MTM and collateral-based credit exposure capping
Withholding tax gross-up and credit reimbursement calculation

Credit support annexes and collateral management
VAT treatment of financial services (EU VAT Directive 2006/112/EC)
EFET General Agreement for commodity derivatives
Close-out netting and set-off under English law
Energy commodity delivery and nomination mechanics
US Dodd-Frank swap reporting (Parts 43 and 45 CFTC)
ISDA Master Agreement and schedule negotiation
EFET General Agreement for Commodity Contracts
Energy OTC derivatives pricing and valuation
Exchange-cleared derivatives and clearing member mechanics
Novation mechanics and counterparty consent processes
Credit risk management in energy trading
