power_offtake.topic: SDE+ Renewable Energy Feed-in Subsidy Scheme (Netherlands, Spring 2017)

concepts.name: SDE+ Operating Subsidy
concepts.scope: A Dutch feed-in-premium scheme that compensates renewable energy producers for the gap between production cost and market value of energy supplied.

concepts.name: Base Amount
concepts.scope: The technology-specific maximum cost-of-production benchmark denominated in €/kWh that sets the ceiling for subsidy eligibility.

concepts.name: Correction Amount
concepts.scope: The annually recalibrated market-value proxy for the energy supplied, used to reduce the subsidy payment when market prices rise.

concepts.name: SDE+ Contribution
concepts.scope: The per-unit subsidy payment equal to the base amount minus the correction amount, floored at zero above the base energy price.

concepts.name: Base Energy Price
concepts.scope: The minimum value the correction amount may take, functioning as a floor that defines the maximum possible SDE+ payment.

concepts.name: Phased Budget Release
concepts.scope: A mechanism dividing each SDE+ application round into sequential phases with rising maximum phase amounts to favour lower-cost technologies.

concepts.name: Free Category
concepts.scope: An option allowing applicants to bid a subsidy rate below the phase maximum in increments of 0.001 €/kWh to improve competitive ranking.

concepts.name: Full Load Hours
concepts.scope: The technology-specific annual cap on subsidisable production hours at nominal capacity, determining maximum eligible output.

concepts.name: Maximum Annual Production Eligible for Subsidy
concepts.scope: The product of installed capacity and maximum full load hours, capping the volume of output that attracts subsidy in any year.

concepts.name: Subsidy Period
concepts.scope: The technology-dependent duration (8, 12, or 15 years) over which an awarded SDE+ grant can be drawn.

concepts.name: Banking (SDE+)
concepts.scope: A provision allowing producers to carry unused or excess subsidisable production between years, with forward banking capped at 25% of annual eligible output.

concepts.name: Negative Electricity Price Rule
concepts.scope: A clause withholding SDE+ payments for electricity fed into the grid during periods when the spot price is negative for six or more consecutive hours.

concepts.name: Wind Factor
concepts.scope: An alternative risk-management mechanism for wind projects that replaces banking by adjusting eligible output for inter-annual wind variability.

concepts.name: P50 Capacity Estimate
concepts.scope: The median probabilistic production estimate required for geothermal and wind projects to set the nominal capacity used in grant calculations.

concepts.name: Biomass Sustainability Criteria
concepts.scope: Regulatory requirements (including EU RED compliance) governing the feedstock quality and origin for solid and liquid biomass categories eligible for SDE+.

concepts.name: Co-firing / Co-gasification Category
concepts.scope: SDE+ subsidy categories covering partial substitution of coal with biomass in coal-fired power stations, subject to an annual energy cap of 25 PJ.

concepts.name: Extended Lifespan Category
concepts.scope: An SDE+ option allowing installations previously subsidised under MEP to apply for continued support subject to minimum age and eligibility conditions.

concepts.name: Electrical Efficiency Requirement
concepts.scope: A minimum ratio of electrical output to fuel input (at least 10% for biomass CHP ≤100 MWe) that installations must meet to qualify for CHP categories.

concepts.name: Provisional vs Final Correction Amount
concepts.scope: A two-stage settlement process whereby an indicative correction amount guides initial payments and a final value triggers a true-up in the following calendar year.

concepts.name: Budget Claim
concepts.scope: The portion of the overall round budget reserved by a granted application, calculated using capacity, full load hours, and the base energy price.

concepts.name: Power Purchase Agreement (PPA)
concepts.scope: Long-tenor bilateral contract governing the sale and purchase of electricity output from a generation facility between a seller and a licensed buyer.

concepts.name: Contracts for Difference (CfD)
concepts.scope: UK low-carbon support mechanism providing a top-up or clawback payment between a strike price and a market reference price for eligible generators.

concepts.name: CfD Market Reference Price
concepts.scope: The benchmark energy price used to settle CfD payments, here defined as the average settlement of the season-ahead contract during the season before delivery.

concepts.name: Day-Ahead Reference Price
concepts.scope: The N2EX Day-Ahead Auction hourly clearing price used as the primary electricity index for PPA settlement.

concepts.name: Imbalance Charge / Imbalance Premium
concepts.scope: A fixed per-MWh deduction from the reference price charged to the seller to compensate the buyer for bearing imbalance settlement risk under the BSC.

concepts.name: Embedded Benefits
concepts.scope: Financial advantages accruing to an embedded generator's offtaker including avoided BSUoS, avoided transmission losses, avoided Capacity Market Supplier Charge, Triad/TNUoS savings, and AAHEDC avoidance.

concepts.name: Triad / TNUoS Benefit
concepts.scope: The avoided demand transmission network use-of-system charge arising from a generator's output during the three half-hours of highest system demand in winter, passed through to the seller.

concepts.name: BSUoS Avoidance
concepts.scope: Embedded generator benefit from reducing the buyer's balancing services use-of-system charge, passed through as part of embedded benefit receipts.

concepts.name: Renewable Energy Guarantee of Origin (REGO)
concepts.scope: Certificate attesting to the renewable origin of electricity generation, transferred from seller to buyer and priced as a percentage of market value in the PPA.

concepts.name: Capacity Market Agreement
concepts.scope: Contract entitling a capacity provider to periodic capacity payments in return for guaranteed availability, with associated supplier charge obligations and monthly weighting factors.

concepts.name: Interim Levy Rate
concepts.scope: Quarterly per-MWh charge levied on electricity suppliers by the Low Carbon Contracts Company to fund CfD payments to generators.

concepts.name: Total Reserve Amount
concepts.scope: Quarterly aggregate financial reserve determined by the LCCC to cover potential CfD payment obligations, funded through supplier levies.

concepts.name: Operational Costs Levy
concepts.scope: Annual per-MWh charge on electricity suppliers covering the administrative operating costs of the CfD settlement body.

concepts.name: Capacity Market Settlement Costs Levy
concepts.scope: Annual fixed amount charged to electricity suppliers to recover the administrative costs of Capacity Market settlement.

concepts.name: Capacity Market Monthly Weighting Factor
concepts.scope: Month-specific percentage determining how annual capacity payments and supplier charges are distributed across the delivery year.

concepts.name: Physical Hedging of PPA
concepts.scope: Arrangement allowing a seller to lock in a forward price on a portion of physical generation volumes for defined periods ahead of delivery.

concepts.name: Financial Hedge under PPA
concepts.scope: Separate derivative instrument (documented under ISDA and Master Netting Agreement) allowing price fixing independently of physical delivery obligations.

concepts.name: Imbalance Risk Allocation
concepts.scope: Contractual assignment of responsibility for deviations between nominated and actual generation volumes and their associated BSC settlement costs.

concepts.name: Day-Ahead Nomination
concepts.scope: Seller's obligation to declare expected hourly export volumes to the buyer by a specified gate closure time on the preceding business day.

concepts.name: Within-Day Re-nomination
concepts.scope: Intraday adjustment to the scheduled generation volume submitted by the seller within a defined notice period, priced at the within-day market reference.

concepts.name: Generator Distribution Use of System (GDUoS) Charges
concepts.scope: Distribution network charges or credits applied to an embedded generator's export connection, passed through at cost between buyer and seller.

concepts.name: BMRP Risk
concepts.scope: Risk of extended plant unavailability affecting contracted power delivery, addressed primarily through Force Majeure and Termination provisions of the PPA.

concepts.name: SDE+ Subsidy Mechanism
concepts.scope: Dutch feed-in premium support scheme providing a top-up between a technology-specific base amount and the market energy price across phased application rounds.

concepts.name: SDE+ Base Amount
concepts.scope: Maximum technology-specific production cost benchmark (€/kWh) above which no subsidy is granted under the Dutch SDE+ scheme.

concepts.name: SDE+ Base Energy Price
concepts.scope: Market reference energy price (€/kWh) subtracted from the base amount to derive the subsidy top-up paid to renewable energy producers.

concepts.name: SDE+ Correction Amount
concepts.scope: Annual adjustment to the SDE+ base energy price reflecting actual market prices, used to recalibrate subsidy payments ex-post.

concepts.name: SDE+ Phased Release
concepts.scope: Sequential opening of application windows at rising maximum phase amounts (€ct/kWh) within a single application round to prioritise cost-effective technologies.

concepts.name: SDE+ Free Category
concepts.scope: Option for applicants to request a subsidy amount below the technology maximum base amount, in multiples of 0.1 €ct/kWh, to tailor bids to their business case.

concepts.name: Full Load Hours (FLH)
concepts.scope: Annual equivalent full-power operating hours per technology category used to determine total eligible energy production for SDE+ subsidy calculations.

concepts.name: Energy-from-Waste (EfW) Generation
concepts.scope: Thermal conversion of municipal solid and commercial waste to produce electricity, with REGO eligibility limited to the biogenic fraction of fuel input.

concepts.name: Change in Law Clause
concepts.scope: PPA provision allowing either party to renegotiate terms if legislative, regulatory, or market rule changes materially alter the balance of risks and benefits.

concepts.name: Bundled PPA Application
concepts.scope: Mechanism allowing multiple project applications to be linked so that all are honoured together or ranked as a single unit for subsidy budget allocation purposes.

concepts.name: Inter-creditor Agreement
concepts.scope: Legal arrangement governing the relative rights of the PPA offtaker and project senior lenders with respect to collateral and mark-to-market exposures.

concepts.name: Mark-to-Market (MtM) Collateral
concepts.scope: Credit support posted by the generator when the unrealised value of hedged positions exceeds a threshold, ranking pari passu with senior lenders.

concepts.name: REMIT Reporting
concepts.scope: EU regulatory obligation to report wholesale energy market transactions and fundamental data, assigned contractually to the buyer under the PPA.

concepts.name: Self-Billing Invoice
concepts.scope: Settlement mechanism under which the buyer calculates and issues the invoice to the seller based on metered generation data and agreed pricing terms.

concepts.name: Offtake Agreement
concepts.scope: Long-term bilateral contract governing the sale and purchase of electricity output between a generator and an offtaker.

concepts.name: Force Majeure
concepts.scope: Contractual clause releasing a party from performance obligations when prevented by events beyond its reasonable control.

concepts.name: Change in Law
concepts.scope: Provision addressing how legislative or regulatory changes affect party obligations and liability under a power purchase agreement.

concepts.name: Termination Rights
concepts.scope: Conditions under which either party may exit the agreement, including prolonged force majeure events.

concepts.name: Delivery and Acceptance Obligations
concepts.scope: Contractual duties of the seller to deliver and the buyer to accept specified quantities of electricity at an agreed delivery point.

concepts.name: Payment Netting
concepts.scope: Mechanism allowing the buyer to offset unpaid delivered amounts against sums owed to the seller during a force majeure event.

concepts.name: Potential Future Exposure (PFE)
concepts.scope: Credit risk metric estimating the maximum expected exposure on a power contract over its remaining term at a given confidence level.

concepts.name: Value at Risk (VaR)
concepts.scope: Statistical measure quantifying the potential loss in contract value over a defined horizon under adverse price movements.

concepts.name: Contract for Difference (CfD) Pricing
concepts.scope: Valuation of the government-backed CfD support mechanism relevant to renewable and low-carbon generation revenues in GB.

concepts.name: Imbalance Settlement
concepts.scope: GB market mechanism by which generation deviations from contracted positions are priced and settled by the system operator.

concepts.name: Waste-to-Energy / CHP Economics
concepts.scope: Project-level financial modelling of combined heat and power plants fuelled by waste, capturing revenues, costs and subsidy income.

concepts.name: Return on Credit Model
concepts.scope: Framework for assessing whether the risk-adjusted return on a counterparty credit exposure meets internal hurdle rates.

concepts.name: Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)
concepts.scope: Confidentiality contract governing the exchange of commercially sensitive information during pre-contractual negotiations.

concepts.name: Price Curve Modelling
concepts.scope: Construction of forward electricity and gas price curves used as inputs to contract valuation and risk models.

concepts.name: Gas Price Volatility (NBP/TTF)
concepts.scope: Measurement of implied or historical volatility on UK and continental European natural gas benchmarks used in power price models.

methods: Subsidy calculation: base amount minus correction amount
Maximum annual eligible production calculation (capacity × full load hours)
Annual SDE+ contribution estimation (contribution rate × eligible production)
Phased competitive allocation across technology categories
P50 probabilistic yield estimation for wind and geothermal
Electrical efficiency ratio calculation for CHP installations
Thermal capacity derivation from aperture area (solar thermal)
PPA gross margin calculation (with and without option overlays)
Daily call option structuring on partial merchant volumes with seasonal exercise
Strike price setting relative to forward market levels
Phased budget allocation with first-come / lowest-bid ranking and lot-drawing tie-break
P50 wind energy yield calculation using Windviewer
Physical hedge volume limits declining by year
Unplanned outage deduction formula based on cumulative under-nomination vs threshold
Capacity Market monthly weighting factor application to capacity payments
Interim levy rate determination and Total Reserve Amount calculation
Project economics / discounted cash flow modelling
implied_prerequisites: Understanding of feed-in tariffs and feed-in premiums
Renewable energy technology fundamentals (solar PV, wind, biomass, geothermal, hydro)
Combined heat and power (CHP) operation principles
Energy unit conversions (kWh, MWh, kW, MW, MWth, MWe)
Electricity market structure and wholesale price formation
Basics of forward and futures markets for power
Project finance and lender security structures

power_peaker.topic: GB gas peaker tolling and route-to-market structuring

concepts.name: Tolling agreement
concepts.scope: A contractual structure whereby a toller (SEEL) takes full dispatch control of generation assets and pays a capacity-based fee to the asset owner in exchange for the commodity margin.

concepts.name: Adjusted Gross Margin
concepts.scope: The net revenue metric defined as power revenues minus gas costs, carbon price floor, and variable O&M, plus embedded benefits and non-CM ancillary revenues, used as the profit-sharing base.

concepts.name: Clean Spark Spread
concepts.scope: The margin earned by a gas-fired generator from selling power after deducting gas fuel cost and carbon cost, used here as the core commodity gross margin component.

concepts.name: Profit-share / floor / cap structure
concepts.scope: A tiered commercial arrangement specifying a minimum annual fee floor, a profit-share threshold, and an upper cap beyond which incremental margin is split at a different ratio between toller and asset owner.

concepts.name: Embedded Benefits (GDUoS)
concepts.scope: Revenue credits accruing to sub-transmission-connected (11 kV) generators arising from avoided Distribution Use of System charges, segmented into red, amber, and green time bands.

concepts.name: Capacity Market revenue
concepts.scope: Payments received under the GB Capacity Market auction, explicitly excluded from the tolling gross margin and retained by the asset owner.

concepts.name: Balancing Mechanism (BM) / NIV-chasing
concepts.scope: GB real-time dispatch optimisation through National Grid's balancing mechanism, including submission of bids and offers and opportunistic response to net imbalance volume signals.

concepts.name: Route-to-market service
concepts.scope: The bundled provision of gas supply, power marketing, meter-point registration, and all trading decisions for a portfolio of generation assets by a single counterparty.

concepts.name: Imbalance / forecast error risk
concepts.scope: The financial exposure arising from deviations between scheduled and actual generation or load, driving the strategic rationale for holding flexible peaking capacity.

concepts.name: System price / capture premium analysis
concepts.scope: Historical analysis of GB system price exceedance above a threshold (e.g. £60/MWh) used to estimate the gross margin available to peaking plant during tight market periods.

concepts.name: STOR (Short Term Operating Reserve)
concepts.scope: An ancillary service product procured by National Grid for short-notice reserve delivery, included as an additional non-CM revenue stream within the tolling margin definition.

concepts.name: Plant availability and efficiency obligations
concepts.scope: Contractual requirements on the asset owner to maintain a minimum availability (95%) and specified thermal efficiency, with penalty and non-firm capacity provisions for shortfalls.

concepts.name: Transition / readiness period
concepts.scope: An interim commercial phase prior to full BM capability during which dispatch is limited to day-ahead nominations, with intraday and balancing activity handled by the incumbent operator.

concepts.name: BSUoS (Balancing Services Use of System)
concepts.scope: A system charge levied on generators for their contribution to balancing costs, explicitly excluded from embedded benefits in the tolling margin calculation.

concepts.name: Portfolio aggregation and shape management
concepts.scope: The use of flexible peaking capacity to cover forecast errors across a renewable and load aggregation portfolio, quantified in GWh and MW terms.

methods: Gross margin back-testing against price history (2014–2017)
Capacity-based fee and profit-share tier modelling
Embedded benefits quantification by DNO zone and time band
Forecast error sizing for portfolio imbalance exposure
Forward curve building (GB power and gas)
implied_prerequisites: GB electricity market structure (wholesale, BM, imbalance settlement)
Gas-fired generation economics and heat-rate concepts
UK Capacity Market rules and auction mechanics
Commodity derivatives and forward curve construction
Tolling and power purchase agreement legal frameworks
Renewable energy portfolio management and imbalance risk

power_project_blue.topic: Energy spread option risk reporting — daily Greeks and P&L by delivery period

concepts.name: Spread option
concepts.scope: An option whose payoff depends on the difference between two underlying commodity prices, here power and gas.

concepts.name: Underlying (Underlying 1 and Underlying 2)
concepts.scope: The two commodity forward prices (gas and power) that jointly determine the spread option value.

concepts.name: Implied volatility (per leg)
concepts.scope: The market-implied volatility input assigned separately to each underlying commodity in the two-factor spread option model.

concepts.name: Correlation (MOD CORR)
concepts.scope: The assumed price correlation between the two underlying commodities used in the spread option pricing formula.

concepts.name: Strike price
concepts.scope: The fixed spread level at which the option holder has the right to buy or sell the underlying spread.

concepts.name: Time to expiry
concepts.scope: The fraction of a year remaining until the option's expiration date, varying by delivery period.

concepts.name: Mark-to-market (M2M) price
concepts.scope: The current fair value per unit of the option position computed from prevailing market inputs.

concepts.name: Unrealised P&L
concepts.scope: The gain or loss on open option positions reflecting changes in M2M value since trade inception.

concepts.name: Realised P&L
concepts.scope: The cumulative cash profit or loss locked in from closed or settled portions of the option position.

concepts.name: Total P&L
concepts.scope: The sum of unrealised and realised P&L representing the overall economic result of the option position.

concepts.name: Delta (gas leg)
concepts.scope: The sensitivity of the option value to a unit change in the gas underlying price.

concepts.name: Delta (power leg)
concepts.scope: The sensitivity of the option value to a unit change in the power underlying price.

concepts.name: Gamma
concepts.scope: The second-order sensitivity of the option value to changes in the underlying commodity price(s).

concepts.name: Vega
concepts.scope: The sensitivity of the option value to a unit change in implied volatility of the underlying(s).

concepts.name: Theta
concepts.scope: The rate of change of option value with respect to the passage of time, representing time decay.

concepts.name: Rho
concepts.scope: The sensitivity of option value to a change in the risk-free interest rate.

concepts.name: Nominal volume
concepts.scope: The total quantity of the commodity underlying the option contract expressed in MWh or equivalent units.

concepts.name: Delivery period (monthly)
concepts.scope: The forward calendar month to which the option contract relates, determining the relevant forward price input.

concepts.name: Base vs Peak commodity segmentation
concepts.scope: The distinction between flat (baseload) and on-peak delivery hour profiles used to price and book energy options.

concepts.name: Interest rate discounting
concepts.scope: The application of a risk-free rate to discount expected option payoffs to present value.

concepts.name: Spread option (spark spread call)
concepts.scope: An option whose payoff depends on the differential between two underlying energy prices, here power and gas.

concepts.name: Implied volatility
concepts.scope: The market-implied standard deviation of returns for each underlying leg used in option pricing.

concepts.name: Correlation parameter
concepts.scope: The assumed linear dependence between the two underlying price processes entering a two-factor spread option model.

concepts.name: Risk-free interest rate
concepts.scope: The continuously compounded rate used for discounting expected option payoffs to present value.

concepts.name: Peak commodity flag
concepts.scope: A product classification indicating the option applies to on-peak delivery hours rather than baseload.

concepts.name: Front-month rolling
concepts.scope: The periodic reassignment of the prompt delivery month as the near-term contract approaches expiry.

concepts.name: Trade price (IC)
concepts.scope: The internal or inter-company price at which the deal was originally transacted, used as the cost basis for P&L.

concepts.name: Index option on power
concepts.scope: A call or put option whose payoff depends on a power price index, here written on monthly peak electricity delivery.

concepts.name: Two-underlying (spread) option model
concepts.scope: Option pricing framework using two correlated underlyings (gas and power) and their respective volatilities to value the contract.

concepts.name: Implied correlation
concepts.scope: The correlation parameter between the two underlying commodity prices embedded in the option pricing model.

concepts.name: M2M (mark-to-market) price
concepts.scope: The fair value of an option position computed daily using current market inputs and the pricing model.

concepts.name: Delta (gas)
concepts.scope: The sensitivity of the option value to a unit change in the gas underlying price.

concepts.name: Delta (power)
concepts.scope: The sensitivity of the option value to a unit change in the power underlying price.

concepts.name: Peak commodity
concepts.scope: A power delivery product covering only peak hours within a delivery period, as opposed to baseload.

concepts.name: Trade price vs M2M price
concepts.scope: The comparison between the original transaction price and the current fair-value price used to derive unrealised P&L.

concepts.name: Interest rate discounting in option pricing
concepts.scope: Application of a continuously compounded risk-free rate to discount expected option payoffs to present value.

concepts.name: Clean Dark Spread (CDS) option
concepts.scope: Option on the margin of a coal-fired generator net of fuel and carbon costs, traded on NL and FR baseload power.

concepts.name: Clean Spark Spread (CSS) option
concepts.scope: Option on the margin of a gas-fired generator net of gas and carbon costs, applied here to NL peak power versus TTF.

concepts.name: Historical volatility
concepts.scope: Realised price volatility computed from time-series of energy commodity prices for model calibration and comparison.

concepts.name: Correlation sensitivity
concepts.scope: Sensitivity of spread option value to the assumed price correlation between the constituent commodity legs.

concepts.name: Delta (option Greek)
concepts.scope: First-order sensitivity of option value to the underlying forward price, used for hedging energy derivatives.

concepts.name: Gamma (option Greek)
concepts.scope: Second-order sensitivity of option value to the underlying forward price, indicating convexity of the position.

concepts.name: Theta (option Greek)
concepts.scope: Rate of change of option value with respect to the passage of time, representing daily time-decay of the portfolio.

concepts.name: Vega (option Greek)
concepts.scope: Sensitivity of option value to changes in implied volatility, used to manage volatility exposure in energy books.

concepts.name: Mark-to-market (MTM) valuation
concepts.scope: Daily revaluation of derivative positions at current forward prices to produce a fair-value P&L figure.

concepts.name: Close-of-business (COB) P&L
concepts.scope: End-of-day profit-and-loss snapshot capturing value changes across the trading book for a single business day.

concepts.name: European call option on energy forwards
concepts.scope: Vanilla call option giving the right to buy an energy forward at a fixed strike, priced under lognormal Black-76 framework.

concepts.name: Peak vs base load distinction
concepts.scope: Differentiation between power contracts covering only on-peak hours and those covering all hours, relevant to NL and FR markets.

concepts.name: Coal (API2) price
concepts.scope: Northwest European coal benchmark price used as the fuel-cost leg in dark-spread option pricing.

concepts.name: TTF gas price
concepts.scope: Dutch Title Transfer Facility natural gas forward price used as the fuel-cost leg in spark-spread option pricing.

concepts.name: EUA (EU Allowance) carbon price
concepts.scope: EU Emissions Trading System allowance price incorporated into clean spread calculations to account for CO2 cost.

concepts.name: Basket option / spread option decomposition
concepts.scope: Technique to convert a multi-commodity spread option into equivalent single-asset basket formulations for pricing.

concepts.name: Brent crude oil spread
concepts.scope: Oil-to-power price relationship tracked as a cross-commodity spread for Italian or broader European market positions.

concepts.name: Term management workbook
concepts.scope: Structured spreadsheet framework for daily Greeks calculation, hedge tracking, and P&L attribution across a derivatives book.

concepts.name: Option pricing report fields
concepts.scope: Tabular output columns from a pricing engine including strike, forward, volatility, time-to-expiry, greeks, and MTM values per contract leg.

methods: Daily Greeks computation (delta, gamma, vega, theta, rho)
Greek computation (delta, gamma, vega, theta, rho)
P&L decomposition into unrealised and realised components
Time-to-expiry calculation on a business-day basis
Position report generation across a forward curve of delivery months
Forward curve bucketing by delivery month
Historical volatility estimation from high-frequency price data
Forward curve construction from market data
Hedge ratio calculation and delta hedging
implied_prerequisites: Forward curve construction for electricity and gas
Spread option pricing (Margrabe formula or Kirk approximation)
Energy commodity market conventions (peak/off-peak, delivery months)
Discount factor and present value calculations
Energy market product structures (peak vs baseload)
Energy commodity markets (power, gas, coal, carbon)
European electricity market structure (NL, FR, IT)

power_rijnmond_dec17.topic: Natural gas transmission service conditions and tariff framework

concepts.name: Entry-exit system
concepts.scope: A transmission framework separating entry capacity rights from exit capacity rights at defined points on the national grid.

concepts.name: Firm vs interruptible capacity
concepts.scope: A distinction between guaranteed transmission capacity and capacity subject to interruption by the TSO, with interruptible capacity priced at a discount to firm tariffs.

concepts.name: Capacity tranche
concepts.scope: A band of interruptible capacity levels sharing a common probability of interruption and corresponding tariff reduction class.

concepts.name: Monthly factor
concepts.scope: A seasonal weighting coefficient applied to tariff calculations reflecting the differential value of winter, shoulder and summer gas months.

concepts.name: Wheeling
concepts.scope: A cross-border transport service allowing a shipper to move gas through the national grid between specified entry-exit combinations at a fixed per-kWh-per-hour-per-year tariff.

concepts.name: Backhaul capacity
concepts.scope: Transmission capacity enabling counter-flow gas movement, where the relevant entry point is treated as an exit point and vice versa.

concepts.name: Diversion
concepts.scope: A service allowing a shipper to alter contracted flat capacity at an entry or exit point, charged as a fixed administrative fee per request.

concepts.name: Title Transfer Facility (TTF)
concepts.scope: A virtual entry-exit point on the Dutch national grid at which shippers can transfer gas title anonymously, supported by a registration service provided by GTS.

concepts.name: Transfer of capacity rights
concepts.scope: A service enabling one shipper to assign contracted entry or exit capacity rights to another party, subject to a fixed registration fee.

concepts.name: Nomination and renomination
concepts.scope: The hourly scheduling messages submitted by a shipper to GTS specifying quantities of gas to be delivered or received at each entry and exit point within a portfolio.

concepts.name: Portfolio balancing
concepts.scope: The obligation on a shipper to maintain equality between entry gas and exit gas quantities on an hourly basis within a given portfolio.

concepts.name: Capacity overshoot
concepts.scope: A penalty condition triggered when actual entry or exit gas in an hour exceeds 102% of contracted capacity.

concepts.name: Contract unit
concepts.scope: A standard twelve-month (or shorter residual) billing period over which capacity is ranked and tariff calculations are performed.

concepts.name: Capacity ranking (TR/WR)
concepts.scope: The ordering of monthly contracted capacities from largest to smallest within a contract unit to apply the stepped seasonal tariff formula.

concepts.name: Tariff formula for entry/exit/wheeling
concepts.scope: A mathematical expression combining ranked capacity differences, seasonal monthly factors and unit tariffs to compute monthly charges for transmission services.

concepts.name: Surrender of capacity
concepts.scope: A process by which a shipper returns contracted capacity to GTS for re-auction, subject to advance notice requirements aligned with the PRISMA auction calendar.

concepts.name: Capacity conversion
concepts.scope: A service enabling a shipper to bundle unbundled firm entry or exit capacity at one side of an interconnection point with capacity at the other side into a bundled product.

concepts.name: Wobbe label
concepts.scope: A gas quality classification assigned to each entry or exit point defining the calorific value band applicable for network code compliance.

concepts.name: EURIBOR-linked interest
concepts.scope: A payment default and settlement adjustment mechanism tying late-payment and provisional-invoice interest rates to the one-month EURIBOR rate plus a spread.

concepts.name: Credit limit and financial security
concepts.scope: A creditworthiness framework under which GTS can require additional collateral from shippers whose imbalance exposure exceeds an assigned credit threshold.

concepts.name: Exit capacity contract terms
concepts.scope: Contractual rules governing reduction, termination and notice periods for firm exit-capacity bookings on the Dutch national gas grid.

concepts.name: Capacity decrease penalty structure
concepts.scope: Tiered charge schedule applied when a shipper reduces contracted exit capacity by more than specified percentage thresholds within a notice period.

concepts.name: Grid Connection Agreement (GCA)
concepts.scope: Separate bilateral agreement between GTS and an end-user governing physical connection at an entry or exit point, which can supersede general conditions.

concepts.name: Operational Balancing Agreement (OBA)
concepts.scope: Agreement at an entry or exit point facilitating gas-flow balancing procedures between GTS and adjacent network operators.

concepts.name: Force majeure provisions
concepts.scope: Contractual conditions under which a party is relieved of gas-transport obligations, including carve-outs for payment and system-balancing duties.

concepts.name: Liability cap structure
concepts.scope: Per-event monetary ceiling on TSO or shipper liability linked to contracted service value at the relevant entry/exit point.

concepts.name: Wilful misconduct and gross negligence carve-out
concepts.scope: Exception to limited-liability regime when damage arises from intentional or recklessly negligent acts by managerial-level personnel.

concepts.name: Assignment and portfolio transfer
concepts.scope: Rules permitting transfer of all rights and obligations under a transport agreement, restricted to whole-portfolio transfers and requiring counterparty consent.

concepts.name: CCGT dispatch optimisation
concepts.scope: Hourly scheduling of a combined-cycle gas turbine to maximise spread between power revenues and fuel plus carbon costs.

concepts.name: Spark spread / dark spread valuation
concepts.scope: Margin metric capturing the difference between electricity price and variable generation cost (gas consumption plus CO2 allowances) for a thermal plant.

concepts.name: Forward curve construction (power, gas, carbon)
concepts.scope: Building term price curves for Dutch electricity, TTF gas and EUA CO2 from market quotes used as inputs to plant valuation models.

concepts.name: Intrinsic value vs. extrinsic (optionality) value
concepts.scope: Decomposition of a generation asset's value into the locked-in dispatch margin from current forward curves and the additional option value from price volatility.

concepts.name: Hourly backtesting of dispatch
concepts.scope: Historical simulation of plant dispatch decisions at hourly resolution to validate optimisation model performance against realised prices.

concepts.name: Shape price / profile value
concepts.scope: Within-day and within-month price differentials for power that reflect load-shape patterns and affect peaking-plant revenues.

concepts.name: Term management and hedging strategy
concepts.scope: Rolling programme of forward sales and fuel/carbon purchases to lock in margins on committed plant generation over multiple delivery periods.

concepts.name: Dutch Network Code (Transmissiecode Gas – TSO)
concepts.scope: Regulatory code governing balancing obligations, nomination procedures and TSO–shipper rights on the Dutch high-pressure gas network.

concepts.name: Euribor-linked late-payment interest
concepts.scope: Contractual interest rate benchmark (Euribor plus spread) applied to overdue amounts under the gas transport service contract.

concepts.name: Confidentiality and information-sharing obligations
concepts.scope: Contractual framework restricting disclosure of transport agreement data and defining permitted exceptions for affiliates, regulators and financiers.

methods: Interruptible tariff discount calculation via capacity tranches
Intrinsic value extraction from forward curves
Stochastic/Monte Carlo plant valuation (implied by extrinsic value files)
implied_prerequisites: Natural gas unit conventions (kWh, m³(n), bar)
Gas day and gas month definitions
Nomination and scheduling processes in gas networks
Dutch Gas Act and Network Code framework
Thermal generation economics and heat-rate modelling
Options theory (real options on physical assets)
Dutch/EU gas market structure and regulation
Contract law and regulatory framework familiarity

concepts.name: Virtual Tolling Arrangement
concepts.scope: A financial structure giving the buyer the right to receive power in exchange for a fixed fee and variable commodity costs without owning the physical plant.

concepts.name: Physical Tolling PPA
concepts.scope: A contractual arrangement transferring commodity price risk to an off-taker who dispatches a power plant and pays availability-based and variable operating charges.

concepts.name: Clean Spark Spread
concepts.scope: The margin earned by a gas generator after deducting gas fuel costs and carbon costs from the power price.

concepts.name: Fixed Tolling Fee
concepts.scope: A monthly option premium paid by the buyer to the seller to compensate for granting dispatch rights over the plant.

concepts.name: Contract Efficiency
concepts.scope: The heat-rate-derived ratio used to convert gas input volumes to power output volumes for settlement and carbon cost calculations.

concepts.name: Power Shape Nomination
concepts.scope: The buyer's daily election of a baseload, peak or extended-peak delivery profile within specified nomination deadlines.

concepts.name: Start Cost
concepts.scope: A per-MWh charge applied on delivery days when the plant transitions from zero to full capacity, covering the fixed cost of a single plant start.

concepts.name: Variable Operating Cost
concepts.scope: A per-MWh charge covering incremental operating and maintenance costs incurred when the plant generates.

concepts.name: Carbon Price Floor (CPF)
concepts.scope: The UK policy mechanism setting a minimum total carbon price for power generators by adding a Carbon Price Support rate to the EU ETS price.

concepts.name: Carbon Price Support (CPS) Rate
concepts.scope: The UK-only climate change levy surcharge on fossil fuels used in electricity generation, expressed per kWh of gas, that tops up the EU ETS carbon price.

concepts.name: EUA Reference Price
concepts.scope: The ICE Futures Europe settlement price for December-delivery EU Allowances used to calculate daily carbon costs in the tolling contract.

concepts.name: Power Carbon Intensity
concepts.scope: The CO2 emissions per MWh of electricity output, derived by dividing the fuel carbon factor by the contract efficiency.

concepts.name: Availability-Based Payment
concepts.scope: A capacity payment made to the plant owner whenever the plant is technically capable of generating, regardless of whether it actually runs.

concepts.name: EOH/Start Ratio
concepts.scope: The ratio of equivalent operating hours to number of starts used to track maintenance liability and determine whether an EOH restoration payment is owed.

concepts.name: Equivalent Operating Hours (EOH)
concepts.scope: A weighted measure of turbine wear that combines actual running hours with a start-equivalent hour allowance to schedule major overhauls.

concepts.name: EOH Restoration Payment
concepts.scope: A compensatory payment from off-taker to plant owner when the dispatch regime consumes starts faster than EOH, triggering an early overhaul.

concepts.name: Availability Payment Sculpting
concepts.scope: The permitted seasonal redistribution of annual availability payments across settlement periods to reflect expected market value.

concepts.name: GTMA Settlement
concepts.scope: The Grid Trade Master Agreement framework governing physical electricity trade notifications and monthly financial settlement in GB.

concepts.name: NBP Gas Delivery
concepts.scope: The physical delivery of natural gas at the UK National Balancing Point under NBP15 transaction terms as the fuel leg of the tolling arrangement.

concepts.name: Line Pack Storage
concepts.scope: The use of pressurised gas held within the station pipeline as short-term on-site fuel storage to provide dispatch flexibility.

concepts.name: Balancing Mechanism (BM) Participation
concepts.scope: The plant's ability to submit bids and offers to National Grid's real-time market, with associated revenues accruing to the off-taker.

concepts.name: Capacity Market Contract
concepts.scope: A GB government auction instrument guaranteeing annual payments to a plant for being available, retained by the plant owner outside the tolling arrangement.

concepts.name: Power Curve Extrapolation
concepts.scope: The forward-curve extension methodology applied beyond the liquid market horizon using seasonal ratio assumptions to value long-dated tolling positions.

concepts.name: Change in Law Provision
concepts.scope: A contractual clause allocating risk between parties when regulatory changes such as CPS rate revisions alter the economics of the tolling agreement.

concepts.name: Long-Term Maintenance Agreement (LTMA)
concepts.scope: A service contract with the original equipment manufacturer covering scheduled overhauls and life-extension work on gas and steam turbines.

concepts.name: Tolling Power Purchase Agreement (Tolling PPA)
concepts.scope: A contractual structure whereby a plant operator provides generation capacity to an off-taker who controls dispatch and bears fuel and power price risk.

concepts.name: Availability Payment
concepts.scope: A fixed periodic fee paid to the plant operator for making generation capacity available, independent of actual output.

concepts.name: Capacity Market Unit (CMU)
concepts.scope: A discrete unit of generation, demand-side response or interconnection capacity registered to participate in the GB Capacity Market auction.

concepts.name: T-4 Capacity Auction
concepts.scope: A GB Capacity Market auction held four years ahead of the delivery year to procure sufficient capacity to meet a reliability standard.

concepts.name: Clearing Price
concepts.scope: The single auction price at which capacity supply meets the demand curve, paid uniformly to all successful bidders.

concepts.name: De-rated Capacity
concepts.scope: A technology-specific downward adjustment to nameplate capacity reflecting expected availability during system stress events.

concepts.name: Net Welfare Algorithm
concepts.scope: The rule-based procedure used to determine whether to include the marginal unit when supply and demand do not intersect exactly, balancing welfare gain against incremental cost.

concepts.name: Capacity Agreement Duration
concepts.scope: The number of delivery years over which a capacity payment obligation and revenue entitlement run, with longer terms available to new-build and refurbishing plant.

concepts.name: Financial Commitment Milestone
concepts.scope: A requirement for new-build capacity providers to demonstrate sufficient capital expenditure or binding financial commitments within 18 months of auction results.

concepts.name: Substantial Completion Milestone
concepts.scope: The threshold of operational generating capacity a new-build or refurbishing CMU must reach before becoming eligible for capacity payments during a delivery year.

concepts.name: Demand-Side Response (DSR)
concepts.scope: Reduction or shifting of electricity consumption by end users in response to system signals, eligible as a capacity resource in the GB Capacity Market.

concepts.name: Ancillary Services
concepts.scope: System-support services including frequency response (primary, secondary, high) and reactive power provision contracted by National Grid from generators.

concepts.name: Maximum Export Limit (MEL)
concepts.scope: The maximum MW a generating unit declares it can export at any point, submitted to National Grid for balancing purposes.

concepts.name: Balancing Mechanism (BM)
concepts.scope: The near-real-time market operated by National Grid in which generators submit bid and offer prices to balance supply and demand within the gate closure period.

concepts.name: Ramp Rate
concepts.scope: The rate in MW per minute at which a generating unit can increase or decrease its output, determining start-up time and minimum on-load duration.

concepts.name: Plant Availability
concepts.scope: The fraction of time a generating unit is technically capable of producing at declared capacity, tracked monthly as a performance metric.

concepts.name: REMIT Notification
concepts.scope: Mandatory disclosure of inside information about generation capacity changes under the EU Regulation on wholesale Energy Market Integrity and Transparency.

concepts.name: CPI Indexation
concepts.scope: Annual adjustment of capacity payment values using the Consumer Price Index to preserve real-terms revenue across the delivery period.

concepts.name: Termination Notice
concepts.scope: A formal written notice issued by the Delivery Body to a capacity provider specifying grounds for and timing of Capacity Agreement termination.

concepts.name: Gas Tolling Agreement (GTA)
concepts.scope: A long-term indexed contract under which a toller pays a capacity charge per available MWh and assumes all market-side risks (fuel, power, emissions, imbalance) while the generator holds availability risk.

concepts.name: Investment-Grade Revenue (IGR) Guarantee
concepts.scope: A parent-company guarantee structure that makes the preferred return on invested capital date-certain and sum-certain over an investment term in lieu of direct market exposure.

concepts.name: Capacity Remuneration Payment (CRP)
concepts.scope: A long-term government-backed capacity market revenue stream that reduces the minimum margin required from wholesale markets, de-risking project cash flows.

concepts.name: Clean Spark Spread (CSS)
concepts.scope: The margin available to a gas-fired generator after deducting gas fuel costs and carbon costs from the wholesale power price, used to value and hedge generation assets.

concepts.name: Tolling Availability Charge
concepts.scope: A fixed payment per available MWh made by the toller to the generator, sized to cover all anticipated fixed and variable operational costs regardless of dispatch.

concepts.name: Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV) Equity Structure
concepts.scope: The allocation of project equity between a pension-fund all-equity investor and an operational counterparty as consideration for guarantee or tolling obligations.

concepts.name: CCGT Flexibility Parameters
concepts.scope: Technical operating characteristics of a combined-cycle gas turbine including ramp rates, minimum stable generation, start times, heat rates at part load and annual start limits.

concepts.name: Generator Imbalance Risk
concepts.scope: The exposure to settlement penalties arising when nominated generation differs from actual generation, and its contractual allocation between generator and toller under a GTA.

concepts.name: EU ETS and CPF Interaction
concepts.scope: The relationship between the EU-wide hard cap on CO2 emissions and the UK-only carbon price top-up, whereby capping the CPF does not alter the EU ETS emissions ceiling.

concepts.name: Loss of Load Expectation (LOLE) Capacity Standard
concepts.scope: The UK regulatory reliability criterion (3 hours per year) that underpins scarcity rents and justifies the capacity market as a complement to energy-only market signals.

concepts.name: Scarcity Rent
concepts.scope: The price premium above short-run marginal cost that emerges during tight system conditions and provides additional revenue to peaking and flexible generation plant.

concepts.name: Cashflow Waterfall
concepts.scope: The priority ordering of project revenue distribution—investor preferred return first, then management service charges, then residual profit sharing—used to structure project-finance SPVs.

concepts.name: Baseload Dark Spread
concepts.scope: The margin available to a coal-fired generator after deducting coal fuel and carbon costs from the wholesale baseload power price, used as a benchmark for thermal asset value.

methods: Contract price decomposition (carbon + start + variable costs)
Heat-rate-based gas volume calculation from power shape nominations
Carbon cost pass-through formula using EUA futures and ECB FX fix

Implied volatility marking and vol skew analysis
Option valuation on power and gas

Capacity charge sizing from fixed and variable cost build-up
Sensitivity analysis on CPF trajectory and exchequer impact

Gas market fundamentals and NBP conventions
CCGT thermodynamics and heat rate concepts

Gas market fundamentals (NBP pricing, hub conventions)

power_capacity_market.topic: Capacity Market supplier charges and settlement

concepts.name: Capacity Market Supplier Charge
concepts.scope: Monthly levy on licensed suppliers proportional to their share of net demand during periods of high demand, funding capacity provider payments.

concepts.name: Period of High Demand
concepts.scope: Defined window of 16:00–19:00 on working days from November to February used as the reference period for metered demand allocation.

concepts.name: Demand Forecast
concepts.scope: Forward-looking estimate of supplier net demand submitted by 1 June before a Delivery Year, used to set initial Supplier Charge and Credit Cover obligations.

concepts.name: Credit Cover
concepts.scope: Financial security (cash or letter of credit) lodged by suppliers at 110% of their monthly Supplier Charge, due 12 working days before each month.

concepts.name: Mutualisation
concepts.scope: Mechanism that redistributes a defaulting supplier's Supplier Charge across non-defaulting suppliers in proportion to their net demand.

concepts.name: Credit Default
concepts.scope: Two-stage process triggered when a supplier fails to lodge required Credit Cover, leading to mutualisation of their charge obligations.

concepts.name: Monthly Weighting Factor
concepts.scope: Profile factor applied to total annual capacity payments to determine the share attributable to each individual month of the Delivery Year.

concepts.name: Penalty Residual Supplier Amount
concepts.scope: Credit returned to suppliers representing residual capacity provider penalty payments net of over-delivery payments after a stress event.

concepts.name: Monthly Reconciliation
concepts.scope: Recalculation of each month's Supplier Charge replacing forecast demand with actual metered data and adjusting for revised capacity provider payments.

concepts.name: Annual Reconciliation
concepts.scope: End-of-Delivery-Year settlement process running three re-determination rounds that consolidates all monthly adjustments including Penalty Residual Supplier Amounts.

concepts.name: Settlement Costs Levy
concepts.scope: Separate charge on suppliers to recover the administrative costs of running EMR settlement, calculated using only final settlement run data.

concepts.name: Late Payment Interest
concepts.scope: Interest charged at 5% per annum above Bank of England base rate on overdue Supplier Charge, Settlement Costs Levy, and reconciliation amounts.

concepts.name: Net Demand
concepts.scope: Supplier metered demand net of embedded generation, adjusted for distribution losses but not transmission losses, used as the allocation base.

concepts.name: Delivery Year
concepts.scope: The contractual year over which capacity obligations are fulfilled, typically October to September, defining the reference period for all charge calculations.

concepts.name: EMR Settlement Limited (EMRS)
concepts.scope: The settlement body responsible for calculating, invoicing, and collecting Capacity Market charges from suppliers on behalf of the Electricity Settlements Company.

methods: Credit cover sizing at 110% of monthly charge
Multi-run reconciliation timeline (3 monthly, 3 annual rounds)

concepts.name: Power Valuation Template
concepts.scope: Standardised modelling framework covering Wind/PPA, spark spreads, merchant tolls, shaped products and aggregator book reviews.

concepts.name: Physical Power Dispatch Model
concepts.scope: Asset-level dispatch simulation used to price and value power generation positions.

concepts.name: Power I&C Pricing
concepts.scope: Pricing methodology for industrial and commercial electricity supply contracts.

concepts.name: Power Swing Valuation
concepts.scope: Valuation of volume flexibility embedded in power supply or offtake agreements.

concepts.name: Wind PPA Valuation
concepts.scope: Mark-to-market and structuring framework for power purchase agreements linked to wind generation.

concepts.name: Spark Spread
concepts.scope: Margin measure capturing the difference between power revenue and gas fuel cost for a generation asset.

concepts.name: Merchant Toll
concepts.scope: Contractual arrangement granting the right to convert gas to power at a fixed tolling fee without owning the asset.

concepts.name: Long-Dated Gas Sales Valuation
concepts.scope: Curve verification, hedging methodology and credit review process applied to multi-year gas supply transactions.

concepts.name: Gas Transaction Reshaping
concepts.scope: Restructuring existing gas sales or storage deals to alter volume profiles and avoid tender obligations.

concepts.name: Storage Arbitrage
concepts.scope: Strategy exploiting seasonal or locational price spreads through injection and withdrawal of gas in storage facilities.

concepts.name: Aggregator Book Acquisition
concepts.scope: Process of evaluating and acquiring energy supply portfolios from aggregators including DS book simplification.

concepts.name: Mark-to-Market (MTM)
concepts.scope: Current fair-value measurement of open deal positions against prevailing market prices.

concepts.name: Lcal Premium Socialisation
concepts.scope: Regulatory mechanism spreading locational capacity costs across market participants affecting pricing approaches.

concepts.name: Transport Tariff Structuring
concepts.scope: Regulatory and commercial rules governing daily and term gas transportation charges and their impact on deal economics.

concepts.name: Curve Verification
concepts.scope: Independent validation of forward price curves used as inputs to deal valuation models.

methods: Data extraction and management via Alteryx
Deal pipeline tracking and KPI reporting
implied_prerequisites: Regulatory framework for European energy markets

dipeng_backhaul.topic: Gas backhaul pipeline project: FEED progress, commercial agreements, and NTS transportation

concepts.name: Backhaul gas transport
concepts.scope: Reverse flow of gas from the National Transmission System into an upstream processing facility, requiring compressor upgrades and new connection infrastructure.

concepts.name: Front End Engineering Design (FEED)
concepts.scope: Pre-investment engineering phase that scopes, costs, and de-risks a capital project before a Final Investment Decision.

concepts.name: Decision Gate 4 (DG4)
concepts.scope: Stage-gate milestone at which a project seeks board-level sanction to proceed to execution, here linked to a probabilistic schedule with P50 reference.

concepts.name: Final Investment Decision (FID)
concepts.scope: Formal commitment to fund and execute a capital project, here contingent on partner alignment and review milestones.

concepts.name: National Transmission System (NTS) connection
concepts.scope: Physical and regulatory interface between an upstream gas processing site and the UK high-pressure gas transmission network, requiring Ofgem licence approval.

concepts.name: Ofgem NTS licence approval
concepts.scope: Regulatory process, including public consultation, required before a new NTS connection point can receive first gas, with a minimum 90-day statutory window.

concepts.name: CARM dispensation
concepts.scope: Waiver of standard industry commercial agreement requirements where National Grid has limited ability to renegotiate terms.

concepts.name: EPC/EPCM contracting
concepts.scope: Engineering, Procurement, Construction and Management contract structure used to deliver capital projects, here tendered to verify FEED deliverables.

concepts.name: Probabilistic project scheduling (P50)
concepts.scope: Schedule expressed in probability terms where P50 represents the date with a 50% likelihood of on-time delivery, used to quantify acceleration opportunities.

concepts.name: CAPEX and OPEX cost estimation
concepts.scope: Separation of capital expenditure on long-lead items and plant construction from operating expenditure on engineering services and inspections, tracked against latest estimates.

concepts.name: Long Lead Items (LLI)
concepts.scope: Equipment with extended procurement timelines—here a depletion compressor—whose delivery schedule drives overall project cost phasing.

concepts.name: HAZOP and HAZID
concepts.scope: Structured safety review techniques (Hazard and Operability Study; Hazard Identification) applied during FEED to identify process and facility risks.

concepts.name: SIL (Safety Integrity Level) review
concepts.scope: Formal assessment of safety instrumented functions to confirm whether existing relief valves and control systems meet required integrity levels.

concepts.name: Design simplification / value engineering
concepts.scope: Systematic reduction of scope complexity during FEED to lower civil, mechanical, and electrical costs without compromising safety or operability.

concepts.name: SEGAL transportation, processing and fractionation agreement
concepts.scope: Contractual framework under which SEGAL Owners (Shell and Esso) provide wet gas reception, NGL extraction, fractionation, and product redelivery services to affiliated shippers.

concepts.name: Shipper Gas entry specification
concepts.scope: Quality parameters that wet gas delivered at the NTS/SEGAL entry point must meet, with operator rights to reject off-specification gas.

concepts.name: NGL allocation procedure
concepts.scope: Methodology for attributing extracted natural gas liquids (ethane, propane, butane, natural gasoline) to individual shippers on a component-mass basis.

concepts.name: Called Volume notification
concepts.scope: Day-ahead and intra-day process by which the SEGAL Operator instructs shippers on the quantity of gas required at the entry point.

concepts.name: Individual Commercial Agreement (ICA)
concepts.scope: Confidential bilateral agreement between each SEGAL Owner and its affiliated shipper setting price and payment terms separate from the main transportation agreement.

concepts.name: Emissions Trading Costs and Regulatory Charges pass-through
concepts.scope: Mechanism for apportioning Phase III EU ETS costs and post-effective-date regulatory compliance costs to shippers in proportion to their gas deliveries.

concepts.name: Capacity Reduction and Total Emergency Shutdown provisions
concepts.scope: Contractual definitions and notification obligations triggered when the SEGAL System cannot accept its booked NGL throughput, in whole or in part.

concepts.name: Force Majeure
concepts.scope: Contractual clause excusing performance obligations when events outside a party's control prevent delivery or receipt of gas or NGLs.

concepts.name: Consequential Loss exclusion
concepts.scope: Mutual waiver of indirect and specified direct losses—including loss of production, profit, and revenue—regardless of the cause or legal basis of the claim.

concepts.name: Wilful Misconduct standard
concepts.scope: Liability carve-out that preserves claims only for intentional or reckless disregard of good practice by senior managerial personnel, excluding good-faith errors.

concepts.name: Reasonable and Prudent Operator standard
concepts.scope: Performance benchmark requiring the skill, diligence, and foresight expected of an experienced operator in similar circumstances, used to qualify SEGAL Owners' service obligations.

concepts.name: Anti-Bribery compliance
concepts.scope: Contractual obligation on all parties to comply with applicable anti-bribery laws in the performance of the transportation and fractionation agreement.

concepts.name: Integrity inspection programme
concepts.scope: Structured examination of retained offshore and onshore equipment—vessels, piping, structural steelwork, valves—to identify defects before commitment to reuse in the project.

concepts.name: Regulatory Charges Apportionment
concepts.scope: Pro-rata allocation of pipeline regulatory costs between shippers and owners based on volumetric usage of relevant system segments.

concepts.name: Emissions Trading Cost Allocation
concepts.scope: Method for dividing emissions-related costs among parties in proportion to their utilisation of the SEGAL System.

concepts.name: Percentage Interest Share
concepts.scope: Each shipper's fractional entitlement to products and proportional liability for costs, used as the primary allocation key throughout the agreement.

concepts.name: Self-Balancing Field Treatment
concepts.scope: Convention whereby the shipper gas stream is treated as originating from a self-balancing field for allocation procedure purposes.

concepts.name: Off-Specification Gas Liability Cap
concepts.scope: Ceiling on shipper indemnity for claims arising from delivery of off-specification gas, linked to amounts recoverable under the Uniform Network Code.

concepts.name: Consequential Loss Knock-for-Knock Indemnity
concepts.scope: Mutual exclusion of consequential loss claims between shipper group and SEGAL group except in cases of wilful misconduct.

concepts.name: Performance Assurance and Suspension
concepts.scope: Mechanism enabling SEGAL owners to demand security, suspend service or terminate in respect of a shipper whose financial standing is in doubt.

concepts.name: Expert Determination
concepts.scope: Dispute resolution pathway for specific contractual disagreements (e.g. cost shares, allocation deficiencies) referred to an independent expert rather than courts.

concepts.name: Payment Default Interest
concepts.scope: Compounded interest charged at LIBOR plus specified margins on overdue amounts, with a higher rate for expert-determined disputes.

concepts.name: Divided Rights Service
concepts.scope: Future operational regime under which shippers receive separate capacity rights, subject to a transition process and DR Date notification.

concepts.name: Coriolis Mass Flow Measurement
concepts.scope: Fiscal-standard instrumentation using coriolis meters and master meter systems to record continuous NGL stream mass flow at the entry point.

concepts.name: Gas Chromatograph Compositional Analysis
concepts.scope: Online continuous analysis of the NGL stream to determine daily component and total mass for allocation and specification compliance.

concepts.name: Contract Year Reconciliation
concepts.scope: End-of-year true-up comparing estimated to actual delivery quantities to correct interim cost apportionment calculations.

concepts.name: Contracts (Rights of Third Parties) Act 1999 Application
concepts.scope: Extension of indemnity and liability relief to non-party group members subject to defined conditions of acceptance.

concepts.name: Uniform Network Code (UNC) Interface
concepts.scope: Regulatory framework governing NTS entry capacity booking and the reference point for capping off-specification indemnity amounts.

concepts.name: Conditions Precedent
concepts.scope: Contractual requirements (including execution of ancillary agreements and commissioning confirmation) that must be satisfied before the agreement becomes operative.

concepts.name: Coriolis meter density measurement
concepts.scope: Physical measurement of NGL stream density in kg/m³ using a coriolis meter for mass flow computation.

concepts.name: Remote Telemetry Unit (RTU) protocol
concepts.scope: Standardised protocol for transmitting measurement data from field instrumentation to a central control system.

concepts.name: Continuous vs continual measurement
concepts.scope: Distinction between instantaneously available signals and signals produced after a complete sampling/analysis cycle.

concepts.name: Change-of-state/value exception reporting
concepts.scope: Telemetry transmission method that sends data only when a value changes, within defined latency limits.

concepts.name: Fiscal Standard Measurement
concepts.scope: Metering accepted by DECC for reporting exported or imported hydrocarbon quantities to a defined accuracy standard.

concepts.name: Deemed Landed Component Mass
concepts.scope: Component mass attributed to a field at the St Fergus entry point and used as the basis for downstream allocation.

concepts.name: Deemed Component Transient NGL Mass (DCTNM)
concepts.scope: Difference between aggregate component masses at the NGL pipeline inlet and those delivered to Mossmorran disposal points, representing pipeline inventory change.

concepts.name: Self Balancing Field
concepts.scope: A field that bears its own proportional share of transient NGL masses rather than passing that share to system balancing fields.

concepts.name: System Balancing Field
concepts.scope: Designated fields that absorb residual transient NGL masses not borne by self balancing fields.

concepts.name: Component Mass allocation
concepts.scope: Pro-rata assignment of each hydrocarbon component at Mossmorran disposal points to individual fields based on inlet availability.

concepts.name: Rundown Quantity
concepts.scope: Total mass of a product delivered to a Mossmorran disposal point in a given period, allocated across fields and participants.

concepts.name: Product Entitlement
concepts.scope: Each participant's ownership share of a product computed daily as opening stock plus rundown quantity plus/minus transfers minus liftings.

concepts.name: Closing Stock / Opening Stock
concepts.scope: Daily product stock position for each participant per field, carried forward as the next day's opening stock.

concepts.name: Participant Product Percentage
concepts.scope: A field-operator-notified percentage defining a participant's share of a product's rundown quantity for a given month.

concepts.name: Stock Transfer
concepts.scope: Agreed transfer of product ownership between participants at their joint request, without a physical cargo movement.

concepts.name: Product Lifting Programme
concepts.scope: Monthly schedule of vessel names, loading date ranges and cargo sizes issued by the Braefoot Bay shipping coordinator.

concepts.name: Overlift / underlift balancing
concepts.scope: Mechanism adjusting a participant's monthly entitlement to account for cumulative over- or under-lifting in prior months.

concepts.name: Allocation Programme
concepts.scope: Operator-run batch computer system that allocates component masses to fields and calculates participant product entitlements.

concepts.name: Mossmorran mass balance
concepts.scope: Component-by-component reconciliation ensuring all NGL masses entering the Mossmorran system equal those leaving via disposal points plus inventory change.

concepts.name: Fee in kind tariff allocation
concepts.scope: Mechanism by which certain product or component quantities are allocated to the system owners as tariff payment rather than cash.

concepts.name: Special Flaring
concepts.scope: Flaring attributed to specific fields with LPG uplift difficulties and separately allocated to those fields rather than shared system-wide.

concepts.name: Gas chromatographic composition analysis
concepts.scope: Measurement of hydrocarbon component fractions in NGL or gas streams to IP.345 standard for use in mass allocation.

concepts.name: Expert determination procedure
concepts.scope: Contractual dispute resolution mechanism using an independent technical expert whose written decision is final and binding.

concepts.name: NGL entry specification
concepts.scope: Quality requirements (sulphur species, water, methanol, composition, vapour pressure, particulates) that shipper gas must meet at the entry point.

concepts.name: Sales Gas / product redelivery specification
concepts.scope: Quality standards that commingled redelivered gas or fractionated products must satisfy at the respective redelivery points.

concepts.name: Average Cargo Size
concepts.scope: Minimum average parcel volume that a Category A participant must achieve per seasonal period when proposing vessel liftings.

concepts.name: Category A and Category B Participants
concepts.scope: Participant classifications that determine different lifting scheduling rules and compliance obligations.

concepts.name: Overlift and Underlift
concepts.scope: Deviations from a participant's scheduled entitlement volume, permitted only by agreement of the Balancing and Scheduling Committee to maintain storage balances.

concepts.name: Notice of Readiness (NOR)
concepts.scope: Formal vessel notification that triggers the commencement of laytime counting for loading operations.

concepts.name: Laytime and Demurrage
concepts.scope: Standard 36-hour loading time allowance and the rate payable by the terminal operator when loading exceeds that allowance.

concepts.name: Demurrage Rate Determination
concepts.scope: Mechanism for setting demurrage rates using the London Tankers Brokers Panel for condensate and independent LPG brokers for LPG vessels.

concepts.name: Worldscale
concepts.scope: Published international freight rate scale used to derive demurrage rates for condensate part-cargo vessels.

concepts.name: Minimum Loading Rate
concepts.scope: Vessel-size-dependent minimum throughput rate required at berth, non-compliance with which can result in vessel expulsion.

concepts.name: Balancing and Scheduling Committee (BSC)
concepts.scope: Governance body with sole authority to determine workability of lifting programmes and allocate berth time.

concepts.name: Storage Balance Management
concepts.scope: Operational constraint requiring lifting proposals to neither exceed nor fall below levels needed to maintain adequate terminal ullage.

concepts.name: Default Disposal Rights
concepts.scope: Shell's right to lift and sell a defaulting participant's product at best obtainable price, net of costs plus a 1% handling fee.

concepts.name: Connected System Exit Point (CSEP)
concepts.scope: The point on the National Transmission System at which a connected offtake system (e.g. SEGAL) receives gas from the NTS.

concepts.name: NTS Exit (Flat) Capacity
concepts.scope: Reserved transportation capacity at a CSEP entitling a user to offtake gas from the National Transmission System.

concepts.name: System Capacity Transfer
concepts.scope: Transfer of NTS exit capacity entitlements between users at a CSEP under Network Code rules.

concepts.name: Network Code Ancillary Agreement
concepts.scope: Contractual document subordinate to the Uniform Network Code governing site-specific exit arrangements at a CSEP.

concepts.name: Accession Agreement
concepts.scope: Mechanism by which a new user joins an existing CSEP Ancillary Agreement and acquires CSEP user status.

concepts.name: SEGAL System
concepts.scope: The integrated pipeline, processing, fractionation and marine loading infrastructure linking North Sea platforms to St. Fergus, Mossmorran and Braefoot Bay.

concepts.name: FLAGS Pipeline
concepts.scope: Far North Liquids and Associated Gas System, a 36-inch trunkline from the Brent B platform to St. Fergus used to transport gas and NGLs.

concepts.name: Accompanying Administrative Document (AAD)
concepts.scope: HM Customs and Excise document required to accompany excise goods in transit, non-return of which can trigger duty liability.

concepts.name: Three-Day Date Range
concepts.scope: Agreed arrival window for a nominated vessel within which NOR and laytime rules apply as standard.

methods: Earned value measurement (% earned vs % plan)
Continuous pressure, temperature and density measurement
Coriolis metering for density and mass flow
Three-month average rundown for overlift allocation
Contractual scheduling rule-setting for cargo liftings
Demurrage rate benchmarking via broker panels
Worldscale rate application to part cargoes
NTS capacity registration and transfer under Network Code

dipeng_credit_risk_model.topic: Credit Risk Modelling for Energy Derivatives

concepts.name: Mark-to-Market (M2M)
concepts.scope: Current fair value of an open derivatives position used as input to credit exposure calculations.

concepts.name: Potential Future Exposure (PFE)
concepts.scope: Statistical measure of worst-case future credit exposure of a derivatives portfolio over a given horizon.

concepts.name: Credit Risk Model Versioning
concepts.scope: Iterative refinement of a credit exposure calculation model tracked across numbered releases.

concepts.name: Forward curve construction
concepts.scope: Building a granular hourly or half-hourly power price curve from liquid quoted products.

concepts.name: Curve shaping
concepts.scope: Distributing flat-period forward prices into sub-period shapes using seasonal or profile weights.

concepts.name: Calendar/quarterly/monthly product hierarchy
concepts.scope: Mapping quoted annual, seasonal, quarterly, and monthly forward contracts into a consistent price structure.

concepts.name: Baseload and peakload splitting
concepts.scope: Deriving off-peak prices from quoted baseload and peakload instruments.

concepts.name: Day-of-week and hour-of-day profiles
concepts.scope: Applying time-of-use shape factors to capture intra-week and intra-day price variation.

concepts.name: Market data ingestion
concepts.scope: Sourcing and formatting daily broker or Reuters settlement prices as inputs to the curve builder.

concepts.name: Cross-market curve building
concepts.scope: Applying a common curve-building framework across different national power markets such as DE, GB, and NL.

methods: Iterative reconciliation of shaped curve to quoted forwards

Understanding of delivery period structures (hourly, daily, monthly)

dipeng_de_gas_and_power.topic: German Gas and Power Markets Data and Modelling

concepts.name: Renewable Generation Normalisation
concepts.scope: Adjusting historical German solar and wind output for structural changes in installed capacity to produce comparable time series.

concepts.name: Long-Term Contract Pricing
concepts.scope: Valuation and structuring of multi-year gas or power supply contracts using formula-based or index-linked price mechanisms.

concepts.name: Gas-Oil Linkage
concepts.scope: Relationship between natural gas contract prices and crude oil benchmarks such as Brent used in legacy continental gas pricing.

concepts.name: EEX Power Price Data
concepts.scope: Historical spot and forward electricity price series sourced from the European Energy Exchange for German power markets.

concepts.name: NCG Gas Price Data
concepts.scope: Historical hub price series for the Net Connect Germany virtual trading point covering spot and forward gas markets.

concepts.name: TTF Gas Price Data
concepts.scope: Historical hub price series for the Title Transfer Facility benchmark used as a European gas price reference.

concepts.name: Wind Generation Data
concepts.scope: Historical output series for German onshore and offshore wind used as input to renewable modelling and capture-price analysis.

concepts.name: TGSA / Demand Charge Records
concepts.scope: Recorded Transportation and Gas Supply Agreement or distribution cost data used in supply cost stack analysis.

concepts.name: Brent Crude Historical Prices
concepts.scope: Time series of Brent crude benchmark prices used for oil-indexed gas contract formula calibration.

concepts.name: Go / Force Outage Historical Data
concepts.scope: Logged generation outage events capturing planned and unplanned capacity unavailability for power balance modelling.

methods: Time-series data extraction and querying (ShellDataQuery tooling)
Spread and basis analysis across hub prices
