dipeng_de_hourly_profile_trade.topic: Hourly power price profile trading and PCA-based profile pricing in the German market

concepts.name: Hourly price profile
concepts.scope: The vector of within-day electricity prices across all hours, treated as a tradeable shape distinct from the flat baseload price.

concepts.name: Profile trade
concepts.scope: A bilateral OTC transaction whose value depends on the hourly shape of power prices rather than a flat period price.

concepts.name: Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
concepts.scope: Dimensionality-reduction technique applied to historical hourly price or load matrices to extract orthogonal factors explaining cross-hour price co-movement.

concepts.name: PCA loadings
concepts.scope: Eigenvectors of the covariance matrix that define how each hour contributes to each principal component and serve as reusable shape factors.

concepts.name: PCA scores
concepts.scope: Projected coordinates of each observed daily price profile onto the principal component axes, summarising daily shape realisations.

concepts.name: Covariance matrix of hourly prices
concepts.scope: Square matrix capturing pairwise co-movement between individual settlement hours, used as input to eigendecomposition in PCA.

concepts.name: Eigenvalue / variance explained
concepts.scope: Magnitude of each principal component's eigenvalue expressed as a percentage of total variance, used to select the number of retained components.

concepts.name: Auto-scaling (standardisation)
concepts.scope: Pre-processing step that mean-centres and unit-variance-scales each hourly variable before PCA to remove differences in price level across hours.

concepts.name: Profile pricing tool
concepts.scope: Spreadsheet or model that converts a set of PCA loadings and market inputs into a fixed-price matrix for an hourly-shaped power contract.

concepts.name: Price forward curve (PFC)
concepts.scope: Hourly or granular forward price curve used as the mark-to-market benchmark against which profile trade day-one P&L is assessed.

concepts.name: Day-one P&L / mark-to-market
concepts.scope: Immediate profit or loss on a profile trade computed by revaluing the fixed-price hourly matrix against the prevailing PFC at trade date.

concepts.name: Backcast / backtesting of loadings
concepts.scope: Out-of-sample historical simulation applying PCA loadings derived from one period to price profiles in earlier periods to assess model stability.

concepts.name: Hourly profile aggregation
concepts.scope: Process of combining individual customer or contract hourly load shapes into a net portfolio profile for pricing or hedging purposes.

concepts.name: Score plot
concepts.scope: 2-D scatter of observation scores on selected principal components used to identify clustering or outliers among daily price profiles.

concepts.name: Loading plot (biplot component)
concepts.scope: 2-D scatter of variable loadings on selected principal components used to interpret which hours drive each shape factor.

methods: Principal Component Analysis (eigendecomposition of covariance matrix)
Hourly price matrix construction for OTC contract pricing
Python scripting (numpy, scipy, matplotlib) for profile analytics
Excel-based profile pricing and aggregation models
implied_prerequisites: Power market structure and settlement conventions

dipeng_data.topic: Power and energy market data aggregation and management

concepts.name: Single imbalance price
concepts.scope: The administratively set reference price used to settle energy imbalances between nominated and actual generation or consumption in a given settlement period.

concepts.name: Imbalance settlement mechanism
concepts.scope: The regulatory and pricing framework by which transmission system operators financially settle deviations from contracted positions in real time.

concepts.name: Day-ahead market (DAM) price
concepts.scope: The hourly or half-hourly clearing price established in an exchange-run auction for electricity delivery the following day.

concepts.name: European Union Allowance (EUA) futures
concepts.scope: Exchange-traded futures contracts whose underlying asset is the right to emit one tonne of CO2 under the EU Emissions Trading Scheme.

concepts.name: API 2 coal price index
concepts.scope: A benchmark price index for coal delivered to Northwest European ports, used as a reference for fuel cost and dark-spread analysis.

concepts.name: TTF day-ahead gas price
concepts.scope: The spot or prompt gas price at the Title Transfer Facility virtual hub in the Netherlands, a primary benchmark for continental European natural gas.

concepts.name: Baseload power price
concepts.scope: The flat 24-hour average electricity price for a given delivery period, covering constant consumption or generation across all hours.

concepts.name: Peak power price
concepts.scope: The electricity price applicable only during defined on-peak hours within a delivery period, typically hours 8 to 20 on business days.

concepts.name: System Buy Price (SBP) and System Sell Price (SSP)
concepts.scope: The two-sided imbalance prices in the GB balancing mechanism at which the system operator buys or sells energy to correct system imbalances.

concepts.name: Wind generation forecasting model
concepts.scope: A quantitative model that converts meteorological wind observations or forecasts into expected electrical power output from wind farms.

concepts.name: Weather data feed
concepts.scope: Numerical weather prediction or observed meteorological data supplied by a third-party provider for use in generation and demand modelling.

concepts.name: Peg Nord gas price
concepts.scope: The spot and forward natural gas price at the French Peg Nord virtual trading hub, a reference for French and northern European gas markets.

concepts.name: NCG gas price
concepts.scope: The spot and forward natural gas price at the NetConnect Germany virtual trading hub, a primary German gas market benchmark.

concepts.name: Gaspool gas price
concepts.scope: The spot and forward natural gas price at the Gaspool virtual trading hub in northern Germany, one of two main German gas market entry points.

concepts.name: Emissions allowance options
concepts.scope: Derivative contracts granting the right but not the obligation to buy or sell EUA or CER carbon allowances at a specified price on or before expiry.

concepts.name: CER (Certified Emission Reduction)
concepts.scope: Carbon credits generated under the Kyoto Protocol Clean Development Mechanism, tradeable within the EU ETS up to regulatory limits.

concepts.name: Data normalisation (matrix to column conversion)
concepts.scope: The process of reshaping time-series price data from a date-by-hour matrix format into a single chronological column for downstream analysis.

concepts.name: Forward curve construction
concepts.scope: The assembly of a term structure of commodity prices from traded market instruments spanning prompt to long-dated delivery periods.

methods: Data scraping and ingestion from exchange and TSO portals
Historical price series construction across multiple commodities

Understanding of balancing mechanism and imbalance pricing
Basic knowledge of EU Emissions Trading Scheme
Understanding of gas hub pricing and virtual trading points

dipeng_data_automation.topic: Power and gas market data automation and volatility analysis

concepts.name: Baseload volatility
concepts.scope: Annualised percentage price volatility of baseload power forward contracts across seasonal and calendar tenors.

concepts.name: Peak volatility
concepts.scope: Annualised percentage price volatility of peak power forward contracts across seasonal and calendar tenors.

concepts.name: Gas-power spread volatility
concepts.scope: Volatility of the price differential between a power forward and its associated gas benchmark, measured across contract tenors.

concepts.name: Gas-power correlation
concepts.scope: Pearson correlation between power forward prices and gas benchmark prices over equivalent contract periods.

concepts.name: NBP volatility
concepts.scope: Annualised price volatility of UK National Balancing Point gas forward contracts used as the gas leg in power-gas spread analysis.

concepts.name: TTF volatility
concepts.scope: Annualised price volatility of Dutch Title Transfer Facility gas forward contracts used as the gas benchmark for Continental power markets.

concepts.name: Forward contract tenors
concepts.scope: Standardised delivery periods—day-ahead, month-ahead, quarter-ahead, season-ahead, year-ahead—used to structure power and gas price series.

concepts.name: Seasonal segmentation
concepts.scope: Splitting historical price data into summer and winter delivery seasons to capture intra-year volatility patterns.

concepts.name: Data automation pipeline
concepts.scope: Systematic extraction, transformation and versioned storage of daily forward-price data across multiple markets and products using spreadsheet macros and Python scripts.

concepts.name: Market coverage across NL, UK, DE, FR, BE
concepts.scope: Parallel data collection for power markets in the Netherlands, United Kingdom, Germany, France and Belgium including baseload, peak and hourly products.

concepts.name: ETS carbon price data
concepts.scope: Automated collection and storage of EU Emissions Trading System allowance price series used alongside power and gas data.

concepts.name: API coal price series
concepts.scope: Automated collection of API coal benchmark price data integrated into multi-commodity forward-price datasets.

Python scripting for file naming and data manipulation
Versioned time-series output to timestamped Excel files

dipeng_data_model_system.topic: Power market data collection and organisation for baseload and peak electricity products

concepts.name: Baseload power product
concepts.scope: Standardised electricity contract delivering flat power across all hours of the delivery period.

concepts.name: Peak power product
concepts.scope: Standardised electricity contract delivering power only during defined peak hours of the delivery period.

concepts.name: Daily granularity
concepts.scope: Time resolution at which power price or volume data is recorded or settled on a day-by-day basis.

concepts.name: Market data collector
concepts.scope: Structured template or tool that aggregates price and related data from multiple sources into a single repository.

concepts.name: Cross-market data organisation
concepts.scope: Systematic arrangement of data across different national electricity markets within a unified framework.

concepts.name: PeGN (Peak German-style)
concepts.scope: Peak contract convention used in French power markets referencing German peak-hour definitions.

Familiarity with European power market conventions

dipeng_eq.topic: CHP power plant forward valuation and dispatch optimisation

concepts.name: CHP plant forward valuation
concepts.scope: Determining the optimised economic performance of a combined heat and power plant over a forward valuation period using forecasted electricity, gas and CO2 prices.

concepts.name: Intrinsic value
concepts.scope: Plant value derived from optimising dispatch against a single deterministic forward price curve.

concepts.name: Extrinsic value
concepts.scope: Additional plant value captured beyond intrinsic value by optimising across multiple price scenarios representing price uncertainty.

concepts.name: Dynamic Programming (DP) optimisation
concepts.scope: Recursive optimisation technique applied to determine start/end plant states and approximate fuel consumption within weekly sub-periods.

concepts.name: Linear Programming (LP) optimisation
concepts.scope: Optimisation engine used after DP to solve for precise hourly dispatch subject to physical and contractual constraints within each weekly period.

concepts.name: Plant state
concepts.scope: Binary or discrete representation of whether a CHP unit is running, starting up, or shut down at each time step.

concepts.name: Start-up and shut-down costs
concepts.scope: Fixed cost charges incurred each time the plant transitions from off to on or on to off, affecting dispatch decisions.

concepts.name: Heat demand constraint
concepts.scope: Minimum or required heat output the CHP must satisfy in each period, acting as an additional dispatch constraint.

concepts.name: Maintenance periods
concepts.scope: Scheduled intervals during which the plant is unavailable for dispatch and must be excluded from the optimisation.

concepts.name: Price scenario generation
concepts.scope: Construction of multiple electricity, gas and CO2 price paths around the forward curve for use in extrinsic value calculation.

concepts.name: Gas day convention
concepts.scope: British market time convention defining a gas-flow day as 06:00 to 05:59 the following day, relevant when aligning gas and power price curves.

concepts.name: Valuation date
concepts.scope: The end-of-day reference point at which forward prices are quoted, representing the last trading day before the forward curve commences.

concepts.name: Weekly period decomposition
concepts.scope: Decomposition of the full valuation horizon into 168-hour sub-problems to make the optimisation computationally tractable.

concepts.name: Variable operation and maintenance costs
concepts.scope: Output-dependent running costs of the plant included in the profit calculation alongside fuel and CO2 costs.

concepts.name: CO2 emission costs
concepts.scope: Carbon cost component of plant dispatch economics derived from CO2 price scenarios and plant emission intensity.

concepts.name: Electricity spot price
concepts.scope: Half-hourly observed market-clearing price for electricity in a wholesale spot market.

concepts.name: Trading interval index
concepts.scope: Sequential numeric identifier (serial date format) labelling each half-hourly settlement period.

concepts.name: Dispatch period flag
concepts.scope: Integer counter distinguishing sub-daily dispatch windows or trading periods within a day.

concepts.name: Capacity or volume parameter
concepts.scope: Numeric field (≈100) likely representing a generation capacity, interconnector limit, or contract volume in MW.

concepts.name: Price cap or reference level
concepts.scope: Numeric field (≈232–262) indicating an administered price ceiling, reference band, or settlement residue benchmark.

concepts.name: Derived price or cost metric
concepts.scope: Numeric field (≈92–104) representing a calculated unit cost, strike price, or threshold derived from adjacent columns.

concepts.name: Binary market-state indicator
concepts.scope: Zero/one flag denoting whether a particular market condition, intervention event, or constraint is active in a given interval.

concepts.name: Intraday price seasonality
concepts.scope: Systematic within-day variation in electricity prices visible across the half-hourly panel.

concepts.name: Half-hourly settlement period
concepts.scope: The discrete time unit (approx. 30-minute interval) used to record electricity prices and dispatch states in GB wholesale markets.

concepts.name: Intraday spot price
concepts.scope: The traded or reference electricity price observed within each half-hourly settlement period.

concepts.name: Dispatch flag / dispatch state
concepts.scope: A binary or categorical indicator recording whether a generating unit or schedule is in a dispatched (active) or non-dispatched state during a given period.

concepts.name: Settlement date and period indexing
concepts.scope: A numeric timestamp (serial date plus fractional period) scheme used to uniquely identify each half-hourly observation in the dataset.

concepts.name: Panel data structure for power markets
concepts.scope: Organisation of electricity market observations across multiple dimensions (time, unit, period type) stored in a rectangular numeric array.

concepts.name: Half-hourly settlement periods
concepts.scope: Time index increments of 1/48 day used to align generation data with electricity market settlement intervals.

concepts.name: Unit commitment flags
concepts.scope: Binary indicators recording whether a generating unit is online or offline in each settlement period.

concepts.name: Dispatch quantity
concepts.scope: Megawatt output level assigned to a plant in each period, drawn from structured tabular records.

concepts.name: Plant capacity and de-rating
concepts.scope: Registered and effective capacity values used to constrain feasible output ranges for a generating unit.

concepts.name: Fuel and emissions parameters
concepts.scope: Fixed coefficients (e.g. heat rate, carbon content) embedded in the dataset to support variable-cost and emissions calculations.

concepts.name: Bid stack / merit order
concepts.scope: Ordered offer prices and quantities that determine which plants are dispatched at each price level.

concepts.name: Start-up and shut-down events
concepts.scope: Discrete transitions in the unit-commitment flag series marking the beginning and end of generation runs.

concepts.name: Intraday price variation
concepts.scope: Within-day pattern of settlement-period prices reflecting demand peaks and off-peak troughs observable in the output series.

methods: Tabular panel data construction at half-hourly frequency
Binary indicator variable construction for dispatch states

dipeng_embedded_benefits.topic: Embedded Benefits in GB Electricity Transmission Charging

concepts.name: Embedded Generation
concepts.scope: Generation connected to distribution networks rather than the transmission system, potentially exempt from certain charges below 100 MW capacity.

concepts.name: Transmission Network Use of System (TNUoS) Charges
concepts.scope: Charges levied on generators and suppliers to recover allowed revenues of Transmission Owners, split into locational and residual elements.

concepts.name: Demand TNUoS Netting
concepts.scope: The mechanism by which a supplier's gross demand is reduced by embedded generation output for the purpose of calculating TNUoS liability.

concepts.name: Generation TNUoS Avoidance
concepts.scope: The benefit to sub-100 MW embedded generators of not paying generation TNUoS charges that apply to transmission-connected generators.

concepts.name: TNUoS Locational Element
concepts.scope: The component of TNUoS tariff that reflects the cost of the wider transmission system and varies by geographic location.

concepts.name: TNUoS Residual Element
concepts.scope: The component added to TNUoS tariffs to ensure correct revenue recovery from generation and demand users beyond the locational signal.

concepts.name: Balancing Services Use of System (BSUoS) Charges
concepts.scope: Per-MWh charges on both generation and demand users to recover the costs of operating the transmission system, including transmission losses.

concepts.name: Embedded BSUoS Benefit
concepts.scope: The double avoidance of BSUoS charges accruing to embedded generators and their associated suppliers under current BSC arrangements.

concepts.name: Transmission Losses
concepts.scope: Energy losses incurred in transmitting electricity across the transmission network, recovered via adjustments to users' energy accounts under the BSC.

concepts.name: Embedded Losses Benefit
concepts.scope: The reduction in a supplier's transmission loss liability arising from netting embedded generation against demand, valued at twice the absolute loss charge.

concepts.name: Balancing and Settlement Code (BSC)
concepts.scope: The GB industry code governing balancing, settlement, and registration of parties including embedded generators and their access to the national energy account.

concepts.name: Grid Supply Point (GSP)
concepts.scope: The metering point at which electricity flows from the transmission system into the distribution network, used as the basis for TNUoS demand charging.

concepts.name: Licence Exemption
concepts.scope: The regulatory status of embedded generators below 100 MW capacity that exempts them from generation TNUoS obligations.

methods: Net demand calculation at Grid Supply Point
Transmission loss adjustment via BSC energy accounts
implied_prerequisites: Basic electricity market structure (generation, transmission, distribution)
Concept of half-hourly and non-half-hourly metering
Regulatory framework for network charging (Ofgem, CMA)
Elexon BSC party registration and BM Unit concepts

dipeng_emissions.topic: EU Emissions Trading Scheme and Air Quality Policy

concepts.name: Cap-and-Trade
concepts.scope: A regulatory mechanism setting an overall emissions ceiling within which covered entities may trade allowances to meet compliance obligations cost-effectively.

concepts.name: Emissions Allowance Allocation
concepts.scope: The process by which regulators distribute emissions permits to covered entities, including free allocation (grandfathering), auctioning, and benchmarking approaches.

concepts.name: Grandfathering
concepts.scope: Allocation of free emissions permits based on an entity's historical emission levels rather than on competitive bidding or performance benchmarks.

concepts.name: Benchmarking Allocation
concepts.scope: Setting permit entitlements by reference to an output- or activity-based efficiency standard rather than historical emissions.

concepts.name: Carbon Price
concepts.scope: The market-determined price of an emissions allowance that signals the marginal cost of abatement across covered installations.

concepts.name: Carbon Price Volatility
concepts.scope: Fluctuations in allowance prices arising from over-allocation, fuel-switching dynamics, and regulatory uncertainty within the ETS.

concepts.name: Windfall Profits
concepts.scope: Unintended gains accruing to energy producers who receive free allowances yet pass the opportunity cost of those allowances through to consumers in output prices.

concepts.name: Aviation Inclusion in ETS
concepts.scope: The policy extension of the EU ETS to cover CO2 emissions from air transport, with specific permit allocation challenges for different carrier types.

concepts.name: International Emissions Trading
concepts.scope: Cross-border exchange of emissions permits between industrialised and developing countries to achieve abatement at lower global cost.

concepts.name: Offset Credits (CCER)
concepts.scope: Emission reduction units generated by certified mitigation projects that covered entities may surrender in lieu of capped allowances.

concepts.name: PM2.5 and PM10 Particulate Matter
concepts.scope: Size-classified airborne particles regulated under EU air quality directives on account of their documented adverse effects on human health.

concepts.name: Chemical Transport Models
concepts.scope: Computational frameworks that simulate emissions dispersal, atmospheric chemistry, and pollutant transformation to produce air quality forecasts.

concepts.name: Reactive Nitrogen Compounds (RNC)
concepts.scope: A class of nitrogen-containing pollutants from combustion, including NOx and ammonia, subject to emissions ceilings under EU and UN-ECE protocols.

concepts.name: Epidemiological Exposure Assessment
concepts.scope: Quantification of population-level exposure to air pollutants to establish statistical associations between pollution concentrations and health outcomes.

concepts.name: Low Emission Zones
concepts.scope: Geographically defined urban areas where vehicle access is restricted to reduce local traffic-related air pollution concentrations.

concepts.name: Emissions Trading System (ETS)
concepts.scope: A cap-and-trade or intensity-based market mechanism requiring covered emitters to hold allowances equal to their verified emissions.

concepts.name: Quota Allocation
concepts.scope: The process by which regulatory authorities distribute emission allowances to covered entities, covering free allocation, auctioning, and grandfathering approaches.

concepts.name: Intensity-Based Reduction Target
concepts.scope: A carbon mitigation approach that caps emissions relative to output rather than imposing an absolute emissions ceiling.

concepts.name: Absolute Emissions Cap
concepts.scope: A hard upper limit on total greenhouse gas emissions within a trading system, as distinct from intensity-based benchmarks.

concepts.name: Market Liquidity
concepts.scope: The ease with which allowances can be bought and sold, measured by traded volume relative to total quota and turnover rates.

concepts.name: Compliance Period and Surrender Obligation
concepts.scope: The regulatory cycle within which covered entities must submit allowances equal to their verified emissions to avoid penalties.

concepts.name: Monitoring, Reporting and Verification (MRV)
concepts.scope: The standardised framework for measuring, disclosing, and independently checking greenhouse gas emissions of covered entities.

concepts.name: China Certified Emission Reduction (CCER)
concepts.scope: Domestic voluntary offset credits generated under approved methodologies that covered entities may use for a capped share of their compliance obligation.

concepts.name: Market Participant Eligibility
concepts.scope: Rules determining which entities—covered emitters, institutional investors, foreign participants—may open accounts and trade in a carbon market.

concepts.name: Price Discovery
concepts.scope: The process by which allowance prices are formed through continuous trading, auction, or negotiated block transfer mechanisms.

concepts.name: Offset Mechanism
concepts.scope: Provisions allowing covered entities to substitute a proportion of required allowances with certified emission reductions from approved project types.

concepts.name: Enforcement and Penalties
concepts.scope: Regulatory powers exercised by provincial and national authorities to sanction non-compliant entities through fines, administrative measures, or criminal prosecution.

concepts.name: Two-Tier Regulatory Structure
concepts.scope: Governance architecture dividing carbon market oversight between the national NDRC (policy and standards) and provincial DRCs (implementation and enforcement).

concepts.name: Registry and Settlement System
concepts.scope: The electronic infrastructure recording allowance holdings, transfers, surrenders, and cancellations and linking to exchange trading systems.

concepts.name: Benchmark Allowance Methodology (Grandfathering vs. Benchmarking)
concepts.scope: Alternative methods for setting entity-level free allocations, either from historical emission levels or from sectoral efficiency standards.

concepts.name: Carbon Finance Products
concepts.scope: Financial instruments—including pledged loans, repurchase agreements, bond structures, and asset management funds—that use carbon allowances or CCERs as underlying assets.

concepts.name: Market Transparency
concepts.scope: Obligations on exchanges and regulators to disclose prices, volumes, allocation data, and compliance outcomes to market participants.

concepts.name: Pilot-to-National Market Transition
concepts.scope: The policy and operational process of migrating regional pilot ETS schemes into a unified national carbon market framework.

concepts.name: Negotiated Block Transfer (协议转让)
concepts.scope: An over-the-counter trade mode for large-volume allowance transactions concluded bilaterally within an exchange-set price band.

concepts.name: Position Limits and Large-Holder Reporting
concepts.scope: Risk controls capping the maximum allowances held by any single participant and requiring disclosure when holdings approach defined thresholds.

concepts.name: Emissions Allowance (配额)
concepts.scope: Government-issued permit granting a covered entity the right to emit one tonne of CO2 within a defined compliance period.

concepts.name: Compliance Obligation (履约)
concepts.scope: Requirement for covered emitters to surrender allowances equal to their verified annual emissions by a specified deadline.

concepts.name: Cap Setting and Quota Allocation
concepts.scope: Administrative process by which authorities determine total annual emission caps and distribute allowances to covered entities.

concepts.name: Chinese Certified Emissions Reductions (CCERs)
concepts.scope: Domestic voluntary offset credits certified by the National Development and Reform Commission that can be used to partially fulfil compliance obligations.

concepts.name: Offset Usage Limits
concepts.scope: Regulatory ceiling—typically 5%—on the proportion of a covered entity's compliance obligation that may be met with offset credits rather than allowances.

concepts.name: Registry System (注册登记簿)
concepts.scope: Official electronic ledger that records the holding, transfer, cancellation, and retirement of emissions allowances and offsets.

concepts.name: Third-Party Verification (第三方核查)
concepts.scope: Independent audit of a covered entity's emissions report conducted by an accredited verification body before allowances are issued or surrendered.

concepts.name: Open-Market Operations (公开市场操作)
concepts.scope: Regulator-initiated allowance auctions or buy-backs used to dampen excessive price volatility and maintain orderly market conditions.

concepts.name: Price Controls and Circuit Breakers
concepts.scope: Exchange rules that suspend or restrict trading when allowance prices move beyond defined percentage bands within a session or across consecutive days.

concepts.name: Position Limits (持仓限制)
concepts.scope: Maximum allowance volumes that a single participant may hold or transact in a single session, designed to prevent market concentration.

concepts.name: Auction Mechanism (配额拍卖)
concepts.scope: Sealed-bid, uniform-price auction process by which regulators sell reserve allowances to compliance entities and other approved participants.

concepts.name: Buy-back / Repurchase (配额回购)
concepts.scope: Regulator-funded purchase of allowances from the secondary market when prices fall below a prescribed minimum to support the carbon price floor.

concepts.name: Margin / Performance Bond (诚信保证金)
concepts.scope: Financial deposit lodged with the exchange by participants to cover potential settlement obligations arising from their trading activity.

concepts.name: OTC / Negotiated Transfer (协议转让)
concepts.scope: Bilaterally negotiated allowance transaction conducted outside the exchange order book, subject to separate documentation and registration requirements.

concepts.name: Block Trade Rules (大宗交易)
concepts.scope: Special procedures applicable when a single trade order exceeds a defined volume threshold, requiring off-screen negotiation and subsequent exchange registration.

concepts.name: T+3 Settlement
concepts.scope: Allowance delivery and cash payment completion three trading days after the trade date, as prescribed by Beijing exchange rules.

concepts.name: Administrative Penalty Discretion (行政处罚自由裁量权)
concepts.scope: Structured framework specifying graduated penalty bands for non-compliance, including reporting failures and over-allocation emissions.

concepts.name: KYC / Counterparty Approval
concepts.scope: Requirement for a market participant to vet and approve trading counterparties before executing transactions, including blocking unapproved members.

concepts.name: Exit Put Option on Pilot Allowances
concepts.scope: Contractual right entitling a counterparty to sell pilot-market allowances back to Shell at a guaranteed floor price (CNY 25), synthetically replicating a put option payoff.

concepts.name: Pilot-to-National Allowance Conversion
concepts.scope: Mechanism by which pilot-scheme allowances held at the end of the pilot period are exchanged for national ETS allowances at a regulatory-determined conversion ratio.

concepts.name: Asian (Average-Price) Put Option
concepts.scope: Path-dependent option whose payoff is based on the average settlement price of allowances over a period rather than the price on a single expiry date.

concepts.name: Lock-in Period and Liquidity Strategy
concepts.scope: Contractual holding period during which a counterparty cannot freely sell allowances except under defined conditions, used to manage supply timing and price targets.

concepts.name: Trader-Assessed Probability (vprob)
concepts.scope: Subjective probability assigned by a trader to the volume of allowances that will trade at or above a target price during the lock-in period, used to value optionality.

concepts.name: Carbon Price Floor / CNY 20 Guarantee
concepts.scope: Contractual guarantee by Shell to compensate counterparties if converted national allowances' average price falls below CNY 20 per tonne.

concepts.name: Anti-Bribery and Anti-Money Laundering Compliance
concepts.scope: Contractual obligations requiring exchange members to comply with applicable AML and anti-bribery laws in connection with allowance transactions.

concepts.name: Pilot Carbon Allowances (SHEA/GDEA)
concepts.scope: Tradeable emission permits issued under China's Shanghai and Guangdong pilot emissions trading schemes.

concepts.name: National Allowance Conversion
concepts.scope: The regulatory process by which pilot scheme allowances are exchanged for allowances under the forthcoming Chinese national ETS at a regulator-set conversion ratio.

concepts.name: Exit Put Option (CNY25-strike)
concepts.scope: An embedded option granting the dealer the right to sell accumulated allowances back at a fixed CNY strike price, arising from volume-weighted trading mechanics during the lock-in period.

concepts.name: CNY20-strike Asian Put
concepts.scope: An average-price put option on national allowances, implicitly written by the dealer as a price floor guarantee to counterparts on converted volumes.

concepts.name: Lock-in Period
concepts.scope: A 20-month window during which counterpart allowance positions are constrained and on-screen trading volumes determine option payoff triggers.

concepts.name: vprob (Probability-weighted Volume)
concepts.scope: The trader-assessed volume of pilot allowances expected to be sold at or above CNY25, used to parameterise deal value sensitivities.

concepts.name: Conversion Ratio (c)
concepts.scope: The regulator-determined ratio of national allowances received per pilot allowance surrendered, affecting residual position size and hedging requirements.

concepts.name: Deal Value Decomposition (Values 1–5)
concepts.scope: A structured breakdown of total deal PnL into component sources including spread income, screen-trading fees, interest carry, put premium capture, and conversion margin.

concepts.name: PNational (Average National Allowance Price)
concepts.scope: The simple average of national allowance closing prices from conversion date to 30 June 2018, used as the settlement reference for converted volume payoffs.

concepts.name: Delta-Hedging with Forward National Allowances
concepts.scope: Selling forward national allowances to offset directional price exposure when probability-weighted volume falls short of the full position.

concepts.name: Dynamic Hedging of Average-Price Guarantee
concepts.scope: Daily pro-rata forward sales of residual national allowance volumes to replicate a delta-hedge against the Asian put exposure embedded in the price guarantee.

concepts.name: FX Sensitivity (USD/CNY)
concepts.scope: Linear dependence of deal values on the USD/CNY exchange rate arising from USD-denominated investment into CNY-denominated allowances.

concepts.name: Allowance Price Seasonality
concepts.scope: Recurring intra-year price patterns in Chinese carbon markets exploited by timing allowance sales around conversion and settlement windows.

concepts.name: Stress-Testing and Breakeven Analysis
concepts.scope: Scenario analysis across conversion ratios and national allowance price levels to determine the PNational breakeven that covers guaranteed floor losses.

concepts.name: Implied Volatility of Carbon Allowances
concepts.scope: Market-implied or historically estimated volatility of pilot and national allowance prices, used to price embedded put options.

concepts.name: PnL Simulation
concepts.scope: Quantitative modelling of deal cashflows across Monte Carlo or scenario paths to assess expected margin and tail risk.

concepts.name: Value at Risk (VaR)
concepts.scope: A statistical measure of potential deal loss used to size and stress-test the early access structure positions.

dipeng_gas_storage.topic: Gas Storage Valuation and Market Design

concepts.name: Intrinsic Value of Storage
concepts.scope: The static value derived from locking in forward price differentials between injection and withdrawal seasons on the valuation date.

concepts.name: Extrinsic Value of Storage
concepts.scope: The additional value beyond intrinsic value obtainable from dynamic re-optimisation using spot and forward price volatility and asset flexibility.

concepts.name: Seasonal Spread
concepts.scope: The price differential between summer and winter gas forward prices used as the primary market signal for storage value, though argued to be an incomplete indicator.

concepts.name: Rolling Intrinsic Strategy
concepts.scope: A dynamic hedging approach that repeatedly recalculates intrinsic value using updated forward curves and adjusts hedge positions to capture incremental gains without accepting lower value.

concepts.name: Storage Flexibility Tools
concepts.scope: The set of competing instruments—storage, spot purchases, LNG, long-term contract flexibility, interruptible contracts—that shippers use to meet balancing and seasonal modulation needs.

concepts.name: Security of Supply Insurance Value
concepts.scope: The option-like benefit storage provides as a physical hedge against supply interruptions, geopolitical events, and extreme weather that spot or hub markets cannot guarantee.

concepts.name: Mothballing and Decommissioning
concepts.scope: Temporary or permanent removal of storage capacity from service, carrying high irreversible costs and multi-year lead times to restore, with implications for future supply security.

concepts.name: Standard Bundled Unit (SBU)
concepts.scope: The contractual unit at Gas Storage Bergermeer bundling a fixed quantity of space, injection capacity, and withdrawal capacity sold under a Standard Storage Services Agreement.

concepts.name: Working Gas Bundle (WGB)
concepts.scope: A tradeable package of gas-in-storage and associated withdrawal-period space at Bergermeer that can be transferred, reversed, or sold between customer and bank counterparties.

concepts.name: Indexed Capacity Fee
concepts.scope: A storage tariff structure where the capacity fee is linked to the average TTF summer-winter spread observed over a defined pricing window prior to the storage year.

concepts.name: Transmission Tariffs at Storage Points
concepts.scope: Entry and exit charges applied to storage injection and withdrawal flows that can erode storage economics and create cross-subsidies with other network users.

concepts.name: Power-to-Gas Technology
concepts.scope: An emerging conversion process that uses surplus renewable electricity to produce hydrogen or synthetic methane for underground storage and later re-conversion to power.

concepts.name: Storage Multiplier
concepts.scope: A back-tested ratio expressing realised storage value relative to the indexed capacity fee benchmark, used to calibrate contract pricing at Bergermeer.

concepts.name: Pressure Factors (Injection/Withdrawal)
concepts.scope: Linear curtailment factors applied to nominal injection and withdrawal capacities reflecting reservoir pressure constraints that reduce effective throughput rates.

concepts.name: Day-Ahead Firm Storage Contract
concepts.scope: A bilateral agreement granting firm injection, withdrawal, and space rights on a day-ahead nomination basis for a defined seasonal period at a specific facility.

concepts.name: Third Energy Package Unbundling
concepts.scope: EU regulatory requirement for ownership or functional separation of gas transmission operations from supply and production activities to ensure non-discriminatory network access.

concepts.name: Market Integration and Storage Complementarity
concepts.scope: The principle that deeper cross-border gas market integration increases hub liquidity but does not eliminate the need for physical storage flexibility near demand centres.

concepts.name: GSB Multiplier
concepts.scope: A price multiplier applied to the seasonal spread to determine the capacity fee per Standard Bundled Unit of gas storage.

concepts.name: Storage Year Spread (SW Spread)
concepts.scope: The absolute difference between average forward baseload winter and summer TTF gas prices over defined reference days preceding a storage year.

concepts.name: Total/Intrinsic Ratio
concepts.scope: The ratio of total achieved storage value (including extrinsic value) to intrinsic value derived from the seasonal spread at pricing time.

concepts.name: Intrinsic Value
concepts.scope: The locked-in value of gas storage derived solely from the observable forward price seasonal spread at the time of valuation.

concepts.name: Extrinsic Value
concepts.scope: The additional value of gas storage beyond intrinsic value, arising from volatility and optionality in spot and forward price movements during the storage year.

concepts.name: Forward Curve Volatility
concepts.scope: The degree of variation in the forward gas price structure over a storage year, which drives the extrinsic component of storage value.

concepts.name: Reserve Multiplier
concepts.scope: The minimum multiplier below which TAQA will not sell any SBUs in the primary capacity auction.

concepts.name: Cut-Off Multiplier
concepts.scope: The lowest multiplier at which SBUs are actually allocated in the auction clearing process.

concepts.name: Primary Capacity Auction
concepts.scope: A sealed-bid, single-round auction mechanism through which storage capacity SBUs are allocated to bidders at indexed prices via ICE Endex.

concepts.name: Indexed Price Formula
concepts.scope: The pricing structure for SBUs expressed as a multiplier times the Storage Year Spread, linking capacity fees to observable market spreads.

concepts.name: Tender (Tenor)
concepts.scope: The contract duration selected by a bidder in the auction, covering one, two, or three consecutive storage years.

concepts.name: Within-Day Value
concepts.scope: Additional storage value created by trading gas on a day-ahead or within-day basis to exploit short-term price movements.

concepts.name: Injection and Withdrawal Fees
concepts.scope: Per-unit commodity charges applied when gas is physically injected into or withdrawn from the storage facility.

concepts.name: Inventory Management under Capacity Constraints
concepts.scope: Operational decisions to sell gas early on spot markets when inventory risks not reaching full capacity due to insufficient forward hedges.

concepts.name: TTF Forward Curve
concepts.scope: The term structure of natural gas forward prices at the Title Transfer Facility hub used as the reference index for storage valuation and fee calculation.

concepts.name: Secondary Trading
concepts.scope: Transfer of capacity or gas-in-storage entitlements between storage customers after initial primary capacity allocation.

concepts.name: Interruptible Capacity
concepts.scope: Storage capacity that may be curtailed by the operator under defined conditions, typically priced at a discount to firm capacity.

concepts.name: Registered Capacity
concepts.scope: The contractually held injection capacity, space, or withdrawal capacity recorded in GSB's registers for a storage customer.

concepts.name: Firm Capacity
concepts.scope: The effective available injection or withdrawal capacity after adjusting registered capacity by pressure factors and maintenance/outage/FM deduction factors.

concepts.name: Injection Pressure Factor (ipf)
concepts.scope: A linear scaling factor reducing injection capacity as gas-in-storage increases from zero to full, ranging from 100% to 75.5%.

concepts.name: Withdrawal Pressure Factor (wpf)
concepts.scope: A linear scaling factor increasing withdrawal capacity as gas-in-storage rises from zero to full, ranging from 52.3% to 100%.

concepts.name: Maintenance Factor
concepts.scope: A decimal factor (0 to 1) representing the proportion of injection or withdrawal capacity unavailable due to planned or unplanned maintenance.

concepts.name: Outage Factor
concepts.scope: A decimal factor (0 to 1) representing the proportion of injection or withdrawal capacity unavailable due to an unplanned outage event.

concepts.name: Force Majeure Factor (iff / wff)
concepts.scope: A decimal factor applied to reduce firm injection or withdrawal capacity during a force majeure event affecting the storage facility.

concepts.name: Gas-in-Storage
concepts.scope: The running contractual balance of gas held in the facility for a customer, updated each hour by injection, withdrawal, and trade quantities.

concepts.name: Contract Quantity
concepts.scope: The binding injection or withdrawal quantity for a given hour, determined at the request close time from the customer's preliminary quantity.

concepts.name: Preliminary Quantity
concepts.scope: The current nominated injection or withdrawal quantity for a given hour, which may be revised by the customer or GSB before the request close time.

concepts.name: Register Transfer
concepts.scope: A bilateral transfer of gas-in-storage or registered capacity between two storage customers via the trade services system, without a price.

concepts.name: Notified Trade
concepts.scope: A bilaterally agreed priced trade of gas-in-storage or registered capacity between two storage customers confirmed through matched notifications.

concepts.name: Screen Trade
concepts.scope: An anonymous order-book trade of gas-in-storage or registered capacity executed through the central counterparty in the trade services system.

concepts.name: Trade Services System (TSS)
concepts.scope: The operator-run electronic platform enabling storage customers to transfer and trade gas-in-storage and capacity among themselves.

concepts.name: Outage Liquidated Damages (Outage LD)
concepts.scope: Pre-agreed damages payable by GSB to customers for each outage hour, calculated as 50% of the seasonal spread times affected registered capacity and outage factor.

concepts.name: Spread
concepts.scope: The absolute difference between the average forward TTF baseload winter and summer gas prices for a storage year, used to calibrate outage damages.

concepts.name: Outage LD Cap
concepts.scope: The annual ceiling on total outage liquidated damages payable by GSB to all storage customers, equal to the Spread times three million MWh.

concepts.name: Injection Fee
concepts.scope: A per-kWh charge on injection contract quantities, set as a fixed fraction of the average forward Dutch baseload electricity price.

concepts.name: Withdrawal Fee
concepts.scope: A per-kWh charge on withdrawal contract quantities, set as a fixed fraction of the average forward Dutch baseload electricity price.

concepts.name: Average Forward Baseload Electricity Price
concepts.scope: The average of daily end-of-day settlement prices for Dutch calendar-year baseload power observed from 1 June to 31 August preceding the storage year.

concepts.name: Capacity Fees
concepts.scope: Periodic charges for holding registered injection capacity, space, or withdrawal capacity under primary and secondary capacity agreements.

concepts.name: Gas-in-Storage Price
concepts.scope: The agreed price at which gas-in-storage is bought or sold between customers in a notified trade or screen trade, settled via GSB.

concepts.name: Default Quantity
concepts.scope: The difference between the contract quantity and the gas actually accepted or delivered at TTF in a given hour due to a party's breach.

concepts.name: Gas Foundation
concepts.scope: A legal entity to which title to injected gas transfers at the connection point, holding gas in trust for the operation of the storage facility.

concepts.name: Contractual Working Gas
concepts.scope: The aggregate gas-in-storage balance across all storage customers and users as recorded contractually in the GSB registers.

concepts.name: Physical Working Gas
concepts.scope: The aggregate physical volume of gas in the facility beneficially owned by storage customers that can contractually be withdrawn within six months.

concepts.name: Full Storage Day
concepts.scope: A day on which a customer's gas-in-storage equals or would exceed registered space, triggering GSB's right to adjust injection and withdrawal quantities.

concepts.name: Credit Limit and Exposure
concepts.scope: The maximum financial exposure a customer may have outstanding with GSB, used to gate approval of trades and transfers on the TSS.

concepts.name: TTF (Title Transfer Facility)
concepts.scope: The Dutch virtual gas trading and balancing point at which injection and withdrawal obligations under the agreement are physically and contractually effected.

concepts.name: Storage Service Agreement (SSSA)
concepts.scope: Contractual framework governing rights and obligations between a storage operator and customer for gas storage capacity at a named facility.

concepts.name: Customer Termination Event
concepts.scope: Defined conditions under which a storage customer may terminate the agreement, including operator breach, insolvency, or physical gas shortfall.

concepts.name: GSB Termination Event
concepts.scope: Defined conditions under which the storage operator may terminate the agreement, including customer breach or insolvency.

concepts.name: FM Termination Event
concepts.scope: Force-majeure-triggered termination right arising when injection or withdrawal outage and FM factors exceed a combined threshold over a sustained period.

concepts.name: Injection Outage Factor (iof) and FM Factor (iff)
concepts.scope: Hourly capacity availability metrics that measure the proportion of injection capacity unavailable due to outage or force majeure respectively.

concepts.name: Withdrawal Outage Factor (wof) and FM Factor (wff)
concepts.scope: Hourly capacity availability metrics that measure the proportion of withdrawal capacity unavailable due to outage or force majeure respectively.

concepts.name: Termination Unwind and Present Value Settlement
concepts.scope: Mechanism for calculating and settling the present value of remaining registered capacities upon non-FM termination, netted against outstanding fees.

concepts.name: Registered Injection, Withdrawal and Space Capacity
concepts.scope: Contractually booked capacity parameters specifying the maximum injection rate, withdrawal rate and working gas volume a customer may hold.

concepts.name: Physical Working Gas vs Contractual Working Gas
concepts.scope: Comparison metric used to determine whether the operator has delivered the contracted storage volume, with a shortfall threshold triggering termination rights.

concepts.name: Assignment and Security Interests
concepts.scope: Rules governing permitted transfers of contractual rights, including pledge or security interest, subject to counterparty credit and consent conditions.

concepts.name: Customer Sensitive Information
concepts.scope: Category of commercially sensitive data about the customer's capacity, trades and financials that the operator is contractually required to keep confidential.

concepts.name: Interruptible Withdrawal Capacity
concepts.scope: Optional additional withdrawal capacity available on a non-firm basis, subject to an incremental fee and operator discretion.

concepts.name: Gas Quality and TTF
concepts.scope: Provision specifying that gas quality at the TTF virtual trading point is governed by the Dutch Network Code rather than the storage agreement.

concepts.name: Storage Valuation Model
concepts.scope: Spreadsheet-based quantitative model for pricing gas storage capacity at multiple facilities using intrinsic and extrinsic value decomposition.

concepts.name: Extrinsic (Optionality) Value of Storage
concepts.scope: The incremental value of storage above intrinsic arising from the ability to re-optimise injection and withdrawal decisions as prices evolve.

concepts.name: Churn Rate
concepts.scope: The number of times the full working gas volume can be cycled through injection and withdrawal over a storage period, used to parameterise storage capacity.

concepts.name: Winter-Summer Spread
concepts.scope: The forward price differential between winter delivery months and summer months that drives the core intrinsic value of seasonal gas storage.

concepts.name: Within-Day and Day-Ahead Volatility
concepts.scope: Short-term price volatility parameters used to value the high-frequency re-optimisation rights inherent in fast-cycle or flexible storage.

concepts.name: Working Capital (WC) in Storage Valuation
concepts.scope: The financing cost of the gas inventory held in storage, modelled as a drag on storage value in the pricing spreadsheets.

concepts.name: Expert Determination
concepts.scope: Dispute resolution mechanism allowing either party to refer valuation disputes, including termination present-value calculations, to an independent expert.

concepts.name: Neutral Gas Price
concepts.scope: A reference index price used within the agreement for fee settlement, liquidated damages and other financial calculations.

concepts.name: Outage Liquidated Damages (Outage LDs)
concepts.scope: Pre-agreed financial compensation payable by the operator when planned or unplanned outages reduce available capacity below contracted levels.

concepts.name: Capacity Fee Structure
concepts.scope: The schedule of fees payable for injection, withdrawal and space capacity, which are zeroed on termination except for amounts accrued pre-notice.

concepts.name: Bulletin Board
concepts.scope: Operator-maintained electronic notice board used to communicate maintenance, outage, force majeure and full-storage notices to storage customers.

concepts.name: Suspension Rights
concepts.scope: Customer right to suspend all contractual rights and obligations when physical gas shortfall conditions persist without a termination notice being issued.

methods: Intrinsic value calculation from forward curve
Back-testing against historical TTF forward curves
Iteration over indexed pricing window (90 pricing days)
Storage capacity sizing analysis (network investment avoidance)

Priority allocation by multiplier then tenor at tie-break

Linear interpolation for pressure factor calculation
Forward price averaging for fee and LD parameter calculation
Liquidated damages formula (50% × Spread × capacity × factor)
Forward curve spread analysis for intrinsic storage valuation
Stochastic optimisation / Monte Carlo simulation for extrinsic storage value
Sensitivity analysis across injection/withdrawal capacity configurations
Churn-rate parameterisation of storage cycling flexibility
Present value calculation of remaining capacity for termination settlement
Working capital drag adjustment in storage pricing
Within-day and day-ahead volatility estimation for short-cycle value
Backtesting of storage dispatch strategies against historical prices
Threshold-based triggering logic for FM and termination event classification

dipeng_goos.topic: Guarantee of Origin (GoO) long-term supply agreement negotiation between a utility network operator and an energy trading company

concepts.name: Guarantee of Origin (GoO)
concepts.scope: A tradeable certificate attesting that a specified quantity of electricity was generated from a renewable energy source.

concepts.name: GoO supply agreement
concepts.scope: A bilateral contract governing the long-term purchase and sale of Guarantees of Origin between a seller and a buyer.

concepts.name: Confidential Information
concepts.scope: Any information exchanged between parties in the context of negotiating a GoO or power supply agreement, subject to non-disclosure obligations.

concepts.name: Term sheet
concepts.scope: A non-binding document outlining the core commercial terms of a proposed GoO transaction prior to execution of definitive agreements.

concepts.name: Permitted Purpose
concepts.scope: The defined scope within which disclosed confidential information may be used, here limited to negotiating a long-term GoO and potential power supply agreement.

concepts.name: Affiliate
concepts.scope: An entity that directly or indirectly controls, is controlled by, or is under common control with a contracting party, typically defined by a 50% voting capital threshold.

concepts.name: Offshore wind GoO sourcing
concepts.scope: The procurement of Guarantees of Origin specifically linked to generation from a named offshore wind farm (Borssele 3 & 4).

dipeng_initiatives.topic: European natural gas transmission network and cross-border interconnection capacities

concepts.name: Cross-border interconnection points
concepts.scope: Physical or virtual locations where gas transmission capacity is offered between neighbouring TSO systems across national borders.

concepts.name: Maximum technical capacity
concepts.scope: The maximum firm capacity that a TSO can offer at an interconnection point in a given flow direction.

concepts.name: Bidirectional flow capability
concepts.scope: Classification of interconnection points by whether firm or virtual reverse capacity can be offered in both directions simultaneously.

concepts.name: Virtual backhaul capacity
concepts.scope: Commercially offered reverse-flow capacity at a point that is physically unidirectional, enabled through netting or nomination offsets.

concepts.name: Trading points and market areas
concepts.scope: Virtual hubs or balancing zones where gas title transfers between shippers, identified by area codes such as TTF, NBP, PSV, and GASPOOL.

concepts.name: LNG terminal entry points
concepts.scope: Connection locations at which regasified LNG is injected into the onshore transmission system, with associated technical capacities.

concepts.name: Gross calorific value (GCV)
concepts.scope: Energy content per unit volume of gas used to convert physical flow quantities between volumetric and energy units at interconnection points.

concepts.name: Transmission system operators (TSOs)
concepts.scope: Entities responsible for operating national or regional high-pressure gas transport networks and publishing capacity data at interconnection points.

concepts.name: Gas storage facility types
concepts.scope: Classification of underground storage assets—salt cavern, aquifer, depleted field—that connect to the transmission system.

concepts.name: ENTSOG Ten-Year Network Development Plan (TYNDP)
concepts.scope: Forward-looking infrastructure plan listing existing and planned pipeline and LNG projects across the ENTSOG member area.

concepts.name: Primary market capacity
concepts.scope: Firm and interruptible transmission capacity auctioned directly by TSOs at interconnection points on the regulated primary market.

concepts.name: Summer capacity
concepts.scope: Additional technical capacity available at specific interconnection points only during the summer months due to reduced domestic demand.

methods: Tabular capacity data presentation by interconnection point
GCV-based unit conversion from GWh/d to Mm³/d

concepts.name: European gas storage balances
concepts.scope: Covers the role of seasonal storage levels in setting European gas price dynamics and supply overhang.

concepts.name: TTF hub liquidity and churn rate
concepts.scope: Covers the growth of TTF as Europe's dominant traded gas hub measured by traded volume relative to NBP and churn rate.

concepts.name: Gas price drivers
concepts.scope: Covers the supply-side, demand-side, and structural factors that determine wholesale gas prices in Europe.

concepts.name: LNG supply growth and Atlantic Basin expansion
concepts.scope: Covers the wave of new liquefaction capacity, particularly US LNG, and its impact on global and European gas balances.

concepts.name: Europe as global gas balancing market
concepts.scope: Covers Europe's function as the intersection of global LNG and pipeline supply flows that absorbs surplus volumes.

concepts.name: Oil-indexed versus hub-indexed gas contracts
concepts.scope: Covers the transition in long-term supply contracts from oil-price linkage toward index and fixed-price structures at traded hubs.

concepts.name: Gas-to-power dynamics
concepts.scope: Covers how coal plant retirements, CO2 costs, and gas supply overhang determine gas consumption in power generation.

concepts.name: Renewables integration and intermittency
concepts.scope: Covers the impact of wind and solar growth on daily power market changes and gas demand patterns.

concepts.name: Structured gas and power products
concepts.scope: Covers bespoke commercial structures including storage/transport optionality, tolling agreements, and flexible-volume supply arrangements.

concepts.name: Groningen production constraints
concepts.scope: Covers politically motivated permit restrictions on Dutch Groningen field output and their effect on European supply levels.

concepts.name: Cross-regional gas trade flows
concepts.scope: Covers the global network of LNG and pipeline trade routes connecting export and import regions by 2020.

concepts.name: Market participant landscape in European energy trading
concepts.scope: Covers the changing mix of utilities, banks, industrial users, hedge funds, and LDCs active in gas, power, and emissions markets.

concepts.name: REMIT reporting obligations
concepts.scope: Covers EU regulatory requirements for transaction and fundamental data reporting in wholesale power and gas markets.

concepts.name: Oil inventory overhang and energy price linkage
concepts.scope: Covers how crude oil stock levels feed through to gas and power commodity price sentiment.

concepts.name: Monthly settlement payment
concepts.scope: Covers the periodic financial settlement amount owed between parties in a power purchase or balancing arrangement.

concepts.name: Rate of change (ROC) adjustment
concepts.scope: Covers modifications to the payment calculation that incorporate a rate-of-change metric, likely related to frequency response or grid services.

concepts.name: Payment reconciliation
concepts.scope: Covers the process of comparing calculated payment figures across multiple model versions to ensure consistency and accuracy.

concepts.name: Contract payment structure
concepts.scope: Covers the contractual breakdown of charges, revenues, or fees that feed into the monthly settlement total.

dipeng_literature.topic: Single-factor forward-curve-consistent energy option pricing and trinomial tree methods

concepts.name: Forward curve consistency
concepts.scope: Property requiring a model to reproduce exactly the initially observed market forward price curve at every maturity.

concepts.name: Single-factor forward price SDE
concepts.scope: Stochastic differential equation driving the entire energy forward curve with a negative-exponential volatility structure.

concepts.name: Mean reversion in spot prices
concepts.scope: Tendency of energy spot prices to revert toward a long-run level, parameterised here by the speed-of-reversion coefficient alpha.

concepts.name: Negative-exponential volatility structure
concepts.scope: Specification in which forward price return volatility declines exponentially with time-to-maturity, ensuring spot price Markovianity.

concepts.name: Risk-neutral pricing
concepts.scope: Valuation of contingent claims as expected discounted payoffs under the equivalent martingale measure.

concepts.name: European option on energy spot
concepts.scope: Closed-form Black-type formula for a call or put on the spot energy price under lognormal forward dynamics.

concepts.name: European option on forward/futures contract
concepts.scope: Closed-form pricing formula for an option whose underlying is a forward contract maturing beyond the option expiry.

concepts.name: Energy price cap
concepts.scope: Instrument limiting the floating price paid by the holder, valued as a portfolio of European call options on successive settlement dates.

concepts.name: Energy price floor
concepts.scope: Instrument setting a minimum price received, valued as a portfolio of European put options.

concepts.name: Energy price collar
concepts.scope: Combination of a long cap and a short floor used to bound energy price exposure within a range.

concepts.name: Energy swaption
concepts.scope: Option to enter a swap exchanging floating spot price payments for a fixed strike, priced analytically by decomposition into forward options.

concepts.name: Trinomial tree
concepts.scope: Discrete lattice with three branches per node used to approximate continuous spot price dynamics for American and path-dependent option pricing.

concepts.name: State prices (Arrow-Debreu prices)
concepts.scope: Time-zero values of securities paying one unit if and only if a specific tree node is reached, used in forward induction to fit the forward curve.

concepts.name: Forward induction
concepts.scope: Recursive computation of state prices moving forward through the tree to calibrate nodal displacements to observed forward prices.

concepts.name: Nodal displacement (shift) method
concepts.scope: Two-stage tree-building technique that first constructs a zero-drift tree then shifts node levels to match the market forward curve exactly.

concepts.name: American option early exercise
concepts.scope: Optimisation over stopping times embedded in backward induction through the tree to determine the value of early exercise rights.

concepts.name: Asian (average price) option
concepts.scope: Path-dependent option whose payoff depends on the arithmetic average of the spot price over fixing dates, requiring storage of average distributions at each node.

concepts.name: Path-dependent option pricing in trees
concepts.scope: Extension of standard backward induction storing multiple values of a path function at each node and interpolating between stored values.

concepts.name: Convenience yield
concepts.scope: Implicit benefit from holding the physical commodity, inferred from the slope of the forward curve and affecting early exercise premia.

concepts.name: Integrated forward price variance
concepts.scope: Integral of squared forward return volatility over the option life, determining the effective Black volatility for forward option pricing.

concepts.name: Markovian spot price process
concepts.scope: Condition under which the spot price alone is sufficient as a state variable, achieved here by the exponential volatility form.

concepts.name: Pipe-to-pipe competition (P2PC)
concepts.scope: The degree to which alternative pipeline routes constrain a transmission system operator from raising tariffs above competitive levels.

concepts.name: Destination market
concepts.scope: A gas transport market defined by shippers who must deliver gas to a fixed network point and seek competing pipeline routes to reach it.

concepts.name: Origin market
concepts.scope: A gas transport market defined by shippers who must evacuate gas from a fixed network point and seek competing pipeline routes away from it.

concepts.name: Parallel-path (transit) market
concepts.scope: A gas transport market defined by shippers moving gas between two fixed external points across an intermediate network, who may have alternative transit routes.

concepts.name: SSNIP test
concepts.scope: A hypothetical monopolist test that asks whether a small but significant non-transitory price increase would be profitable, used here to delineate relevant gas transport markets.

concepts.name: Entry-exit tariff system
concepts.scope: A tariffication framework in which shippers pay separate charges for injecting and withdrawing gas at network nodes, independently of the specific path taken.

concepts.name: Bypass pipeline
concepts.scope: A pipeline built by a network user to connect directly to an alternative network, thereby avoiding the incumbent TSO's tariffs.

concepts.name: Herfindahl-Hirschman Index (HHI)
concepts.scope: A concentration measure used to assess whether the number and size distribution of competing pipelines is sufficient for effective competition.

concepts.name: Residual Supplier Index (RSI)
concepts.scope: A market-power indicator measuring whether a specific supplier is pivotal to meeting demand, applied here to pipeline capacity markets.

concepts.name: Long-run marginal cost (LRMC)
concepts.scope: The cost benchmark against which a TSO's tariff-setting ability is assessed to determine whether it can sustain supra-competitive prices.

concepts.name: Secondary capacity market
concepts.scope: A market in which holders of long-term primary pipeline capacity resell that capacity, potentially providing competitive discipline on primary tariffs.

concepts.name: Countervailing buyer power
concepts.scope: The ability of large gas shippers or project developers to negotiate tariffs bilaterally with a TSO, limiting the TSO's market power at specific entry or exit points.

concepts.name: Spare capacity on alternative routes
concepts.scope: The available headroom on competing pipelines that determines whether transit or other flows can physically switch away from the incumbent TSO in response to a price increase.

concepts.name: Natural monopoly
concepts.scope: A market structure in which a single pipeline operator can serve all demand at lower cost than two or more competing pipelines, underpinning the rationale for tariff regulation.

concepts.name: Hub-to-hub capacity
concepts.scope: A virtual transport service facilitating gas transfers between separate virtual trading points operated by different TSOs across national borders.

concepts.name: Virtual Trading Point (VTP)
concepts.scope: A notional node within an entry-exit zone where gas ownership can change without specifying a physical transport path.

concepts.name: Tariff benchmarking
concepts.scope: A regulatory method that sets or validates pipeline tariffs by comparison with those of other operators rather than through a pure cost-of-service calculation.

concepts.name: Supply-side substitutability
concepts.scope: The ability of alternative pipeline operators to offer competing capacity on a route within a timeframe relevant to market definition analysis.

concepts.name: Barriers to entry in pipeline markets
concepts.scope: Structural and regulatory obstacles—including planning approvals, sunk costs, and right-of-way requirements—that prevent new pipelines from contesting an incumbent TSO's market.

concepts.name: Light regulation vs full regulation
concepts.scope: A regulatory spectrum distinguishing pipelines subject only to third-party access obligations from those whose tariffs and service terms are also controlled in advance.

concepts.name: Market power in gas transmission
concepts.scope: Covers the ability of a transmission system operator to profitably raise tariffs at entry, exit, and border points absent competitive constraints.

concepts.name: Bypass pipeline threat
concepts.scope: Covers the conditions under which a shipper could economically build an independent pipeline to avoid an incumbent TSO's network.

concepts.name: SSNIP test in pipeline markets
concepts.scope: Applies the Small Significant Non-transitory Increase in Price test to define relevant geographic and product markets for gas transit routes.

concepts.name: Transit market definition
concepts.scope: Covers identification of origin-destination pairs for cross-border gas flows and assessment of alternative route substitutability.

concepts.name: Origin and destination markets
concepts.scope: Distinguishes shipper categories based on whether gas is being injected into or withdrawn from a network at domestic or border points.

concepts.name: Long-run marginal cost (LRMC) of pipeline capacity
concepts.scope: Covers the cost benchmark used to assess whether a new entrant or the incumbent can add capacity more cheaply, setting a ceiling on regulated or unregulated tariffs.

concepts.name: Primary and secondary capacity markets
concepts.scope: Covers the distinction between capacity purchased directly from the TSO and capacity resold by existing shippers on bulletin boards.

concepts.name: Price discrimination in entry-exit systems
concepts.scope: Covers the feasibility of charging different tariffs to transit versus domestic users by offsetting changes at paired entry and exit points.

concepts.name: Contestability of pipeline markets
concepts.scope: Covers the extent to which the threat of new pipeline construction constrains the incumbent TSO's pricing for new and existing capacity.

concepts.name: Demand elasticity for gas transport
concepts.scope: Covers the low responsiveness of shippers and end-customers to transport tariff increases given long-term contractual commitments and small transport cost share.

concepts.name: Clean Development Mechanism (CDM)
concepts.scope: Covers the Kyoto Protocol flexibility mechanism allowing Annex I parties to earn certified emission reductions from projects in non-Annex I countries.

concepts.name: Kyoto Mechanisms
concepts.scope: Covers the three market-based instruments—CDM, Joint Implementation, and International Emissions Trading—created under the Kyoto Protocol to achieve cost-effective GHG reductions.

concepts.name: Certified Emission Reductions (CERs)
concepts.scope: Covers the carbon credits issued under the CDM after verification and certification of emission reductions achieved by registered project activities.

concepts.name: Baseline and additionality in CDM
concepts.scope: Covers the requirement that CDM projects demonstrate emissions reductions beyond what would have occurred in the absence of the project.

concepts.name: Crediting period for CDM projects
concepts.scope: Covers the time window over which a registered CDM project activity is eligible to generate CERs, including renewal procedures.

concepts.name: Afforestation and Reforestation CDM (A/R CDM)
concepts.scope: Covers the specific CDM modality for land-use sink projects including the non-permanence risk and temporary credit instruments (tCER, lCER).

concepts.name: Small-scale CDM (SSC)
concepts.scope: Covers simplified modalities and bundling procedures for CDM projects below defined capacity or output thresholds.

concepts.name: Programme of Activities (PoA)
concepts.scope: Covers the CDM framework allowing a coordinating entity to implement multiple component project activities under a single registered programme.

concepts.name: Designated Operational Entity (DOE)
concepts.scope: Covers the accredited third-party bodies responsible for validation of CDM project design documents and verification of emission reductions.

concepts.name: Certified Emission Reduction (CER)
concepts.scope: Credit unit issued under the CDM representing verified GHG emission reductions from project activities in non-Annex I countries.

concepts.name: Emission Reduction Unit (ERU)
concepts.scope: Credit unit issued under Joint Implementation representing GHG emission reductions transferred between Annex I Parties.

concepts.name: Assigned Amount Unit (AAU)
concepts.scope: Kyoto Protocol unit representing the total permitted emissions of an Annex I Party derived from its base-year emissions and reduction target.

concepts.name: Removal Unit (RMU)
concepts.scope: Kyoto Protocol unit representing net GHG removals by sinks such as afforestation and reforestation activities.

concepts.name: Temporary CER (tCER) and Long-term CER (lCER)
concepts.scope: Special CER types issued specifically from afforestation and reforestation CDM project activities with time-limited validity.

concepts.name: Joint Implementation (JI)
concepts.scope: Kyoto Protocol mechanism enabling credit transfers between Annex I Parties through project-based emission reductions without changing total Annex I caps.

concepts.name: International Emissions Trading (IET)
concepts.scope: Market mechanism permitting Annex I Parties to buy and sell Kyoto Protocol units to achieve compliance cost-effectively without altering aggregate caps.

concepts.name: Additionality
concepts.scope: Requirement that CDM or JI project emission reductions must exceed what would have occurred under a business-as-usual baseline scenario.

concepts.name: Baseline Scenario
concepts.scope: Projected GHG emissions trajectory in the absence of a CDM or JI project activity, used as the reference against which reductions are measured.

concepts.name: Project Design Document (PDD)
concepts.scope: Key CDM document describing a project's technical and organisational aspects including baseline and monitoring methodologies.

concepts.name: CDM Project Cycle
concepts.scope: Sequential regulatory process from project planning through validation, registration, monitoring, verification, certification to CER issuance and distribution.

concepts.name: Designated National Authority (DNA)
concepts.scope: National body that provides host-country approval of voluntary participation and confirms sustainable development contribution for CDM projects.

concepts.name: CDM Executive Board (EB)
concepts.scope: Supervisory body under CMP authority responsible for registering CDM projects, approving methodologies, accrediting operational entities and issuing CERs.

concepts.name: Validation
concepts.scope: Independent pre-registration evaluation of a CDM project against Kyoto Protocol requirements on the basis of the PDD.

concepts.name: Verification and Certification
concepts.scope: Periodic independent review confirming the quantity of monitored GHG reductions achieved, leading to written assurance by a DOE.

concepts.name: Share of Proceeds (SOP)
concepts.scope: Levy on issued CERs covering CDM administrative costs and a 2% adaptation fund contribution for vulnerable developing Parties.

concepts.name: Compliance and Carry-over
concepts.scope: Rules determining consequences of Annex I excess emissions and conditions under which surplus KP units can be banked to subsequent commitment periods.

concepts.name: Emission Cap
concepts.scope: Quantified GHG limit for an Annex I Party calculated as the sum of AAUs, RMUs, ERUs, CERs and IET adjustments over a commitment period.

methods: Analytical integration of lognormal forward price SDE
Trinomial tree construction with equal time and space steps
Forward induction for state price computation
Hull-White path-dependent pricing algorithm with interpolation
Log-linear grid for arithmetic average distribution approximation
Least-squares fitting of exponential volatility to historical futures return standard deviations
Convergence analysis across time steps and stored values
SSNIP test applied to pipeline route substitutability
HHI and RSI calculation for pipeline market concentration
Annualised capital cost comparison for bypass pipeline feasibility
Qualitative assessment of barriers to entry and permitting
Survey review of shipper experience with route switching
Capacity availability assessment (primary and secondary markets)
Profit maximisation analysis under capacity constraints
KP unit accounting and compliance assessment
