Basic fixed-income concepts (discount factors, forward rates)
Industrial organisation and natural monopoly theory
Energy regulation and third-party access frameworks
EU Gas Directive and network code requirements
Discounted cash flow and annualisation of capital costs
Merger control and competition law assessment tools
Environmental economics (carbon markets, Kyoto Protocol framework)
Basic knowledge of EU gas market regulation (Second and Third Gas Directives)
Basic climate policy and UNFCCC framework
Kyoto Protocol structure and commitment periods

dipeng_models.topic: KYOS Analytical Platform — energy analytics software user manual

concepts.name: Price forward curve construction (KyCurve)
concepts.scope: Covers building hourly/daily/monthly commodity forward curves from market price data including peak/offpeak/baseload decomposition.

concepts.name: Gas storage valuation (KyStore)
concepts.scope: Covers intrinsic, rolling intrinsic, and spot-trading valuation of gas storage assets including optimisation and hedge generation.

concepts.name: Swing contract valuation (KySwing)
concepts.scope: Covers valuation of flexible gas offtake contracts with take-or-pay, make-up, and rolling intrinsic strategies.

concepts.name: Power plant valuation (KyPlant)
concepts.scope: Covers stochastic valuation, dispatch optimisation, P&L and hedge outputs for thermal power plants.

concepts.name: Price simulation (KySim)
concepts.scope: Covers Monte Carlo simulation of multi-commodity energy prices using calibrated stochastic models including cointegration and merit-order power.

concepts.name: Statistical calibration (KyCalibration)
concepts.scope: Covers estimation of volatility, mean-reversion and correlation parameters from historical commodity price data.

concepts.name: Risk metrics (KyRisk / KyVaR)
concepts.scope: Covers Earnings-at-Risk, Cash-flow-at-Risk, Volumes-at-Risk, Hedges-at-Risk and Value-at-Risk calculations for energy portfolios.

concepts.name: Power fundamentals modelling (KyPowerFundamentals)
concepts.scope: Covers merit-order-based fundamental electricity price simulation using plant fleet, demand, interconnector and fuel data.

concepts.name: Intrinsic valuation
concepts.scope: Covers the deterministic present-value benchmark derived from current forward prices for storage or flexible contracts.

concepts.name: Rolling intrinsic strategy
concepts.scope: Covers dynamic re-hedging of storage or swing assets as the forward curve evolves over time.

concepts.name: Commodity forward curve bootstrapping
concepts.scope: Covers stripping of quoted monthly, quarterly and calendar forward prices into a consistent daily or hourly price curve.

concepts.name: Bid-ask spread as trading cost
concepts.scope: Covers incorporation of half the bid-ask spread as a per-unit cost when optimising storage and swing dispatch.

concepts.name: Take-or-pay provision
concepts.scope: Covers minimum offtake obligations and make-up rights embedded in gas supply contracts.

concepts.name: Carbon Price Floor (UK CPF/CPS)
concepts.scope: Covers the UK Carbon Price Support mechanism and its effect on CO2 price simulation and power plant hedging.

concepts.name: Settlement price calculation
concepts.scope: Covers computation of reference settlement prices from traded market data for mark-to-market and invoicing.

concepts.name: Hedging strategy and target hedge percentage
concepts.scope: Covers parameterisation of desired hedge ratios by maturity bucket for use in portfolio risk reporting.

concepts.name: Volume actuals and forecasts
concepts.scope: Covers upload and management of time-series consumption and production forecasts linked to delivery points and business units.

concepts.name: KyDispatch
concepts.scope: Covers short-term unit-commitment and economic dispatch optimisation across a fleet of power plants.

concepts.name: Scenario / What-If analysis
concepts.scope: Covers re-running valuation models under alternative price or volume scenarios to assess sensitivity.

concepts.name: Inventory valuation (KyInventory / KyCavern)
concepts.scope: Covers valuation and optimisation of commodity inventory positions including cavern storage with tranche-based volume constraints.

concepts.name: Production, demand and weather time series
concepts.scope: Structured time series inputs covering generation output, consumption load, temperature, costs, heat, traded positions and interconnect capacity used across platform models.

concepts.name: Traded positions time series
concepts.scope: Daily delivery volume profiles derived from a portfolio of traded marker products, requiring user mapping from tradable products to daily positions.

concepts.name: Temperature-gas price correlation
concepts.scope: Statistical relationship between temperature data and gas spot prices used in risk modelling, expected to exhibit negative correlation.

concepts.name: Seasonal forecasting (KyForecast)
concepts.scope: Time series forecasting model for data with evident seasonal patterns, using daily or hourly granularity and requiring at least one full year of historical input.

concepts.name: Price forward curve
concepts.scope: A single price for every delivery period (hourly, daily or monthly) in the future, built from market quotes and shaped into consistent granularity.

concepts.name: Arbitrage-free forward curve construction (KyCurve)
concepts.scope: Model that shapes liquid market forward quotes into internally consistent, gap-free price forward curves across hourly, daily and monthly granularities for power and gas.

concepts.name: Monthly shaping weights
concepts.scope: Relative seasonal price weights per calendar month calibrated from historical forward quotes or supplied by the user, applied within KyCurve.

concepts.name: Day-type shaping
concepts.scope: Assignment of identical or distinct intra-week price profiles to grouped weekday categories, with public holidays treated as Sundays and bridge days as Saturdays.

concepts.name: Balance-of-month (BOM) price
concepts.scope: Forward price for the remaining days of the current delivery month, optionally incorporating prices already settled earlier in that month.

concepts.name: Curve extrapolation
concepts.scope: Extension of a forward curve beyond the last liquid market quote date, with each extrapolated month priced at the same month one year prior plus a fixed percentage.

concepts.name: Curve smoothing
concepts.scope: Technique applied to the short end of a forward curve to ensure smooth price transitions across month boundaries.

concepts.name: Curve shifting
concepts.scope: Manual rescaling of a constructed daily or hourly forward curve so that yearly average prices match user-specified target levels.

concepts.name: Settlement curve
concepts.scope: Historical average price series derived from spot or forward fixings over a defined valuation period, used to price floating-rate commodity contracts.

concepts.name: FX conversion for settlement prices
concepts.scope: Restatement of commodity settlement prices into another currency using either monthly-average or daily FX rates.

concepts.name: Gas storage valuation inputs
concepts.scope: Physical parameters of a gas storage facility including working volume, injection and withdrawal rates, cost components, and volume restrictions used in optimisation models.

concepts.name: Injection and withdrawal rates
concepts.scope: Volume-dependent or time-dependent capacity constraints governing how fast gas can be injected into or withdrawn from a storage facility on a given day.

concepts.name: Take-or-Pay (ToP) clause
concepts.scope: Contractual minimum and maximum volume off-take obligations over specified periods (daily, monthly, quarterly, annual or total) attached to flexible gas supply contracts.

concepts.name: Valuation curve (gas)
concepts.scope: Composite forward curve combining daily granularity for the spot month with monthly granularity thereafter, used for gas storage valuation requiring near-term price detail.

concepts.name: Fixed vs. flexible volume contracts
concepts.scope: Distinction between contracts with a predetermined delivery profile and contracts whose actual volume lies within defined upper and lower bounds.

concepts.name: Price indexation and fixings
concepts.scope: Contract pricing mechanisms linking delivery prices to spot, forward or oil indices, with optional partial conversion to fixed prices through price-click transactions.

concepts.name: Power plant efficiency curve
concepts.scope: Relationship between plant output level and fuel-to-power conversion efficiency, parameterised at minimum, mid and maximum capacity set-points with optional seasonal corrections.

concepts.name: Start-up and shut-down curves
concepts.scope: Time-stamped fuel consumption and power output profiles for each plant start type (hot to cold) and shutdown, including fixed costs and equivalent operating hours.

concepts.name: Nominated volumes
concepts.scope: Daily or monthly delivery quantities formally declared under a flexible contract, converting it operationally into a fixed-volume obligation for reporting and dispatch purposes.

concepts.name: Mark-to-Market (MtM) valuation
concepts.scope: Revaluation of fixed-price commodity contracts against the current market forward curve to determine unrealised gains or losses.

concepts.name: Capacity factor adjustment
concepts.scope: Year-specific scaling applied to historical and forecast production or demand time series to reflect known changes in installed or utilised capacity.

concepts.name: Forced outage modelling
concepts.scope: Distinguishes scheduled and unscheduled plant outages by yearly percentage, mean time to repair, and equivalent operating hours attribution.

concepts.name: Equivalent Operating Hours (EOH)
concepts.scope: Cumulative measure of thermal stress on a power plant used to trigger maintenance scheduling and quantify trip impact.

concepts.name: Dynamic maintenance scheduling
concepts.scope: EOH-based approach that allows maintenance timing to shift between high-margin and low-margin periods rather than following a fixed calendar.

concepts.name: CHP heat dispatch modes
concepts.scope: Covers heat-led versus least-cost joint dispatch of boiler and power plant, subject to PQ diagram and heat transport limits.

concepts.name: Ramp rate constraints
concepts.scope: Speed limits for ramping generation between minimum stable generation and maximum capacity applied as a post-process in valuation.

concepts.name: Minimum on-time and off-time
concepts.scope: Operational constraints specifying the shortest permissible production run and inter-start interval for a thermal unit.

concepts.name: Seasonal efficiency and output corrections
concepts.scope: Monthly multiplicative adjustments to efficiency curve and capacity bounds to capture ambient-temperature effects.

concepts.name: Gas storage tranche structure
concepts.scope: Defines PAD, Back-Up and As-Available capacity layers with time-varying minimum and maximum volume bounds for inventory optimisation.

concepts.name: Intrinsic storage value
concepts.scope: Maximum value lockable from a single forward curve via mixed-integer linear programming, computed at daily, monthly or tradable contract granularity.

concepts.name: Full option (spot) value
concepts.scope: Monte Carlo-based storage value from optimal spot-market dispatch determined by Least Squares Monte Carlo, reflecting extrinsic optionality.

concepts.name: Least Squares Monte Carlo (LSMC)
concepts.scope: Regression-based dynamic programming technique used to approximate the optimal continuation value across simulated price paths.

concepts.name: Three-factor gas price model
concepts.scope: Mean-reverting simulation model decomposing gas price dynamics into long-term, short-term and seasonal factors with cointegration support.

concepts.name: Spot mean-reversion rate
concepts.scope: Parameter controlling the speed at which simulated spot prices revert to the forward price level, typically 5–30 percent per day for natural gas.

concepts.name: Geometric Brownian Motion (GBM) for forward prices
concepts.scope: Single-factor lognormal process used to simulate forward commodity and FX prices within the KyStore/KySwing simulation engine.

concepts.name: Volatility term structure
concepts.scope: Differentiated spot, long-term and seasonal volatility inputs that can be supplemented with monthly weights to rescale spot volatility by delivery period.

concepts.name: EWMA volatility estimation
concepts.scope: Exponentially Weighted Moving Average method that down-weights older returns via a decay factor to produce more responsive parameter estimates.

concepts.name: Cointegration between commodities
concepts.scope: Long-run equilibrium relationship estimated between gas and other commodities constraining their joint simulation to avoid persistent divergence.

concepts.name: Volume-based delta hedge
concepts.scope: Forward hedge sized by averaging simulated injection/withdrawal volumes across spot strategy paths for each delivery period.

concepts.name: Value-based (actual) delta hedge
concepts.scope: Forward hedge sized by weighting simulated volumes by realised spot prices, providing theoretically superior value stabilisation.

concepts.name: Static versus dynamic delta hedging
concepts.scope: Distinguishes a one-time hedge placed at valuation date from a periodically re-adjusted hedge that incurs incremental bid-ask costs.

concepts.name: Discount rate (continuous)
concepts.scope: Continuously compounded rate applied via the exponential function to discount future storage cash-flows to the valuation date.

concepts.name: Forward curve granularity (daily/monthly/mixed)
concepts.scope: Choice of price curve resolution sent to the optimisation engine, affecting whether sub-monthly spreads can be exploited intrinsically.

concepts.name: Swing option constraints
concepts.scope: Volume restrictions, indexed strike prices, carry-forward and make-up provisions, and penalty terms that characterise long-term gas supply contracts.

concepts.name: Gamma sensitivity
concepts.scope: Second-order measure of how delta changes with the gas price, optionally computed and saved to assess convexity of storage value.

concepts.name: Backtest of storage strategy
concepts.scope: Ex-post comparison of projected versus realised storage values by replaying historical spot and forward prices through each trading strategy.

concepts.name: Random seed control
concepts.scope: User-settable initialisation of the Monte Carlo random number generator enabling reproducibility and consistent cross-profile comparison.

concepts.name: Mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) for storage
concepts.scope: Exact optimisation technique used for intrinsic valuation when storage injection/withdrawal rates are not inventory-dependent.

concepts.name: Swing contract
concepts.scope: A physical gas supply contract granting flexible daily/periodic offtake volumes subject to minimum and maximum quantity constraints.

concepts.name: Take-or-pay constraint
concepts.scope: A contractual obligation requiring the buyer to pay for a minimum volume of gas whether or not it is physically taken.

concepts.name: Period quantity constraint (PCQ)
concepts.scope: Volume bounds applied over a defined sub-period (daily, monthly, quarterly, annual) within a swing contract.

concepts.name: Make-up clause
concepts.scope: A contractual right allowing under-lifted volumes in one period to be compensated by additional offtake in a subsequent period.

concepts.name: Intrinsic value
concepts.scope: The value of a swing contract optimised against a single deterministic forward curve without any stochastic component.

concepts.name: Spot trading strategy
concepts.scope: An optimal dispatch policy that exploits spot price realisations relative to the strike price on each delivery day.

concepts.name: Perfect foresight value
concepts.scope: An upper-bound valuation obtained by optimising offtake decisions with full knowledge of future spot price paths.

concepts.name: Mean reversion rate
concepts.scope: A parameter controlling the speed at which the simulated spot price reverts toward the current forward price level each day.

concepts.name: Monthly spot volatility weights
concepts.scope: User-defined multiplicative scalars that redistribute a single annual spot volatility parameter across calendar months.

concepts.name: Delta hedge
concepts.scope: A forward position in gas products sized to neutralise the price sensitivity of the swing contract's mark-to-market value.

concepts.name: One-factor commodity model
concepts.scope: A simplified stochastic model for non-primary commodities that shifts the entire forward curve up or down with no mean reversion.

concepts.name: Cointegration
concepts.scope: A long-run equilibrium relationship between commodity prices that constrains their joint long-term dynamics in simulation.

concepts.name: Forward curve granularity
concepts.scope: The temporal resolution (daily, monthly, or mixed) of the gas price forward curve used as input to the valuation model.

concepts.name: Continuous discount rate
concepts.scope: An exponential discounting convention applied to future cash flows to express them in present-value terms.

concepts.name: FX averaging convention
concepts.scope: The rule governing how exchange rates are applied when converting strike prices between the gas market currency and the domestic currency.

concepts.name: Bid-ask spread
concepts.scope: The transaction cost embedded in the difference between buy and sell prices of hedging products, reducing realised trading profits.

concepts.name: Minimum re-hedge profit
concepts.scope: A threshold net margin per MWh below which a re-hedging trade is suppressed to avoid unprofitable rebalancing after transaction costs.

concepts.name: Backtest
concepts.scope: A historical simulation of the swing contract valuation and hedging strategy applied over a past delivery period using realised market data.

concepts.name: Random seed
concepts.scope: An initialisation value for the Monte Carlo random number generator enabling reproducible or independently randomised simulation runs.

concepts.name: Delivery point
concepts.scope: A designated location in the gas network at which physical offtake volumes under a contract are measured and allocated.

concepts.name: Strike formula
concepts.scope: The contractual pricing formula determining the price at which gas is purchased under the swing contract on each delivery day.

methods: Dynamic programming / optimisation for storage and swing dispatch
Statistical calibration of volatility and correlation
Seasonal time series forecasting (trigonometric / sine function decomposition)
Monthly and intra-day weighting and interpolation
Linear interpolation of volume restrictions and injection/withdrawal rates
Spot-price capping and outlier treatment in regression
Optimal dispatch scheduling with ramp and start/stop constraints
Automated FTP-based data ingestion and processing
Additive and multiplicative strike formula calibration to zero intrinsic value
implied_prerequisites: Forward curve concepts and market quoting conventions
Contract pricing: fixed, indexed and floating
Power plant thermodynamics and dispatch economics
Natural gas market structure and contracts

dipeng_nl_css.topic: Dutch Clean Spark Spread (CSS) Daily Options

concepts.name: Clean Spark Spread (CSS)
concepts.scope: The margin from converting gas to power net of carbon cost, used as the underlying for the option structure.

concepts.name: Daily Call Option on CSS
concepts.scope: A strip of European-style daily exercisable options giving the holder the right to receive physical power delivery against a floating price each calendar day.

concepts.name: Floating Price Formula
concepts.scope: The settlement price for each delivery day constructed from TTF gas price, EUA carbon price, and a fixed efficiency coefficient, plus a strike.

concepts.name: TTF Day-Ahead Index
concepts.scope: The Heren-published day-ahead Dutch gas price used as the gas cost input in the CSS floating price calculation.

concepts.name: EUA Carbon Cost
concepts.scope: The ICE ECX front December EUA futures settlement price applied per tonne of CO2, scaled by a carbon intensity factor, to compute the clean component of the spread.

concepts.name: Gas Efficiency Factor
concepts.scope: The thermal conversion ratio (MWh gas per MWh power, e.g. 2 MWhg/MWhe = 50%) linking gas consumption to power output in the spread formula.

concepts.name: Strike Price
concepts.scope: The fixed floor level (here 0 EUR/MWh) subtracted from the floating price to determine option intrinsic value on each exercise day.

concepts.name: D-1 Exercise
concepts.scope: The option exercise mechanism whereby the holder must notify the writer by a specified deadline on the business day before each delivery day.

concepts.name: Physical Settlement
concepts.scope: The delivery obligation under which the writer supplies baseload or peak power on the Dutch HV grid on exercised days, with corresponding gas flow from holder to writer.

concepts.name: Quarter-Ahead vs Day-Ahead Reference Price
concepts.scope: The distinction between forward quarterly indices (used to set price floors) and day-ahead spot indices (used for daily settlement), relevant to index selection for NAM calculations.

concepts.name: Peak vs Baseload Delivery Profile
concepts.scope: The distinction between full 24-hour baseload delivery and restricted peak-hour delivery (e.g. Monday–Friday 08:00–20:00 CET) in the physical power leg.

concepts.name: Non-exercise Default
concepts.scope: The contractual provision that if the holder fails to nominate, the volume for that delivery day is assumed zero and no physical delivery occurs.

methods: Floating price construction from component indices
Index benchmarking against actual traded data (Trayport)
implied_prerequisites: European energy commodity markets (power and gas)
Options pricing basics (call options, strike, premium)
Energy market index conventions (Heren, ICE ECX)

dipeng_options_system.topic: Power Options Pricing and Management Systems

concepts.name: Power Options Pricing
concepts.scope: Valuation of optionality embedded in electricity contracts using model-driven pricing frameworks.

concepts.name: Power Curve Modelling
concepts.scope: Construction and calibration of forward power price curves for use in derivatives pricing.

concepts.name: Storage Valuation
concepts.scope: Modelling and optimisation of energy storage assets to extract value from price spreads over time.

concepts.name: Intrinsic and Extrinsic Value
concepts.scope: Decomposition of an energy option's total value into its deterministic intrinsic component and stochastic extrinsic component.

concepts.name: Options Portfolio Management
concepts.scope: Tracking, aggregation and risk management of a book of power options positions.

concepts.name: Greeks and Sensitivities
concepts.scope: Calculation of first- and higher-order price sensitivities for power option positions to support hedging.

concepts.name: Spark Spread and Dark Spread Options
concepts.scope: Spread option structures linking power prices to fuel input costs for generation assets.

concepts.name: Virtual Power Plant (VPP) Options
concepts.scope: Structured option products that replicate the output optionality of a physical generation asset.

concepts.name: Monte Carlo Simulation for Energy Derivatives
concepts.scope: Stochastic simulation of price paths used to price path-dependent and multi-asset power options.

concepts.name: Rolling Hedge and Delta Hedging
concepts.scope: Dynamic replication strategies applied to power options books using forward contract adjustments.

implied_prerequisites: Forward and futures markets in electricity

dipeng_power.topic: European power plant tolling, CCGT valuation, and energy market fundamentals

concepts.name: Delta Hedging for Power Tolling
concepts.scope: Dynamic replication of a CCGT tolling option by trading daily Greeks derived from a tolling model against forward prices.

concepts.name: Back-Testing Methodology
concepts.scope: Framework for evaluating a service provider's hedging performance by replaying historical forward prices through a tolling model.

concepts.name: Tolling Model
concepts.scope: Valuation model that converts commodity forward curves and plant parameters into Greeks and intrinsic value for a CCGT.

concepts.name: Daily Greeks
concepts.scope: Sensitivities of CCGT option value to power, gas and carbon prices computed daily for each tradable tenor.

concepts.name: Clean Dark Spread (CDS)
concepts.scope: Margin of a coal-fired plant after deducting fuel and carbon costs from electricity revenue.

concepts.name: Clean Spark Spread (CSS)
concepts.scope: Margin of a gas-fired plant after deducting gas fuel and carbon costs from electricity revenue.

concepts.name: CCGT Plant Parameters
concepts.scope: Technical inputs—efficiency, availability, variable O&M, start-up costs—used to define the economic boundaries of a gas turbine tolling option.

concepts.name: Intra-Month Volatility
concepts.scope: Short-dated implied volatility calibrated to value within-month optionality on power and gas prices.

concepts.name: Correlation (Power–Gas)
concepts.scope: Statistical dependency between power and gas prices used as an input to spread option pricing.

concepts.name: Merit Order
concepts.scope: Stack ranking of generation technologies by short-run marginal cost determining dispatch sequence and market clearing price.

concepts.name: Capacity Market Mechanism
concepts.scope: Regulatory framework that remunerates generation capacity availability to ensure security of supply and incentivise new build.

concepts.name: Missing Money Problem
concepts.scope: Shortfall between a plant's energy margin and ancillary revenues relative to its fixed and capital costs, which capacity payments are designed to bridge.

concepts.name: EU Emissions Trading Scheme (EU ETS)
concepts.scope: Cap-and-trade carbon market whose price (EUA) feeds into generation marginal costs and clean spread valuations.

concepts.name: Market Stability Reserve (MSR)
concepts.scope: EU policy mechanism designed to withdraw surplus allowances from the ETS to support the carbon price.

concepts.name: Ancillary Services
concepts.scope: Grid-stability services (primary, secondary, tertiary reserve) procured by RTE for which flexible generators receive additional revenues.

concepts.name: Extrinsic Value of a Tolling Option
concepts.scope: Time value component of a CCGT spread option arising from commodity price volatility beyond the intrinsic spark spread.

concepts.name: Forward Curve Construction
concepts.scope: Assembly of daily forward price curves for power, gas and carbon across multiple tenors for use in hedging and valuation.

concepts.name: Liquidity Adjustment
concepts.scope: Correction applied to theoretical hedge prices to account for bid-offer spreads and limited tradable volume in forward markets.

concepts.name: De-rated Capacity
concepts.scope: Effective generation capacity after applying availability and de-rating factors, used to assess reserve margin adequacy.

concepts.name: Contract for Difference (CfD) for New Build
concepts.scope: Seven-year capacity contract structure in the French market that guarantees a reference capacity price for new-entrant generators.

concepts.name: EBITDA and Cash Flow Projection
concepts.scope: Financial forecasting of plant earnings and cash flows incorporating energy margin, capacity payments and O&M costs.

concepts.name: Thermal Sensitivity of Demand
concepts.scope: Responsiveness of electricity consumption to temperature, particularly acute in France due to widespread electric heating.

concepts.name: Baseload power price projection
concepts.scope: Forward-looking wholesale electricity price forecast driven by fuel costs, carbon prices, capacity mix, and merit-order dynamics.

concepts.name: Capacity market (CM) payment
concepts.scope: A €/kW revenue stream paid to generators for certified available capacity to meet security-of-supply obligations.

concepts.name: Nuclear decommissioning impact
concepts.scope: The effect of progressive retirement of nuclear capacity on merit-order positioning and wholesale price uplift for thermal plants.

concepts.name: Renewable intermittency and backup requirement
concepts.scope: The need for flexible dispatchable capacity to complement variable wind and solar generation and maintain system reliability.

concepts.name: EU ETS carbon price
concepts.scope: The price of EU Allowances under the cap-and-trade scheme that adds a carbon cost to fossil-fuel generation and influences merit order.

concepts.name: Merit order dispatch
concepts.scope: The economic ranking of generating units by marginal cost that determines which plants are called on to produce at any given demand level.

concepts.name: IEA WEO scenarios
concepts.scope: Three long-run commodity and energy-policy pathways (New Policies, Current Policies, 450) used as anchors for gas, coal, and carbon price projections.

concepts.name: Capacity factor / load factor
concepts.scope: The ratio of actual energy output to maximum possible output, used to measure plant utilisation.

concepts.name: Equivalent Operating Hours (EOH)
concepts.scope: A wear-normalised measure of turbine running time that determines maintenance inspection intervals and contract milestones.

concepts.name: Long-Term Service Agreement (LTSA)
concepts.scope: A reduced-scope maintenance contract option that replaces the full O&M agreement after a major inspection milestone, lowering fixed fees.

concepts.name: Ancillary services revenue
concepts.scope: Income earned by providing frequency response and voltage regulation to the transmission system operator.

concepts.name: Achieved power price
concepts.scope: The blended electricity price actually realised by a plant after hedging, optimisation, and market access decisions.

concepts.name: Gross margin
concepts.scope: Plant-level revenue minus variable fuel, carbon, and variable tax costs, representing the contribution before fixed costs.

concepts.name: EBITDA
concepts.scope: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortisation, used as a cash-flow proxy for plant-level financial performance.

concepts.name: French Capacity Market (mécanisme de capacité)
concepts.scope: A certificate-based system obliging electricity suppliers to hold certified capacity proportional to their customers' peak consumption.

concepts.name: Peak demand thermal sensitivity
concepts.scope: The amplification of electricity demand during cold weather driven by France's large stock of electric heating, creating extreme peak-to-baseload ratios.

concepts.name: Nuclear unplanned outages
concepts.scope: Sudden loss of nuclear generation due to safety inspections or component failures that tightens supply and sharply raises spot prices.

concepts.name: Infra-marginal rent
concepts.scope: The surplus earned by low-marginal-cost generators when the market-clearing price is set by higher-cost marginal plant.

concepts.name: Decennial Visit (VD4)
concepts.scope: The fourth ten-yearly safety inspection for French nuclear reactors, used here as the regulatory threshold determining plant life extension or closure.

concepts.name: PPE (Programmation Pluriannuelle de l'Énergie)
concepts.scope: France's multi-year energy programme setting renewable and nuclear capacity targets used as the basis for installed-capacity scenario modelling.

concepts.name: Heat Recovery Steam Generator (HRSG)
concepts.scope: A boiler that recovers exhaust heat from the gas turbine to produce steam driving the steam turbine in a combined-cycle configuration.

concepts.name: Distributed Control System (DCS)
concepts.scope: The plant automation and monitoring platform that centralises real-time operational control and historical data logging.

concepts.name: Extrinsic (optionality) value of a power plant
concepts.scope: The additional value a CCGT captures by exercising its hourly run/no-run option only when the spark spread is positive, asymmetrically benefiting from favourable price scenarios.

concepts.name: Tolling agreement
concepts.scope: A contractual arrangement under which a toller pays a fixed fee to a plant owner in exchange for the right to control plant dispatch and receive the electricity output against supplying fuel.

concepts.name: Capacity market / capacity certificates
concepts.scope: A remuneration mechanism obligating certified capacity providers to deliver energy when called, generating a steady revenue stream from periodic capacity auctions.

concepts.name: Hot Gas Path Inspection (HGPI) / Major inspection cycle
concepts.scope: Scheduled maintenance events triggered at defined EOH thresholds requiring plant shutdown and causing planned outage periods that affect availability and capital expenditure.

concepts.name: Long Term Service Agreement (LTSA) vs. full O&M contract
concepts.scope: Alternative maintenance contracting structures with different scope-of-work coverage and fixed cost profiles, with LTSA potentially offering lower fixed costs after a major inspection trigger.

concepts.name: Plant heat rate and degradation
concepts.scope: The thermal efficiency of a CCGT expressed in HHV terms, which declines with cumulative operating hours and resets partially after major inspections, affecting fuel cost calculations.

concepts.name: Virtual Power Plant (VPP) / daily call option structure
concepts.scope: A financial derivative giving the holder the right to nominate physical output from a specific plant each day against a strike price indexed to gas and carbon costs.

concepts.name: Frequency containment reserve / automatic frequency restoration reserve
concepts.scope: System services in which generators provide rapid active power response to contain or restore grid frequency, remunerated separately from energy sales.

concepts.name: PEG Nord day-ahead gas price
concepts.scope: The French natural gas hub reference price used to mark gas fuel costs in spark spread calculations and tolling fee strike price formulas.

concepts.name: EUA (EU Allowance) carbon price
concepts.scope: The price of EU Emissions Trading Scheme Phase 3 daily futures, used to calculate the carbon cost component of the clean spark spread and plant variable costs.

concepts.name: Achieved electricity price
concepts.scope: The blended power price a merchant CCGT realises, incorporating both intrinsic day-ahead market value and extrinsic optionality value from selective dispatch.

concepts.name: Unlevered free cash flow (UFCF)
concepts.scope: Pre-tax operating cash flow after capex and working capital movements, used as the primary cash flow metric for enterprise valuation of the generating assets.

concepts.name: EBITDA margin for merchant generation
concepts.scope: EBITDA as a proportion of revenues, summarising the profitability left after fuel, carbon, variable O&M, fixed costs, and HQ expenses.

concepts.name: Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) / Days Payables Outstanding (DPO)
concepts.scope: Working capital efficiency metrics measuring average collection and payment periods, used to model intra-year cash flow timing for the generating assets.

concepts.name: Load factor
concepts.scope: The ratio of actual net energy output to maximum possible output over a period, reflecting dispatch intensity driven by spark spread economics and plant availability.

concepts.name: Forced outage rate
concepts.scope: The probability that a generating unit is unexpectedly unavailable, used to adjust availability assumptions and capacity credit calculations.

concepts.name: Energy Manager role in tolling
concepts.scope: The party responsible for plant programming, balancing, gas shipping, ancillary service participation, and capacity certificate sales on behalf of the plant owner and co-tollers.

concepts.name: Capacity premium mechanism
concepts.scope: A regulated payment per MW of available capacity, funded via CSPE and contracted through EDF, designed to remunerate firm generation adequacy in the absence of a fully operational capacity market.

concepts.name: Pacte Electrique Breton (PEB)
concepts.scope: A regional energy agreement structuring demand-side management, renewable development, and supply security obligations specific to the Brittany electrical peninsula.

concepts.name: Competitive tender for new generation capacity
concepts.scope: A state-organised procurement process by CRE to award a long-term capacity contract to a new CCGT plant meeting technical, environmental, and economic criteria.

concepts.name: EPC contract
concepts.scope: A fixed-price engineering, procurement, and construction contract allocating construction cost and schedule risk to the contractor (Siemens).

concepts.name: Project finance debt-to-equity structure
concepts.scope: A 70:30 leveraged financing structure for a special-purpose vehicle, where senior lenders hold loan agreements secured against project cash flows and contracts.

concepts.name: DSRA (Debt Service Reserve Account)
concepts.scope: A liquidity reserve funded at financial close to cover a defined number of debt service periods in the event of cash flow shortfall.

concepts.name: EBITDA margin for a merchant/capacity plant
concepts.scope: The ratio of EBITDA to total revenues used to assess operating profitability of a power plant across its contracted and merchant revenue streams over time.

concepts.name: State aid compatibility — Altmark criteria and SGEI
concepts.scope: The EU legal framework assessing whether a capacity premium paid to a new generator constitutes permissible state aid under the Altmark case law or Service of General Economic Interest classification.

concepts.name: CSPE (Contribution to Public Service of Electricity)
concepts.scope: A French levy on electricity consumers used to fund public service obligations including capacity premiums paid to contracted generators.

concepts.name: Interconnector import constraint
concepts.scope: A scenario assumption that cross-border electricity imports are unavailable during winter months, used to stress-test seasonal price formation in a power dispatch model.

concepts.name: CCGT dispatch efficiency
concepts.scope: The thermal conversion efficiency (LHV basis) of a combined-cycle gas turbine that determines its position in the merit order relative to competing generation technologies.

concepts.name: Merit order stack modelling
concepts.scope: A bottom-up representation of generation capacity ranked by short-run marginal cost used to determine the market-clearing power price at each hour.

concepts.name: Nuclear lifespan assumption
concepts.scope: A scenario parameter governing the retirement schedule of existing nuclear capacity, which substantially affects power price trajectories and the need for new firm capacity.

concepts.name: Day-ahead power price forecasting
concepts.scope: The modelling of hourly clearing prices in the day-ahead electricity auction using fundamental supply-demand inputs validated against historical outturn prices.

concepts.name: Imbalance cost calculation
concepts.scope: The quantification of settlement charges arising from deviations between contracted and metered positions in short-term balancing markets.

concepts.name: Clean spark spread
concepts.scope: The margin of a gas-fired generator calculated as the power price minus gas cost and CO2 cost, used to assess plant profitability and hedging strategy.

concepts.name: Forward curve management
concepts.scope: The active rolling of hedges along the forward curve for power and gas positions, tracking mark-to-market value and Greeks across tenors.

concepts.name: Locational spread option
concepts.scope: An option on the price differential between two delivery locations or bidding zones, valued using spread option methodology.

concepts.name: O&M and LTSA contracts
concepts.scope: Long-term service and operations-and-maintenance agreements that fix or cap operating expenditure, reducing cost uncertainty for project lenders.

methods: Scenario analysis (IEA WEO New Policies / Current Policies / 450)
Forward curve and analyst consensus for near-term commodity prices
Plant-level financial projection (revenue, gross margin, EBITDA)
Discounted cash flow (DCF) / pre-tax UFCF valuation
Gross margin and EBITDA waterfall construction
Tolling fee structuring and strike price indexation
Sensitivity analysis on availability and load factor
Scenario analysis (ENTSO-E Constrained Progress vs National Green Transition)
Historical price validation with correlation coefficient benchmarking
Discounted cash flow / project finance modelling
Debt sizing and debt service reserve account calculation
Forward curve construction and term management
Sensitivity analysis on nuclear retirement and import constraints
implied_prerequisites: Gas market hubs and pricing (TTF, PEG Nord, Zeebrugge)
Thermal generation economics and cost components
Carbon markets and EU ETS mechanics
Energy policy and regulatory frameworks (French and EU)
Security of supply and capacity adequacy concepts
Power market fundamentals (energy-only vs. capacity markets)
CCGT plant thermodynamics and operational constraints
Derivative pricing basics (call options, strike prices)
Corporate financial modelling (P&L, cash flow, working capital)
French electricity market structure (EPEX, RTE, GRTgaz)
M&A transaction process and due diligence
Electricity market structure and price formation
EU energy regulation and state aid law
Merit order and short-run marginal cost concepts

dipeng_power_deal_structuring.topic: GB Electricity Balancing Mechanism and Cash-Out Reform

concepts.name: Balancing Mechanism
concepts.scope: The real-time market layer where participants submit bids and offers to decrement or increment output, with National Grid as sole counterparty, covering approximately 2% of volume.

concepts.name: Gate Closure
concepts.scope: The point one hour before a settlement period at which participants must submit their final contracted positions before balancing actions are taken.

concepts.name: Dual Cash-Out Pricing
concepts.scope: The existing imbalance settlement mechanism that applies a more favourable price to parties that aid system balance and a harsher marginal price to parties that worsen it.

concepts.name: Single Cash-Out Pricing
concepts.scope: A proposed reform that removes the price spread between opposing imbalance directions, applying one price regardless of whether the party aids or worsens balance.

concepts.name: Price Average Reference (PAR)
concepts.scope: The volume of the most expensive balancing actions over which a weighted average price is calculated for imbalance settlement, subject to phased reduction toward marginal pricing.

concepts.name: Marginal Pricing
concepts.scope: The pricing approach achieved as PAR is reduced to 1 MWh, causing the cash-out price to reflect the single most expensive balancing action dispatched.

concepts.name: Reserve Scarcity Pricing (RSP)
concepts.scope: A scarcity-based pricing function that determines the cost of reserve actions in cash-out based on the level of capacity available on the system at gate closure.

concepts.name: Value of Lost Load (VoLL)
concepts.scope: An administratively set price used to value demand control actions in the balancing stack, escalating from £3,000/MWh to £6,000/MWh across the reform timeline.

concepts.name: Demand Control Pricing
concepts.scope: The mechanism that prices involuntary demand curtailment actions into cash-out at VoLL, creating a scarcity signal during tight system margins.

concepts.name: Imbalance Volume
concepts.scope: The difference between a participant's contracted position and their metered output or import, settled financially in half-hourly periods.

concepts.name: Half-Hourly Settlement
concepts.scope: The settlement framework in which each 30-minute period is separately metered and financially settled, proposed for mandatory extension to profile classes 5–8.

concepts.name: Profile Classes
concepts.scope: Demand customer categories (1–8) that determine metering and settlement methodology, with classes 5–8 covering non-domestic customers below 100 kW.

concepts.name: Smart Meter Roll-Out
concepts.scope: The programme to install half-hourly-capable meters across domestic and small-business consumers between 2015 and 2020, enabling time-of-use settlement.

concepts.name: EBSCR (Electricity Balancing Significant Code Review)
concepts.scope: Ofgem's coordinated review and reform package covering marginal pricing, single cash-out, reserve scarcity pricing and demand control pricing with phased implementation timescales.

methods: Merit-order stacking of balancing actions by price
Weighted average price calculation over PAR volume
Scarcity pricing function (RSP) based on system margin at gate closure
Administrative VoLL setting for demand control
Phased regulatory implementation via Code Modifications
implied_prerequisites: Basic electricity market structure (forwards, spot, balancing)
Concepts of system operator roles and responsibilities
UK energy regulation and Ofgem's mandate

dipeng_purple.topic: Power portfolio acquisition due diligence and credit valuation

concepts.name: Portfolio detail line-by-line trade capture
concepts.scope: Enumerates individual trades within an acquired book to establish a verified position inventory.

concepts.name: Credit charge
concepts.scope: Quantifies the cost of counterparty credit risk embedded in open bilateral energy trades.

concepts.name: Portfolio economics
concepts.scope: Aggregates mark-to-market values, margin requirements and net present value across a transferred trade book.

concepts.name: Masterfile reconciliation
concepts.scope: Cross-references trade-level data against a master position record to detect discrepancies or missing legs.

concepts.name: Flat trades
concepts.scope: Identifies offsetting or zero-net-exposure positions that can be novated or cancelled at minimal cost.

concepts.name: Book summary valuation
concepts.scope: Condenses portfolio-level P&L, credit, and risk metrics into an executive-facing snapshot for deal assessment.

concepts.name: Novation and trade transfer
concepts.scope: Covers the legal and operational process of transferring contractual obligations from seller to buyer in an energy book acquisition.

concepts.name: Credit-adjusted NPV
concepts.scope: Adjusts the risk-free net present value of a trade book for expected counterparty default losses.

dipeng_rocs.topic: Renewable Obligation Certificates (ROCs) and Feed-in Tariffs (FiTs) – scheme mechanics, valuation and credit risk

concepts.name: Renewables Obligation Certificate (ROC)
concepts.scope: A tradeable certificate issued per MWh of qualifying renewable generation, used by suppliers to demonstrate compliance with the Renewables Obligation.

concepts.name: Feed-in Tariff (FiT)
concepts.scope: A government-guaranteed per-kWh payment to small-scale renewable generators, fixed for 20 years and RPI-linked.

concepts.name: ROC banding
concepts.scope: Technology- and configuration-specific multipliers that determine how many ROCs are issued per MWh of generation.

concepts.name: Buy-out price
concepts.scope: The RPI-indexed fixed price per ROC that suppliers pay Ofgem when they cannot present sufficient ROCs to meet their Renewables Obligation.

concepts.name: Recycle payment
concepts.scope: A redistribution of buy-out fund proceeds back to generators who presented ROCs, calculated annually in proportion to ROCs presented.

concepts.name: ROC auction price
concepts.scope: The market-clearing price at which ROCs are sold via auction, subject to fees and demand dynamics.

concepts.name: ROC forward curve
concepts.scope: A term structure of expected future ROC prices used for deal valuation and risk quantification.

concepts.name: Power Purchase Agreement (PPA)
concepts.scope: A bilateral contract between a renewable generator and a supplier specifying the terms for purchasing ROCs and associated electricity.

concepts.name: Export tariff
concepts.scope: An RPI-linked guaranteed rate paid to FiT-accredited generators for electricity exported to the grid.

concepts.name: Return on Average Capital Employed (RoACE)
concepts.scope: An annualised profitability metric applied to trading working capital to assess deal economics on a normalised basis.

concepts.name: Potential Future Exposure (PFE)
concepts.scope: A credit-risk measure estimating the maximum likely counterparty exposure over the life of a trade at a given confidence level.

concepts.name: Ofgem accreditation
concepts.scope: The regulatory approval process by which a generator qualifies to receive ROCs or FiTs under the relevant government scheme.

methods: ROC revenue calculation (banding × MWh × auction/buy-out price)
PFE estimation for ROC purchase deals
FiT tiered-rate lookup and annual earnings projection
ROI and payback-period estimation for renewable installations
implied_prerequisites: Time value of money and RPI indexation

dipeng_risk_documents.topic: Project and Deal Return Metrics for Energy Investments

concepts.name: IRR Ungeared
concepts.scope: Unlevered internal rate of return equating after-tax project cash flows to zero NPV, excluding financing costs.

concepts.name: IRR Geared
concepts.scope: Levered internal rate of return comparing Shell net equity investment to after-tax cash flows inclusive of financing costs.

concepts.name: RTEP Ungeared
concepts.scope: Real-terms equivalent of the unlevered IRR computed on inflation-adjusted cash flows rather than money-of-the-day flows.

concepts.name: RTEP Geared
concepts.scope: Real-terms equivalent of the levered IRR, comparing Shell equity investment to real after-tax cash flows including financing.

concepts.name: NPV 7% Real Terms
concepts.scope: Net present value of after-tax real cash flows discounted at the Shell global cost-of-capital premise of 7%.

concepts.name: NPV (LIBOR)
concepts.scope: Mark-to-market deal value computed as pre-tax gross margin in money-of-the-day discounted at the forward LIBOR rate.

concepts.name: Value Investment Ratio (VIR)
concepts.scope: Ratio of levered after-tax NPV7%RT to the present value of all fixed commitments and obligations at 7% real terms.

concepts.name: Value at Risk (VaR)
concepts.scope: Difference between mean NPV(LIBOR) and the 99th-percentile worst-case transaction value over a one-year holding period.

concepts.name: Return on Value at Risk (RoVaR)
concepts.scope: Ratio of transaction NPV(LIBOR) to transaction Value at Risk at a 99% confidence interval and one-year holding period.

concepts.name: Return on Average Capital Employed (ROACE)
concepts.scope: Ratio of annual average undiscounted NIAT to average capital employed including investments and cash working capital on a money-of-the-day basis.

concepts.name: Average Capital Employed (ACE)
concepts.scope: Denominator of ROACE comprising all outstanding investments net of recapture plus cash working capital including margin postings.

concepts.name: Real vs Nominal Cash Flows
concepts.scope: Distinction between money-of-the-day and inflation-adjusted cash flows used to reconcile nominal and real return metrics.

concepts.name: Group Inflation Premise
concepts.scope: Shell's country-specific inflation assumption used to convert nominal cash flows to real terms for RTEP calculations.

concepts.name: Hurdle Rate
concepts.scope: Minimum acceptable return threshold applied to IRR and RTEP metrics relative to borrowing costs or a corporate benchmark.

implied_prerequisites: Inflation and real vs nominal interest rate relationships
Working capital and capital employed accounting

dipeng_rules.topic: ICE OTC Natural Gas Markets: Structure, Products and Trading

concepts.name: OTC vs Exchange-Traded Futures
concepts.scope: Distinguishes standardised futures from customisable OTC contracts across size, grade, location and settlement.

concepts.name: Central Clearing
concepts.scope: Covers the role of a clearing house in eliminating bilateral counterparty credit risk in OTC markets.

concepts.name: Henry Hub
concepts.scope: Describes the physical and contractual primacy of Henry Hub as the benchmark US natural gas trading and delivery point.

concepts.name: Natural Gas Forward Curve
concepts.scope: Covers the seasonal shape of natural gas futures prices and non-parallel shifts across the curve.

concepts.name: Natural Gas Strips
concepts.scope: Defines calendar, winter and summer strips of consecutive futures contracts used as fixed legs in swaps.

concepts.name: Fixed-Price Financial Swap
concepts.scope: Covers the exchange of a fixed futures-settlement price for a floating index price over a delivery period.

concepts.name: Basis Swap
concepts.scope: Covers the hedging of geographic price differentials between Henry Hub and a specific delivery location.

concepts.name: Swing Swap
concepts.scope: Defines the exchange of a fixed price for a daily published index price, often used for volumetric risk management.

concepts.name: Exotic Options in OTC Gas Markets
concepts.scope: Identifies Asian, barrier, spread and swing options available in OTC markets as alternatives to vanilla exchange options.

concepts.name: March-April Widowmaker Spread
concepts.scope: Covers the highly volatile intermonth spread between March and April natural gas futures driven by end-of-winter storage dynamics.

concepts.name: Natural Gas Volatility
concepts.scope: Characterises natural gas as having consistently high realised and implied volatility relative to other commodity futures.

concepts.name: OTC Bilateral vs OTC Cleared Trading
concepts.scope: Distinguishes direct counterparty credit management from centrally cleared OTC execution and their respective risk profiles.

concepts.name: ICE Lot Contract Size
concepts.scope: Defines the OTC ICE Lot as 2,500 MMBTU per day, one quarter of the NYMEX futures contract size.

concepts.name: Physical Natural Gas Delivery Hubs
concepts.scope: Covers the network of US pipeline delivery points at which fixed-price and basis OTC contracts are settled physically.

concepts.name: Price Transparency in OTC Markets
concepts.scope: Covers live anonymous quote dissemination as a mechanism for attracting liquidity and supporting price discovery.

implied_prerequisites: Pipeline and physical gas delivery basics

dipeng_show_models.topic: Day-Ahead Power Price Modelling and Portfolio Analysis

concepts.name: Day-Ahead Moving Average (DA MA) Prices
concepts.scope: Captures the moving-average structure of day-ahead power prices to separate systematic profile from noise.

concepts.name: Imbalance Cost Analysis
concepts.scope: Quantifies the costs arising from deviations between scheduled and actual generation or consumption in the balancing market.

concepts.name: Hourly DA Weighted Revenue
concepts.scope: Measures portfolio revenue by weighting day-ahead prices against hourly generation or position profiles.

concepts.name: Bias Correction in Price Statistics
concepts.scope: Adjusts raw price model outputs to remove systematic forecast bias identified in historical data.

concepts.name: Historical Volatility
concepts.scope: Estimates the degree of price variability observed in past power and gas market data over a defined lookback window.

concepts.name: Power-Gas Correlation Collapse
concepts.scope: Describes periods where the normally positive statistical relationship between power and gas prices breaks down significantly.

concepts.name: Cross-Commodity Correlation
concepts.scope: Measures the co-movement between power and natural gas prices for use in joint risk and pricing models.

concepts.name: Dutch NZW Pricing Model
concepts.scope: A region-specific day-ahead price model calibrated to Dutch North-West zone market conditions.

dipeng_solar.topic: UK Solar PV Power Purchase Agreements and Green Power Valuation

concepts.name: Power Purchase Agreement (PPA)
concepts.scope: A contract between a renewable generator and an offtaker specifying the price and terms under which generated electricity and associated benefits are sold.

concepts.name: Market Benchmark Price (MBP)
concepts.scope: A composite reference price summing wholesale power, ROCs, REGOs and embedded benefits to represent the full achievable market value for green power.

concepts.name: Renewable Obligation Certificate (ROC)
concepts.scope: A tradeable green certificate issued per MWh of eligible renewable generation, with a banding multiplier varying by technology, used to demonstrate compliance with the Renewable Obligation.

concepts.name: ROC Obligation Level
concepts.scope: The annual quantity of ROCs suppliers must surrender per MWh of supply, set by BEIS, which drives ROC market value through the buy-out price and recycle mechanism.

concepts.name: ROC Recycle Value
concepts.scope: The share of the buy-out fund redistributed to ROC holders in proportion to certificates surrendered, forming part of the total ROC value received by generators.

concepts.name: Feed-in Tariff (FiT) Export Rate
concepts.scope: An administered per-MWh payment available to small-scale generators for electricity exported to the grid, as an alternative to a commercial PPA.

concepts.name: Contract for Difference (CfD)
concepts.scope: A UK government support mechanism paying generators the difference between a strike price and a market reference price, requiring a separate offtake PPA for the physical power.

concepts.name: CfD Market Reference Price (MRP)
concepts.scope: The benchmark market price used to calculate CfD top-up or clawback payments, against which PPA offtaker discounts are applied.

concepts.name: Value Retention
concepts.scope: The percentage of the Market Benchmark Price actually received by the generator after offtaker discounts and fees, varying by route-to-market and contract length.

concepts.name: Renewable Energy Guarantee of Origin (REGO)
concepts.scope: A certificate proving that electricity was generated from a renewable source, tradeable separately and carrying a small incremental value in PPA negotiations.

concepts.name: Embedded Benefits
concepts.scope: Revenue streams or avoided costs accruing to distribution-connected generators including avoided TNUoS, BSUoS, GDUoS charges and transmission and distribution loss savings.

concepts.name: Transmission Network Use of System charge (TNUoS)
concepts.scope: A charge levied on transmission-connected parties for use of the high-voltage network, which embedded generators can avoid or receive a credit for, including via the Triad mechanism.

concepts.name: Balancing Services Use of System charge (BSUoS)
concepts.scope: A charge reflecting the cost of balancing the electricity system, which embedded generators can partially avoid and share with offtakers as an embedded benefit.

concepts.name: Generator Distribution Use of System charge (GDUoS)
concepts.scope: A credit paid to generators connected to the distribution network that offsets distribution network costs, dependent on voltage connection level and intermittency.

concepts.name: Transmission and Distribution Losses
concepts.scope: The physical energy lost in transporting electricity across networks, valued as an embedded benefit for distribution-connected generators who avoid contributing to these losses.

concepts.name: Triad Benefit
concepts.scope: An embedded benefit arising from a generator's ability to reduce net demand during the three half-hour settlement periods of highest system demand, reducing TNUoS liability.

concepts.name: Imbalance Risk
concepts.scope: The financial exposure arising when a party's metered generation or consumption deviates from its contracted position, settled at the cash-out price in the Balancing Mechanism.

concepts.name: Intraday Extrinsic Value
concepts.scope: Additional value capturable through intraday trading of renewable output by re-optimising positions as generation forecasts improve closer to delivery.

concepts.name: Seasonal Time of Day (STOD) Pricing
concepts.scope: A tariff structure differentiating electricity prices by time of day and season to reflect varying demand and supply costs across peak, off-peak and night periods.

concepts.name: e-POWER Auction
concepts.scope: An NFPA-run competitive auction mechanism for short-term renewable PPAs where generators tender their output and embedded benefits to multiple offtakers simultaneously.

concepts.name: Flexible PPA
concepts.scope: A power purchase agreement where the generator's output is priced against a floating market index rather than a fixed price, exposing both parties to market price movements.

concepts.name: Fixed Price PPA
concepts.scope: A power purchase agreement locking in a single agreed price for electricity for the contract term, eliminating market price risk for the generator.

concepts.name: Corporate PPA
concepts.scope: A long-term direct electricity supply agreement between a renewable generator and a corporate end-user, often structured with sleeving through a licensed supplier.

concepts.name: Sleeving
concepts.scope: An arrangement whereby a licensed supplier intermediates between a generator and a corporate buyer to manage balancing, metering and settlement obligations.

concepts.name: Backwardation
concepts.scope: A market structure in which forward prices for seasonal power contracts decline for delivery periods further into the future.

concepts.name: Financial Commitment Milestone (CfD)
concepts.scope: A contractual deadline by which a CfD-supported project must demonstrate financial close, failing which the Low Carbon Contracts Company may terminate the agreement.

concepts.name: CMP 264 / CMP 265
concepts.scope: Proposed code modifications to transmission charging arrangements that would limit or remove the TNUoS embedded benefit for new embedded generators from specified dates.

concepts.name: Generation Forecasting Accuracy
concepts.scope: The precision with which a generator or third-party service predicts output ahead of delivery, directly determining the size of imbalance costs and intraday trading value.

concepts.name: ROC Compliance Period
concepts.scope: The annual April-to-March period within which ROCs must be surrendered to meet supplier obligations, with surplus ROCs bankable into future periods.

concepts.name: Day-ahead index pricing
concepts.scope: Electricity priced as a percentage of the N2EX hourly day-ahead market index, transferring short-run price exposure to the offtaker.

concepts.name: Fixed-price PPA
concepts.scope: Electricity sold at a locked-in £/MWh tariff referenced to seasonal baseload forward contract settlement prices for the contract term.

concepts.name: ROC Buyout Price
concepts.scope: The regulated price at which suppliers can discharge their Renewables Obligation in lieu of surrendering ROCs, forming the floor of ROC market value.

concepts.name: Generator Distribution Use of System (GDUoS) Benefit
concepts.scope: A credit paid by distribution network operators to generators that offset distribution network costs by injecting power locally.

concepts.name: Triad Avoidance
concepts.scope: Revenue arising from a generator's ability to reduce a supplier's exposure to the three half-hour demand peaks used to set transmission demand charges.

concepts.name: Bankability requirements
concepts.scope: Contractual terms required by project finance lenders to make a PPA acceptable as security, including take-or-pay, investment-grade counterparty and direct agreement provisions.

concepts.name: Investment-grade counterparty credit
concepts.scope: The requirement that the offtaker in a PPA holds an investment-grade credit rating or is supported by a rated parent entity to satisfy lender requirements.

concepts.name: Direct Agreement
concepts.scope: A tripartite contract between lenders, the generator and the offtaker giving lenders step-in rights over the PPA in an enforcement scenario.

concepts.name: Non-recourse project finance
concepts.scope: Debt secured only on project assets and cash flows, without recourse to the sponsor's balance sheet, imposing strict PPA structural requirements.

concepts.name: Feed-in Tariff (FiT)
concepts.scope: A UK government scheme guaranteeing a fixed payment per MWh to small-scale renewable generators, applicable here to anaerobic digestion projects.

concepts.name: SDE+ subsidy (Netherlands)
concepts.scope: The Dutch renewable energy production incentive that tops up market revenue to a reference price, with the PPA required to mirror its price index.

concepts.name: APX peak price reference
concepts.scope: The annual average APX day-ahead peak price used as the market electricity price reference within the Dutch SDE+ framework.

concepts.name: Guarantee of Origin (GoO)
concepts.scope: A European certificate confirming renewable origin of one MWh of electricity, analogous to REGOs, priced separately in Dutch PPA structures.

concepts.name: Price floor
concepts.scope: A minimum guaranteed offtake price protecting project revenue against sustained low wholesale market prices, viewed favourably by lenders.

concepts.name: Negative price handling
concepts.scope: PPA provisions determining whether the generator is paid, curtailed or compensated during periods when wholesale market prices fall below zero.

concepts.name: Capacity Market Supplier Levy embedded benefit
concepts.scope: An embedded benefit representing the share of capacity market supplier levy savings that embedded generators can negotiate with their offtaker.

concepts.name: Solar irradiance and wind forecast interaction
concepts.scope: The meteorological dependency whereby errors in wind speed forecasts propagate into solar radiation forecast errors through cloud-cover dynamics.

concepts.name: Half-hourly (HH) settlement data
concepts.scope: Metered generation data at 30-minute resolution used for settlement, yield assessment and PPA pricing evaluation.

concepts.name: N2EX index
concepts.scope: The Nord Pool day-ahead power exchange operating in Great Britain, providing the reference price for index-linked PPA structures.

concepts.name: REMiT reporting obligation
concepts.scope: EU regulation requiring market participants with assets above 10 MW to report wholesale energy transactions and fundamental data to regulators.

concepts.name: East-west panel orientation
concepts.scope: A solar panel mounting configuration that increases capacity per hectare and flattens the daily generation profile relative to south-facing arrays.

concepts.name: Full Load Hours (FLH)
concepts.scope: An annual yield metric expressing total energy output as equivalent hours of operation at rated capacity, used for P50 yield assessment.

concepts.name: P50 yield assessment
concepts.scope: An independent energy yield estimate with a 50% probability of exceedance, used as the base-case production assumption in project finance.

concepts.name: Renewables Obligation Certificate (ROC)
concepts.scope: UK subsidy instrument entitling solar generators to tradeable certificates per MWh of eligible output.

concepts.name: ROC buyout price and recycle fund
concepts.scope: Regulatory mechanism setting the floor price for ROCs and redistributing buyout fund proceeds to obligated suppliers.

concepts.name: ROC supply-demand balance
concepts.scope: Modelling framework projecting the ratio of ROCs issued to obligation demand to determine market clearing price.

concepts.name: Imbalance exposure
concepts.scope: Revenue risk arising from difference between metered generation and contracted volume settled at system imbalance price.

concepts.name: Half-hourly (HH) generation data
concepts.scope: Granular settlement-period output records used to calibrate solar generation profiles and imbalance calculations.

concepts.name: Solar generation forecasting
concepts.scope: Statistical or physical modelling of site-level PV output for use in contract pricing and hedging.

concepts.name: Hindcast analysis
concepts.scope: Back-testing of generation or price models against historical actuals to validate forecast accuracy.

concepts.name: Potential Future Exposure (PFE)
concepts.scope: Forward-looking credit risk metric representing the distribution of mark-to-market exposure at a given confidence level over time.

concepts.name: Cashflow and working capital analysis
concepts.scope: Project-level modelling of periodic cash inflows and outflows to assess liquidity and funding requirements.

concepts.name: Forward power price curve
concepts.scope: Market-implied or model-derived term structure of electricity prices used to value future generation revenues.

concepts.name: Value at Risk (VaR) for ROC revenue
concepts.scope: Statistical measure of downside exposure in ROC price income under adverse market scenarios.

concepts.name: SDE+ subsidy (NL)
concepts.scope: Dutch feed-in premium scheme supplementing renewable generators' revenue up to a cap price per MWh.

concepts.name: Installed capacity tracking
concepts.scope: Monitoring of cumulative deployed PV capacity to inform supply-side modelling and subsidy regime projections.

concepts.name: Return on credit model
concepts.scope: Framework for evaluating risk-adjusted return on capital deployed in counterparty credit exposures under energy contracts.

concepts.name: N2EX day-ahead price
concepts.scope: GB day-ahead auction price on the N2EX exchange used as a reference for power settlement and imbalance comparison.

concepts.name: RPI escalation
concepts.scope: Inflation indexation applied to contract prices or subsidy values using the Retail Price Index.

concepts.name: Multi-site portfolio aggregation
concepts.scope: Consolidation of generation, imbalance, and revenue data across multiple solar farm sites for portfolio-level risk and pricing.

concepts.name: Tenor structuring (1-year, 2-year, 5-year, 10-year)
concepts.scope: Selection of contract or modelling horizon affecting price risk, subsidy overlap, and financing considerations.

ROC buy-out and recycle value forecasting
Embedded benefit quantification by technology and connection voltage
Competitive PPA tender and bid evaluation
Case study revenue modelling by technology and location
Day-ahead N2EX index pricing with sharing percentage
STOD tariff pricing by voltage connection level

Subsequent price-fixing option within index-linked PPA
Portfolio batching and volume-tiered pricing evaluation
Credit support sizing (months of revenue coverage)
Broker screen transparency methodology for price fixing
SDE+ subsidy mirroring in PPA price structure
Advance payment and monthly settlement reconciliation
Imbalance cost calculation (metered vs contracted volume)
Statistical regression/time-series fitting for generation forecasts

Renewable Obligation and ROC banding framework
